text: The backs of road signs are often painted **black**.
NOTE: This is also common in Italy and Romania.
text_zh: 道路標誌的背面通常漆成**黑色**。
注意：這在義大利和羅馬尼亞也很常見。

text: The “S” on Albanian stop signs feature a **distinct shape**; the ends of the S are quite short and have the same angle as the middle, rather than being vertical. This is also sometimes seen on [directional signs](https://www.google.com/maps/@41.4762807,19.7144537,3a,15y,293.79h,86.16t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s0Xem3meAWDPpNUbSfeuE5A!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).
NOTE: Italian [stops signs](https://goo.gl/maps/366KjYZAnUyXk4YZ6) and [directional signs](https://goo.gl/maps/EKJL6bTozCYSMke28) have the same feature.
text_zh: 阿爾巴尼亞停車標誌上的「S」字樣具有**獨特的形狀**；S 的兩端相當短，且與中間部分角度相同，而非垂直。這有時也會出現在[方向標誌](https://www.google.com/maps/@41.4762807,19.7144537,3a,15y,293.79h,86.16t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s0Xem3meAWDPpNUbSfeuE5A!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)上。
注意：義大利的[停車標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/366KjYZAnUyXk4YZ6)和[方向標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/EKJL6bTozCYSMke28)也有相同特徵。

text: The numbers on speed signs are written in a **bold font**.
NOTE: The font is much thinner on speed signs in [Montenegro](https://goo.gl/maps/fvWn6neYoBsnP6J18).
text_zh: 速限標誌上的數字以**粗體字型**書寫。
注意：在[蒙特內哥羅](https://goo.gl/maps/fvWn6neYoBsnP6J18)的速限標誌上，字體會細得多。

text: Direction signs have a white background, a **blue outline**, and a unique font.
text_zh: 方向指示牌為白底、**藍色外框**，並使用獨特的字體。

text: Similar white signs with a** **blue outline and unique font can also be seen at the **entrance of towns**.
NOTE: Germany uses [yellow town entrance signs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/fLnrUWoSDqzsyGxx5) with a black outline.
text_zh: 在**城鎮入口**也能看到類似的白色標誌，帶有**藍色外框**和獨特字體。
註：德國使用的是帶有黑色外框的[黃色城鎮入口標誌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/fLnrUWoSDqzsyGxx5)。

text: **Green** signs can commonly be seen, giving directions to different local facilities.
text_zh: 常見的**綠色**標誌會指示通往當地不同設施的方向。

text: **Pedestrian signs** have a unique design: instead of zebra stripes, they have two horizontal dashed lines.
NOTE: All neighbouring countries have pedestrian signs with zebra stripes.
text_zh: **行人標誌**有獨特的設計：它們沒有斑馬線，而是兩條水平虛線。
註：所有鄰國的行人標誌都有斑馬線圖案。

text: Road signs in Austria are sometimes mounted by **four metal clips**, which is unique within central Europe. However, plenty of Austrian signs are attached in other ways.
text_zh: 奧地利的道路標誌有時會用**四個金屬夾**固定，這在中歐是獨一無二的。不過，也有許多奧地利標誌是以其他方式固定。

text: Austrian **bus stop signs** contain a yellow and green circle with the letter **H**.
NOTE: This design is relatively unique in Europe. The only other country with similar bus stop signs is Germany.
text_zh: 奧地利的**公車站牌**包含一個黃綠相間的圓圈，中間帶有字母 **H**。
註：這種設計在歐洲相當獨特。唯一擁有類似公車站牌的國家是德國。

text: These one-way traffic signs, with the word **‘EINBAHN’** written on them, are unique to Austria.
NOTE: In Germany there will be “Einbahnstraße” written on the sign.
text_zh: 這些寫有 **‘EINBAHN’** 字樣的單行道交通標誌是奧地利特有的。
註：在德國，標誌上會寫著「Einbahnstraße」。

text: “No Stopping” and “No Waiting” signs in Austria will often have the words “Anfang” or “Ende” (meaning “beginning” and “end”) written on, or below, them.
text_zh: 奧地利的「禁止停車」和「禁止臨時停車」標誌上或下方，經常會寫有「Anfang」或「Ende」（意為「開始」與「結束」）字樣。

text: These simple dead-end signs with a **white upside down T** are mostly unique to Austria.
Most countries in Europe use [this sign](https://maps.app.goo.gl/cB2CMCs6fQTNTZPQ8).
NOTE: Older coverage in Switzerland can be seen using [this design](https://maps.app.goo.gl/yv3PkLHesS63WCYD7) as well.
text_zh: 這種帶有**白色倒 T 形**的簡易無路可通標誌主要為奧地利獨有。
歐洲大多數國家使用的是[這種標誌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/cB2CMCs6fQTNTZPQ8)。
註：瑞士較舊的街景覆蓋中也可以看到[這種設計](https://maps.app.goo.gl/yv3PkLHesS63WCYD7)。

text: These **yellow and white stripes** around poles and signposts are found in Vorarlberg.
text_zh: 柱子和標誌桿上的這些**黃白相間條紋**出現在福拉爾貝格邦。

text: Most Brazilian road signs have the backs painted **black**.
NOTE: This is also common in Paraguay.
text_zh: 大多數巴西道路標誌的背面都被漆成**黑色**。
註：這在巴拉圭也很常見。

text: **Postcodes (CEP) **are seen frequently on [street signs](https://goo.gl/maps/7RAf4dB5LnHm3PT36) in Brazil (though sometimes hard to read). The first two numbers will depict an area, a state or multiple states. The numbers go anti-clockwise from São Paulo, ending in Rio Grande do Sul.
text_zh: 巴西的[路牌](https://goo.gl/maps/7RAf4dB5LnHm3PT36)上經常可以看到**郵遞區號（CEP）**（雖然有時很難看清）。前兩位數字代表一個區域、一個州或多個州。數字從聖保羅開始呈逆時針方向排列，最後止於南里奧格蘭德州。

text: Street signs in [Campo Grande](https://goo.gl/maps/bP6rWChW4MMmzJS18) and [Joinville](https://goo.gl/maps/1UTu9TZ3KLZK4kxv7) are **stickers** wrapped around a pole at intersections. Campo Grande signs usually have extra information and a red and yellow stripe.
text_zh: 在[大坎普](https://goo.gl/maps/bP6rWChW4MMmzJS18)與[若茵維利](https://goo.gl/maps/1UTu9TZ3KLZK4kxv7)，路標是路口處包裹在桿子上的**貼紙**。大坎普的路標通常會有額外資訊以及紅黃相間的條紋。

text: Canada uses the word **‘maximum’ **on speed signs. Because speed is measured in kilometres instead of miles, the numbers tend to be higher than the US which can be identifiable from afar.

NOTE: The US uses the words **‘speed limit’ **on such signs. In addition, speed limits ending with 5 are more common in the US, and the ‘speed limit’ text takes up two lines versus one for ‘maximum’ in Canada.
text_zh: 加拿大在速限標誌上使用 **‘maximum’** 這個詞。由於速度是以公里而非英里來衡量，因此數字往往比美國更高，這從遠處就能辨識出來。
注意：美國在此類標誌上使用 **‘speed limit’** 這個詞。此外，以 5 結尾的速限在美國更常見，「speed limit」的文字佔據兩行，而加拿大的「maximum」則是一行。

text: Canadian road signs tend to be **less wordy** compared to their US counterparts. Good examples of this are railroad crossing and yield signs. In the US, these usually have the literal words ‘railroad crossing’ and ‘yield’ written on them, whereas in Canada, these signs are typically** **blank.
text_zh: 與美國相比，加拿大的道路標誌通常**較少文字**。平交道標誌與讓路標誌就是很好的例子。在美國，這些標誌通常寫著 ‘railroad crossing’ 和 ‘yield’ 字樣，而在加拿大，這些標誌通常是** **空白的。

text: Canada uses unique **diamond**-shaped T-Intersection signs.
NOTE: Canada is the only country in the world where you can find these signs. The US, for example, uses rectangular** **T-Intersection signs.
text_zh: 加拿大使用獨特的**菱形** T 字路口標誌。
註：加拿大是世界上唯一能看到這種標誌的國家。例如，美國使用的是矩形** **T 字路口標誌。

text: **Thin metal signposts** are common. They will typically either have several small holes or have a [U profile](https://maps.app.goo.gl/oqFAZpsUpMhbDx5P8).
text_zh: **細金屬標誌桿**很常見。它們通常帶有幾個小孔，或是採用 [U 型截面](https://maps.app.goo.gl/oqFAZpsUpMhbDx5P8)。

text: French is the majority language in **Québec** and parts of **New Brunswick**.

NOTE: At the federal level, French has official status alongside English, so you can sometimes find bilingual signs in other parts of Canada. In addition, French is also spoken in several communities in Nova Scotia, Ontario and Manitoba.
text_zh: 法文是**魁北克省**以及**紐布倫斯威克省**部分地區的主要語言。
註：在聯邦層級，法文與英文同具官方語言地位，因此在加拿大其他地區有時也能找到雙語標誌。此外，新斯科細亞省、安大略省和曼尼托巴省的幾個社區也使用法文。

text: Some provinces have **unique speed signs**.
Ontario speed limit signs may have a **black section** on the bottom with the words ‘km/h’ or ‘begins’ written in white.
British Columbian signs also include the ‘km/h’ but **lack **the black section.
Québec can sometimes have **French **on their speed limit signs.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 部分省份擁有**獨特限速標誌**。
安大略省的限速標誌底部可能有一個**黑色區塊**，上面印有白字「km/h」或「begins」。
卑詩省的標誌也包含「km/h」，但**缺少 **黑色區塊。
魁北克省的限速標誌上有時會有**法文 **。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Québec T-Intersection signs **do not **feature the chequerboard pattern.
text_zh: 魁北克省的 T 字路口標誌**不 **具備棋盤格圖案。

text: Newfoundland T-Intersection signs feature a **rectangular yellow border** around the diamond shape.
text_zh: 紐芬蘭的 T 字路口標誌在菱形外圍帶有**黃色矩形外框**。

text: Road signs in British Columbia can have **green** backsides.
NOTE: Green backsides are also somewhat common on Prince Edward Island.
text_zh: 卑詩省的道路標誌背面可以是**綠色**的。
註：綠色背面在愛德華王子島上也算常見。

text: Signs in British Columbia are sometimes hung down from these unique signposts.
text_zh: 卑詩省的標誌有時會從這種獨特的標誌桿上懸掛下來。

text: You can sometimes find a **green and white** striped sticker on signposts in Manitoba.
text_zh: 在曼尼托巴省的標誌桿上，有時可以找到**綠白相間**的條紋貼紙。

text: Signposts in Saskatchewan can feature these **white triangles**. The number can vary.
text_zh: 薩克其萬省的標誌桿上會有這種**白色三角形**。數字可能會有所不同。

text: Stop signs with the word **‘Arrêt’ **are unique to Québec.
text_zh: 帶有 **‘Arrêt’** 字樣的停止標誌是魁北克特有的。

text: Stop signs with both **‘Stop’ and ‘Arrêt’** are most commonly found in New Brunswick.
NOTE: Such stop signs can rarely be found in other provinces.
text_zh: 同時印有 **「Stop」與「Arrêt」** 的 Stop 標誌最常見於紐布倫斯威克省。
註：此類 Stop 標誌極少出現在其他省份。

text: Like the stop signs, street signs in New Brunswick are also bilingual.
Though unlike the stop signs, bilingual street signs are found in other French minority areas of Canada.
text_zh: 與 Stop 標誌一樣，紐布倫斯威克省的路名牌也是雙語的。
不過與 Stop 標誌不同的是，雙語路名牌也可以在加拿大其他法文少數族群地區看到。

text: Rural roads in Alberta are numbered sequentially. This makes it easy to figure out your exact location using just a road sign.
- **Township roads** (Twp Rd) run east to west. Their numbers increase the more north you go.
- **Range roads** (Rge Rd) run north to south. Their numbers increase the more west you go. These numbers reset a couple of times.

[This infographic](/images/canada/canada_albertatownshipgrid.png) shows which numbers are found where. You need to multiply the numbers on the grid by 10 to get the road numbers. For example, the junction in the image example is found just north of Red Deer.
NOTE: Similarly named roads can also sometimes be seen in Saskatchewan, however they are more common in Alberta.
text_zh: 亞伯達省的鄉村道路按順序編號。這讓你僅憑道路標誌就能輕鬆確定具體位置。
- **鄉鎮道路**（Twp Rd）呈東西走向。越往北走，編號越大。
- **範圍道路**（Rge Rd）呈南北走向。越往西走，編號越大。這些編號會重置數次。
[這張圖表](/images/canada/canada_albertatownshipgrid.png)顯示了各編號的分佈位置。你需要將網格上的數字乘以 10 才能得到道路編號。例如，圖例中的交叉路口位於紅鹿市正北方。
註：類似命名的道路偶爾也會出現在薩克其萬省，不過在亞伯達省更常見。

text: In Newfoundland and Labrador, most wooden posts on guardrails have this **pyramid** shaped top. Occasionally, you can spot them on [standalone posts](https://goo.gl/maps/hBq3pYWKuD2MkgFQ7) and [signposts](https://goo.gl/maps/grcv9vSj4wF5MUzZ7) as well.
text_zh: 在紐芬蘭與拉布拉多省，護欄上的大部分木柱都帶有這種**金字塔**形頂端。偶爾你也能在[獨立立柱](https://goo.gl/maps/hBq3pYWKuD2MkgFQ7)和[標誌桿](https://goo.gl/maps/grcv9vSj4wF5MUzZ7)上看到它們。

text: You can spot these **wooden boxes** holding up signs in Newfoundland and Labrador.
text_zh: 你可以在紐芬蘭與拉布拉多省看到支撐標誌的**木盒**。

text: Christmas Island uses the standard **Australian bollard**. It is a simple white bollard with a red reflector on the front, and a grey reflector on the back.

NOTE: In general, road infrastructure metas are similar to those found on mainland Australia, such as [speed limit signs](https://goo.gl/maps/bMWYvWn1yBfSiWs29), [green sign backgrounds](https://goo.gl/maps/EDq64mntxxcKBnrk7), etc.
text_zh: 聖誕島使用標準的**澳洲路樁**。這是一個簡單的白色路樁，正面有紅色反光片，背面有灰色反光片。
註：一般來說，道路基礎設施的特徵與澳洲本土發現的相似，例如[速限標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/bMWYvWn1yBfSiWs29)、[綠色標誌背景](https://goo.gl/maps/EDq64mntxxcKBnrk7)等。

text: Bus stop signs in Denmark are **black and yellow**. A small sign is attached to the top of the pole, with the bus schedule underneath. Additionally, you may see this older [**blue and white**](https://goo.gl/maps/fRjTDJetFmcvkqtt6)** **version.
text_zh: 丹麥的公車站牌是**黑黃相間**的。桿子頂端附有一個小牌子，下方則是公車時刻表。此外，你可能會看到這個較舊的[**藍白**](https://goo.gl/maps/fRjTDJetFmcvkqtt6)** **版本。

text: **Yellow traffic light poles** are typically found in the city of Santiago de los Caballeros.
NOTE: This only applies to traffic light poles - yellow signposts are common in both cities.
text_zh: **黃色紅綠燈桿**通常位於聖地牙哥市。
注意：這僅適用於紅綠燈桿——黃色路標柱在兩座城市都很常見。

text: Small **yellow signs** displaying the road number, which typically starts with a “**D**”, are unique to France. They are commonly placed on top of directional signs or town entry signs.
text_zh: 顯示道路編號的小型**黃色標誌**（通常以「**D**」開頭）是法國特有的。它們通常放置在指標或城鎮入口標誌的上方。

text: French directional signs are usually white with a black outline slightly offset from the edge. They have an arrow-like shape, with the black border getting thicker at the point.
Highway directions have either a [blue or green background](https://goo.gl/maps/8jKUAjSqdf9AJcLM9).
Smaller places and points of interest are frequently written in an italic font.
text_zh: 法國的指標通常是白色的，帶有稍微偏離邊緣的黑色外框。它們呈箭頭形狀，黑色邊框在尖端處變粗。
高速公路指標具有[藍色或綠色背景](https://goo.gl/maps/8jKUAjSqdf9AJcLM9)。
較小的地點和景點通常以斜體字書寫。

text: Town entrance signs in France have a red border with a thin white outline.
text_zh: 法國的城鎮入口標誌帶有紅色邊框和細白邊。

text: French road signs have a red border with a thin white outline. You will often find white rectangular signs with black text below traffic signs.
NOTE: Road signs in Spain have a [thick red border](https://maps.app.goo.gl/49ec9Xf89vko3Tbr5) that goes all the way to the edge.
text_zh: 法國的道路標誌帶有紅色邊框和細白邊。你經常會在交通標誌下方找到帶有黑字的白色長方形標誌。
註：西班牙的道路標誌具有[粗紅色邊框](https://maps.app.goo.gl/49ec9Xf89vko3Tbr5)，一直延伸到邊緣。

text: Many traffic signs in France have flat rectangular signposts.
_Signposts, along with signbacks, can be dyed with unorthodox colours, more so than in other countries. Some of those are regional, which you can learn more about in the regionguessing section._
NOTE: The only other European countries with flat signposts are Portugal, Spain, and Andorra.
text_zh: 法國的許多交通標誌都使用扁平的長方形標誌桿。
_標誌桿以及標誌背面可以塗上非傳統的顏色，比其他國家更常見。其中有些是地區性的，你可以在地區猜測（regionguessing）部分深入了解。_
注意：歐洲其他擁有扁平標誌桿的國家只有葡萄牙、西班牙和安道爾。

text: Traffic signs with particularly **short signposts** are very common in France.
text_zh: 法國非常常見具有特別**短標誌桿**的交通標誌。

text: Pedestrian crossing signs in France have five stripes and a disconnected head on the person. They have the usual white border of French traffic signs.
Less commonly, you can find a design with [two dashed lines](https://goo.gl/maps/iD7GdGUA7Ew3h8oa7) instead of stripes.
text_zh: 法國的人行穿越道標誌有五條條紋，且行人的頭部是分離的。它們帶有法國交通標誌常見的白色邊框。
較少見的情況是，你可以找到採用[兩條虛線](https://goo.gl/maps/iD7GdGUA7Ew3h8oa7)而非條紋設計的標誌。

text: Kilometre markers in France most commonly have a yellow or red semicircle on top of a white rectangle. They can be found in the form of a waystone or as a flat sign and can be either [parallel](https://goo.gl/maps/8KpoMhXGetkA7qeR9) or [perpendicular](https://goo.gl/maps/WJHfU8tnG9qfZoyDA) to the road. Major highways can have [square markers](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RTdHYF79SdUZFLTt7) with a red top.
text_zh: 法國的公里標石通常在白色長方形上方有一個黃色或紅色的半圓形。它們可以是界石或扁平標誌的形式，並且可以[平行](https://goo.gl/maps/8KpoMhXGetkA7qeR9)或[垂直](https://goo.gl/maps/WJHfU8tnG9qfZoyDA)於道路。主要高速公路上則可能有頂部為紅色的[方形標誌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RTdHYF79SdUZFLTt7)。

text: House numbers in France are most commonly blue, typically written in a serif font with slightly exaggerated shapes. This is most useful when differentiating from Italy, which almost never uses blue house number signs.
NOTE: Similar designs can be found in all other neighbouring, as well as many other, countries.
text_zh: 法國的門牌號碼最常見的是藍色，通常以帶有稍微誇張造型的襯線字體書寫。這在區分義大利時非常有用，因為義大利幾乎從不使用藍色門牌號碼標誌。
注意：類似的設計也可以在所有其他鄰國以及許多其他國家找到。

text: Most departments have their own unique logo (formally called official flag), often containing stylized initials or the entire name. Notable infrastructure with department logos include [bus stops](https://maps.app.goo.gl/1CqFWtzhUqLV2k8n7), [kilometre markers](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JGY1Xwa8SvPyyV5A9), [trail banners](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kP4kjMrH3rK5gLSZ7), [directional signs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/QM5gqNqrRtf4gWRR6) and [signbacks](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ZHA8UMQL6eFzSNyP6). Learning what each logo looks like is not recommended for beginners, but it can be helpful to know what they stand for when scanning.

You can find the full list of logos [here](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flags_of_the_regions_of_France#French_Departments), or see them projected onto a map [here](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/06/Flag_Map_of_Departments_of_France_Version_2_%28Logo_Flags%29.png).
text_zh: 大多數省份都有自己獨特的標誌（正式稱為官方旗幟），通常包含風格化的縮寫或全名。帶有省份標誌的知名基礎設施包括[公車站](https://maps.app.goo.gl/1CqFWtzhUqLV2k8n7)、[公里標石](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JGY1Xwa8SvPyyV5A9)、[步道標示](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kP4kjMrH3rK5gLSZ7)、[方向標誌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/QM5gqNqrRtf4gWRR6)和[標誌背面](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ZHA8UMQL6eFzSNyP6)。不建議初學者學習每個標誌長什麼樣子，但在掃描時了解它們代表什麼會很有幫助。

你可以在[這裡](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flags_of_the_regions_of_France#French_Departments)找到標誌的完整列表，或在[這裡](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/06/Flag_Map_of_Departments_of_France_Version_2_%28Logo_Flags%29.png)查看它們在地圖上的投影。

text: A flag made up of red and yellow stripes, based on [the Senyera](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Senyera), is the official flag and department logo of **Pyrénées-Orientales**. You will often find the pattern used in coats of arms on street signs.
NOTE: The flag of [Provence](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Provence) looks similar, but with [vertical](https://maps.app.goo.gl/CWTzNJaQNoRJwEDeA) stripes instead.
text_zh: 一面由紅黃條紋組成、基於[塞涅拉旗](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Senyera)的旗幟，是**東比利牛斯省**的官方旗幟和省份標誌。你經常會在路標的徽章上看到這種圖案。
注意：[普羅旺斯](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Provence)的旗幟看起來很相似，但採用的是[垂直](https://maps.app.goo.gl/CWTzNJaQNoRJwEDeA)條紋。

text: **Dark green** road signposts and backs are most commonly found in Brittany and around Paris, but also various southern regions in the country.
NOTE: Beware that this, and the following coloured infrastructure can rarely be found in other parts of the country.
text_zh: **深綠色**的道路標誌桿和背面最常在布列塔尼和巴黎周邊找到，但在該國的各個南部地區也能見到。
注意：請注意，這種以及接下來的彩色基礎設施在該國的其他地區很少見。

text: In the Pas-de-Calais department, you may find road signs with the following colour arrangement: a **dark green post** paired with a signback of a **lighter shade of green**, ranging from [matcha green](https://maps.app.goo.gl/cH9cbEYkyVwUMkEXA) to [greenish turquoise](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HVwoK8mut3XwKQ8g8). The [department’s logo](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/fr/6/64/Logo_62_pas_de_calais.jpg), a green and blue triangle, is occasionally present [on the signback](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RV2AH3h7Lq75MKu47).
NOTE: Under certain lighting, they can appear similar to the greyish road signs mentioned in the previous tip.
text_zh: 在加來海峽省，你可能會找到具有以下顏色配置的路標：**深綠色標誌桿**搭配**較淺綠色**的標誌背面，範圍從[抹茶綠](https://maps.app.goo.gl/cH9cbEYkyVwUMkEXA)到[綠色土耳其玉色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HVwoK8mut3XwKQ8g8)。[該省的標誌](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/fr/6/64/Logo_62_pas_de_calais.jpg)是一個綠藍相間的三角形，偶爾會出現在[標誌背面](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RV2AH3h7Lq75MKu47)。
注意：在特定光線下，它們看起來可能與前一個提示中提到的灰色路標相似。

text: Road signs where both the** post** and **back** are painted **brown** are most commonly found in Seine-et-Marne, and rarely in Ille-et-Vilaine. It is more reliable when the post is **square**, however round signposts are equally common.
text_zh: **標誌桿**和**背面**都漆成**棕色**的路標最常見於塞納-馬恩省，伊勒-維萊訥省則較少見。當標誌桿是**方形**時，這個線索更為可靠，不過圓形標誌桿也同樣常見。

text: Directional signs in Haute-Garonne often use **burgundy red attachments** and ornaments. This is sometimes paired with [yellow signposts](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zXUbPBqqsHJZaBvu7).
text_zh: 上加龍省的方向標誌經常使用**勃根地紅的配件**與裝飾。這有時會與[黃色標誌桿](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zXUbPBqqsHJZaBvu7)搭配使用。

text: Most town entry signs in Marne follow a unique format: Instead of having [separate](https://maps.app.goo.gl/MK8LGR6zFBcdyG2M7) entry and exit signs, they are combined into a **single, noticeably thicker block**.
text_zh: 馬恩省的大多數城鎮入口標誌都遵循獨特的格式：它們沒有[分離的](https://maps.app.goo.gl/MK8LGR6zFBcdyG2M7)入口和出口標誌，而是結合成一個**單一且明顯較厚的區塊**。

text: Street signs in the metropolitan area of Paris often say the** name of the city**, which is generally atypical for street signs in France. The signs will often be made in a **modern design**, and many city names will be** river based**, notably named after Seine and Marne.
NOTE: This can be seen sporadically throughout the country, so consider other clues.
text_zh: 巴黎都會區的街道標誌通常會寫上**城市名稱**，這在法國的街道標誌中通常是不尋常的。這些標誌通常採用**現代設計**，且許多城市名稱將**基於河流**，特別是以塞納河和馬恩河命名。
注意：這在全國各地偶爾也能見到，因此請一併考慮其他線索。

text: [**Breton**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Breton_language) is a Celtic language, visually most similar to Welsh. Common letters include **d**, **k**, **w **and the letter** ñ**, which is not found in French. It is commonly found on the Breton peninsula, with bilingual street signs as east as [Rennes](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SXA9tpudgXLcbpvJ7) and rarely [Nantes](https://maps.app.goo.gl/v9hAN6FqvpLekm5n6). The Breton word for street is straed**.**
text_zh: [**布列塔尼語**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Breton_language)是一種凱爾特語，視覺上與威爾斯語最為相似。常見的字母包括 **d**、**k**、**w** 以及法語中沒有的字母 **ñ**。它常見於布列塔尼半島，雙語路標向東可達[雷恩](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SXA9tpudgXLcbpvJ7)，少數可達[南特](https://maps.app.goo.gl/v9hAN6FqvpLekm5n6)。布列塔尼語中街道的意思是 straed**。**

text: [**Alsatian**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alsatian_dialect), a dialect of German, is occasionally found in [Alsace](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alsace), a region that changed countries 4 times in modern history. Most bilingual street signs use some variation of gasse or strasse.
NOTE: Streets [containing German names](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HeoLMxMiP1nPJuJD9) are also concentrated in this region, though not as consistently.
text_zh: 德語的一個方言[**阿爾薩斯語**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alsatian_dialect)偶爾會在[阿爾薩斯](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alsace)找到，這個地區在近代史上曾 4 次更換國家。大多數雙語街道招牌都會使用 gasse 或 strasse 的某些變體。
注意：[包含德文名稱](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HeoLMxMiP1nPJuJD9)的街道也集中在這個地區，雖然不像前者那麼一致。

text: [**Occitan**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Occitan_language) is a Romance language closely related to Catalan that’s sparsely concentrated in the South of France, most often found on street signs in big cities, and very rarely on [town entry signs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/J5Bj9ZSR2MfHAegg9). It can be divided into dialects, each using a slightly different word for street, all similar to Catalan “carrer”. For example, in Toulouse, you’ll find the Languedocian carrièra and in Avignon carriero, in the Provençal** **dialect.
Click [here](https://i.imgur.com/B8gX96p.png) for a more extensive infographic.
NOTE: The street sign designs pictured are also unique to the two cities respectively.
text_zh: [**奧克語**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Occitan_language)是一種與加泰隆尼亞語密切相關的羅曼語族語言，稀疏地分佈在法國南部，最常出現在大城市的街道招牌上，極少數出現在[城鎮入口標誌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/J5Bj9ZSR2MfHAegg9)上。它可以分為多種方言，每種方言對街道的稱呼略有不同，但都與加泰隆尼亞語的「carrer」相似。例如，在土魯斯你會看到朗格多克方言的 carrièra，而在亞維農則會看到普羅旺斯** **方言的 carriero。
點擊[這裡](https://i.imgur.com/B8gX96p.png)查看更詳細的資訊圖表。
注意：圖中顯示的街道招牌設計也分別是這兩座城市特有的。

text: Bilingual signs in [**Basque**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Basque_language), a language isolate, are concentrated In the western half of the Pyrénées-Atlantiques department, bordering the Basque speaking regions in Spain. Common letters include K, X and Z. On directional signs, it’s written with a **thinner font**, which is unique within all minority languages in France.
The word for street is karrika, in contrast to “kalea” in the Spanish Basque country.
text_zh: [**巴斯克語**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Basque_language)是一種孤立語言，其雙語招牌集中在庇里牛斯-大西洋省（Pyrénées-Atlantiques）的西部地區，與西班牙的巴斯克語地區接壤。常見的字母包括 K、X 和 Z。在方向指示牌上，它使用的是**較細的字體**，這在法國的所有少數族群語言中是獨一無二的。
街道的巴斯克語是 karrika，這與西班牙巴斯克地區的「kalea」形成對比。

text: On the island of Corsica, you may find bilingual signs in [**Corsican**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Corsican_language), a Romance language that utilises many features found in Italian, like words almost always ending in vowels. In particular, the endings** u/iu/ju**, changed from o/io, are common in Corsican. Moreover, placenames will usually have an Italian origin.
text_zh: 在科西嘉島上，你可能會找到[**科西嘉語**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Corsican_language)的雙語招牌。這是一種羅曼語族語言，使用了許多義大利語的特徵，例如單字幾乎總是結尾於母音。特別是結尾為 **u/iu/ju**（由 o/io 轉變而來）在科西嘉語中很常見。此外，地名通常具有義大利語起源。

text: Paris uses an iconic** green & Prussian blue **design with a top arch that has also been replicated in [Bucharest](https://maps.app.goo.gl/E3LqAPwX8jt9YmgK8), which is sometimes referred to as Paris of the east.
NOTE: The simple rectangular form of the sign can be found in the [towns nearby](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Noo6GyM9T63fta8C8) and rarely in [other cities](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SN1rqVG9eMNqQZxQ8).
text_zh: 巴黎採用標誌性的**綠色與普魯士藍**設計，頂部帶有拱形，這種設計也被[布加勒斯特](https://maps.app.goo.gl/E3LqAPwX8jt9YmgK8)複製，該市有時被稱為東方巴黎。
注意：這種招牌的簡單長方形版本可以在[附近的城鎮](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Noo6GyM9T63fta8C8)找到，在[其他城市](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SN1rqVG9eMNqQZxQ8)則非常罕見。

text: Lyon’s street signs feature four corner bolts and an **uninterrupted inner white border** that cuts a **notch** for the arrondissement and each bolt.
NOTE: Outside Lyon proper, the street sign will display the [name of the suburb](https://maps.app.goo.gl/gP3ngUUpUKf4Rqmz6) instead.
text_zh: 里昂的街道招牌特色是四個角落都有螺絲，且具有**不間斷的內側白色邊框**，該邊框在行政區編號和每個螺絲處都有一個**凹口**。
注意：在里昂市區外，街道招牌會顯示[郊區的名稱](https://maps.app.goo.gl/gP3ngUUpUKf4Rqmz6)來代替。

text: **Marseille**’s street signs will usually feature the city’s **emblem**, a variation of the [Greek cross](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christian_cross_variants#Greek_cross). The white border will usually be **interrupted** at the top, even when the cross is [absent](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Kb4vaENAKeNfGt2XA).
text_zh: **馬賽**的街道招牌通常帶有城市的**徽章**，這是[希臘十字](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christian_cross_variants#Greek_cross)的一種變體。白色邊框通常在頂部**中斷**，即使十字[不存在](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Kb4vaENAKeNfGt2XA)也是如此。

text: Small tables with “**Arrᵗ**” written on a small separate sign, are found in **Bordeaux**, despite being a city not divided into arrondissements.
text_zh: 在**波爾多**可以找到寫有「**Arrᵗ**」的小型獨立標示牌的小桌子，儘管這座城市並未劃分行政區。

text: **Montpellier** street signs will typically contain a blue **‘M’** on a white background in the top left corner.
text_zh: **蒙pellier**（蒙pellier）的街道招牌通常在左上角白底上有一個藍色的**「M」**。

text: Street signs with a red slanted [fleur-de-lis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fleur-de-lis) are unique to **Lille**.
text_zh: 帶有紅色斜向[法國百合](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fleur-de-lis)的街道招牌是**里爾**特有的。

text: In the outskirts of **Bordeaux**, you may find square traffic signposts with the [Bordeaux](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wine_red#Claret) shade of **red**, named after the wine grown in the region.
NOTE: Red posts by themselves are not unique to Bordeaux, so apply this meta with caution.
text_zh: 在**波爾庫**的郊區，你可能會發現方形交通路標柱帶有波爾庫[酒紅色](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wine_red#Claret)的**紅色**，這是以該地區出產的葡萄酒命名的。
注意：紅色郵筒或桿子本身並非波爾多獨有，因此套用這個 meta 時請謹慎。

text: On the French Riviera (Côte d'Azur in French, literally translated as **Blue Coast**), you can find regular traffic signposts painted azure blue. Uniquely, [Cagnes-sur-mer](https://maps.app.goo.gl/sP2LGFRxb79XRWro6), west of Nice, will feature lighter, powder blue infrastructure.
NOTE: Blue infrastructure can be found to a lesser extent all across France, particularly [Brittany](https://maps.app.goo.gl/6GwpcWAD5gS5LCE7A), so consider the landscape as well.
text_zh: 在法國蔚藍海岸（法文為 Côte d'Azur，字面意思是**藍色海岸**），你可以找到漆成天藍色的常規交通標誌桿。特別的是，尼斯以西的[卡agnes-sur-mer](https://maps.app.goo.gl/sP2LGFRxb79XRWro6)擁有較淺的粉藍色基礎設施。
注意：全法國各地都能在一定程度上找到藍色的基礎設施，特別是在[布列塔尼](https://maps.app.goo.gl/6GwpcWAD5gS5LCE7A)，因此也要把周遭景觀納入考量。

text: If you see a **blue** or **green** street sign shaped like an **arrow**, attached to a utility pole or street light, you are likely to be in the county of Szabolcs-Szatmár-Bereg.

NOTE: Blue arrow-shaped street signs can also be found in [Dunakeszi](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.6290186,19.1549932,3a,29.7y,151.87h,90.55t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1se_1iRMK0jnxi0R13E9x-8A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192), north of Budapest. However, those are attached to blue sign posts.
text_zh: 如果你看到形狀像**箭頭**的**藍色**或**綠色**路標，固定在電線桿或路燈上，你很可能位於索博爾奇-薩特馬爾-貝雷格州。
注意：藍色箭頭形狀的路標也可以在布達佩斯以北的[鄧納凱施](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.6290186,19.1549932,3a,29.7y,151.87h,90.55t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1se_1iRMK0jnxi0R13E9x-8A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)找到。然而，那些是固定在藍色標誌桿上的。

text: The names of 2nd level subdivisions, named **‘Kabupaten’ **or **‘Kab’ **for short, translating to regency, can be found all over Indonesia on various signs and billboards. Each province is split up into multiple Kabupatens, totalling to 417 which are covered by street view, and therefore applicable in Geoguessr. These are learnable with enough time and patience.
_See the resources section for more information._
text_zh: 第二級行政區的名稱（簡稱為**「Kabupaten」**或**「Kab」**，意為縣）可以在印尼各地的各種標誌和告示牌上找到。每個省份都被劃分為多個縣，街景涵蓋範圍總計有 417 個，因此可用於 GeoGuessr 中。只要給予足夠的時間和耐心，這些都是可以學會的。
_請參閱資源章節以獲取更多資訊。_

text: While kabupaten names appear significantly more often, a number of [signs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UgV2DtQbn4qVDL9t5) also display the **postal code**. Postal codes are five digits long and grouped by their starting digit, ranging from 1xxxx in Jakarta to 9xxxx in Maluku and Papua.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 雖然縣名出現的頻率顯著高得多，但許多[招牌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UgV2DtQbn4qVDL9t5)也顯示了**郵遞區號**。郵遞區號為五位數，按其起始數字分組，從雅加達的 1xxxx 到馬魯古和巴布亞的 9xxxx。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Indonesia is religiously a **Muslim **majority country, so seeing churches, and other Christian signs, is a good clue for these regions.
text_zh: 印尼在宗教上是**穆斯林**占多數的國家，因此看到教堂和其他基督教標誌，是辨識這些地區的好線索。

text: You can often find this **yellow warning sign** on poles.
text_zh: 你經常可以在電線桿上找到這個**黃色警告標誌**。

text: Italian is the most spoken language in Italy. It uses many double consonants, and typically has a very large number of i’s. You can also find ì, é and à. Most words will end with a vowel.
NOTE: The Italian word for street is ‘via’, and can be found on most street signs.
text_zh: 義大利語是義大利最常說的語言。它使用許多雙輔音，通常有非常大量的字母 i。你也可以找到 ì、é 和 à。大多數單字會以母音結尾。
注意：義大利語的街道是「via」，可以在大多數路標上找到。

text: It is very common for the back of Italian road signs to be **black**, or dark grey.
text_zh: 義大利路標背面為**黑色**或深灰色非常普遍。

text: Directional signs are **blue** with a **white arrow**. All letters on these signs will be **capitalised**.
text_zh: 指示標誌為**藍色**，帶有**白色箭頭**。這些標誌上的所有字母都將是**大寫**的。

text: Directional signs in national roads (Strada Statale) are **blue** with a **white and blue border**.
Divided highways (Autostrade) have **green** signs with a **white and green border**.
text_zh: 國家公路（Strada Statale）上的指示標誌為**藍色**，帶有**白藍相間邊框**。
高速公路（Autostrade）有**綠色**標誌，帶有**白綠相間邊框**。

text: Street signs are typically white with a thin **blue border** and **black text**.
text_zh: 街道標誌通常是白色，帶有細**藍色邊框**和**黑色文字**。

text: Italian pedestrian signs have **five stripes** and a basic person without a belt.
text_zh: 義大利行人標誌有**五條條紋**和一個沒有腰帶的基本人形。

text: These signs, featuring a “no parking”-sign with the text “**passo carrabile**” are commonly found in urban areas. At the top of these signs you will typically find the municipality (comune) name.
text_zh: 這些標誌帶有「禁止停車」標誌以及「**passo carrabile**」字樣，常見於市區。這些標誌的最上方通常會標示市鎮（comune）的名稱。

text: The region of South Tyrol has a German majority, and as such uses **German bilingual signs**.
text_zh: 南提洛（South Tyrol）大區擁有德國人多數人口，因此使用**德語雙語標誌**。

text: **French** can be seen on signs in the Aosta Valley. Most notably, street signs often use both the Italian word “via” and the French word “rue”.
text_zh: **法語**可以在瓦萊達奧斯塔（Aosta Valley）的標誌上看到。最顯著的是，街道標誌通常同時使用義大利語單字「via」和法語單字「rue」。

text: Close to the Slovenian border you can find **Slovene bilingual signs**.
text_zh: 靠近斯洛維尼亞邊境，你可以找到**斯洛維尼亞語雙語標誌**。

text: A lot of Kazakh infrastructure, from pedestrian signs, poles, houses, to bollards, is very similar to what you see in Russia.
text_zh: 哈薩克的許多基礎設施，從行人標誌、電線桿、房屋到路樁，都與你在俄羅斯看到的非常相似。

text: Directional signs are **green **with a white border and text. They often display road numbers in white or [yellow](https://goo.gl/maps/DqEYtasj9mwbfE3G7).
text_zh: 方向指標是**綠色**的，帶有白色的邊框和文字。它們通常以白色或[黃色](https://goo.gl/maps/DqEYtasj9mwbfE3G7)顯示道路編號。

text: While infrequent, road signs in Kenya will mostly be **red and white**.
text_zh: 雖然不常見，但肯亞的路標大多是**紅白相間**的。

text: Upon closer inspection of signs, billboards and posters, you will notice that the **county name** is often written. Therefore, knowledge of Kenyan counties can be extremely useful in region guessing.
_You can practise Kenyan counties using the quiz in the resource section._
text_zh: 仔細檢查路標、大型看板和海報時，你會發現通常會寫上**郡名**。因此，熟悉肯亞的郡對於猜測區域非常有用。
_你可以使用資源區中的測驗來練習肯亞的郡。_

text: Post codes in Kenya can be identified by [signs in the format PO BOX XXX-YYYZZ](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zkoZ8sYzmTGiRivA6), where the number YYY (usually 3 digits but sometimes 0) corresponds to a post code. This is the number which can be used to narrow down your guess. Often, the name of the city is listed after the PO BOX.
NOTE: You can sometimes see [PO BOX without the second number](https://maps.app.goo.gl/sNta3QHeJpwVVgoDA) after the hyphen which is not helpful.

_You can click on the image to enlarge it. Here is a _[quiz](https://www.super-duper.fr/quiz2024/areacodes.php?country=POST_KE&language=en&tile=gmaps&border=thin&difficulty=false&timer=false&gmaplng=en)_ to help practice Kenyan post codes_
text_zh: 肯亞的郵遞區號可透過[格式為 PO BOX XXX-YYYZZ 的標示](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zkoZ8sYzmTGiRivA6)來辨識，其中數字 YYY（通常為 3 位數，但有時為 0）對應到郵遞區號。這個數字可用來縮小你的猜測範圍。通常 PO BOX 後面會列出城市名稱。
注意：有時候你會看到連字號後面[沒有第二個數字的 PO BOX](https://maps.app.goo.gl/sNta3QHeJpwVVgoDA)，這對判斷沒有幫助。
_你可以點擊圖片將其放大。這裡有一個_[測驗](https://www.super-duper.fr/quiz2024/areacodes.php?country=POST_KE&language=en&tile=gmaps&border=thin&difficulty=false&timer=false&gmaplng=en)_可協助練習肯亞郵遞區號_

text: Mongolian infrastructure has clear Russian influence. Wooden poles with supporting stone blocks, [white lamp posts](https://www.google.com/maps/@46.677839,113.270184,3a,64.1y,330.3h,92.79t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sAv0lfNtDl5QLj3rxCnkYzA!2e0), and [three-striped** **pedestrian crossing signs](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.2393538,106.2025013,2a,60y,95.51h,75.52t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sXUNd4wtT71dkoiStvdsI-Q!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) are common to see.

Unique to Mongolia is the** **[**“ЗОГС”**](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.2286946,106.2131419,2a,15y,73.91h,86.02t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sDbSJ2KjqHFeQw_Vx-Muhyg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)** stop sign**.
NOTE: Each town has unique lamp post designs, so learning them can be quite useful.
text_zh: 蒙古的基礎設施有明顯的俄羅斯影響。帶有支撐石塊的木製電線桿、[白色路燈](https://www.google.com/maps/@46.677839,113.270184,3a,64.1y,330.3h,92.79t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sAv0lfNtDl5QLj3rxCnkYzA!2e0)以及[三條紋**行人穿越道標誌**](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.2393538,106.2025013,2a,60y,95.51h,75.52t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sXUNd4wtT71dkoiStvdsI-Q!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)都很常見。
蒙古特有的是[**「ЗОГС」**](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.2286946,106.2131419,2a,15y,73.91h,86.02t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sDbSJ2KjqHFeQw_Vx-Muhyg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)**停車標誌**。
註：每個城鎮都有獨特的路燈設計，因此學習這些設計會非常有用。

text: Some road markers (“**hectometre markers**”) have province-specific designs. This only applies to markers for regional N-roads, which have road numbers in yellow boxes.
Not all N-road markers have province-specific designs: some just have a generic design that can be found nationwide.
The A-roads all have the same signs and are recognizable because the road number is in a red box.
Bollards sometimes feature **kilometre stickers**, which are also limited to specific regions.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it. Image provided by Timzkii._
text_zh: 有些道路里程標示（「**百公尺標示**」）具有省份專屬的設計。這僅適用於 N 系列區域道路的標示，其道路編號位於黃色方框中。
並非所有的 N 系列道路標示都有省份專屬的設計：有些只是全國通用的通用設計。
A 系列道路的標誌全都相同，並且因為道路編號位於紅色方框中而易於辨認。
路樁有時會有**公里貼紙**，這也僅限於特定地區。
_你可以點擊圖片來放大。圖片由 Timzkii 提供。_

text: Direction signs in North Macedonia are typically **yellow **with** biscriptal text**: town names are written in both Latin and Cyrillic script.
NOTE: Serbia, Slovenia, Croatia, and Montenegro have similar signs. Serbia is the only one that will have biscriptal text though.
text_zh: 北馬其頓的指示標誌通常是**黃色**且帶有**雙文字系統**：城鎮名稱同時以拉丁字母和斯拉夫字母（西里爾字母）書寫。
備註：塞爾維亞、斯洛維尼亞、克羅埃西亞和蒙特內哥羅都有類似的標誌。不過，塞爾維亞是唯一會使用雙文字系統的國家。

text: Macedonian is a Slavic language which uses the **Cyrillic** script. Road signs have Latin on them too, although most other signs are fully in Cyrillic.
The letters ‘**Ѓ**’ and ‘**Ќ**’ are unique to Macedonian. ‘Љ’, ‘Њ’, and ‘Џ’ are only in Serbian and Macedonian.
text_zh: 馬其頓語是一種使用**西里爾字母**的斯拉夫語言。道路標誌上也有拉丁字母，不過大多數其他標誌完全使用西里爾字母。
字母「**Ѓ**」和「**Ќ**」是馬其頓語所獨有的。「Љ」、「Њ」和「Џ」則僅見於塞爾維亞語和馬其頓語中。

text: North Macedonia normally uses **yellow-filled** **in warning signs**. Most of Europe uses white ones.
NOTE: In southeastern Europe, Greece also commonly uses yellow-filled in signs. Slovenia sometimes has yellow-filled signs.
text_zh: 北馬其頓的**警告標誌**通常使用**黃底**。大多數歐洲國家使用白底。
備註：在東南歐，希臘也常在標誌中使用黃底。斯洛維尼亞偶爾也有黃底標誌。

text: Panama uses the Spanish word “**ALTO**” on stop signs.

NOTE: [Mexico](https://goo.gl/maps/f1zLdwAo5VhYDhtC7), [Costa Rica](https://maps.app.goo.gl/K6pZqyNn2Hw52GXJ7) and [Guatemala](https://www.google.com/maps/@14.6255005,-90.5568668,3a,15y,74.14h,81.77t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1smSi97ivNOrtG5_baoEx9YQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) also use “ALTO”, but the font is thinner.
text_zh: 巴拿馬在停止標誌上使用西班牙語單字「**ALTO**」。

注意：[墨西哥](https://goo.gl/maps/f1zLdwAo5VhYDhtC7)、[哥斯大黎加](https://maps.app.goo.gl/K6pZqyNn2Hw52GXJ7)與[瓜地馬拉](https://www.google.com/maps/@14.6255005,-90.5568668,3a,15y,74.14h,81.77t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1smSi97ivNOrtG5_baoEx9YQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)也使用「ALTO」，但字型較細。

text: Red octagonal signs with an oddly **realistic eye** are unique to Panama.
text_zh: 印有異常**逼真眼睛**的紅色八角形標誌是巴拿馬特有的。

text: Being a French Department, you will see **French infrastructure**, such as [signs](https://goo.gl/maps/g4Zs8JkqkiWbQYt28), [bollards](https://www.google.com/maps/@-21.2427103,55.3131219,3a,75y,99.88h,80.84t,358.51r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sfAEf2UYNe56no-OLI1RWoA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) and [poles](https://www.google.com/maps/@-21.281482,55.4317286,3a,90y,19.99h,96.64t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sm6b5qi8oScL85YCcGo5E_g!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).
text_zh: 身為法國的省份，你會看到**法國的基礎設施**，例如[標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/g4Zs8JkqkiWbQYt28)、[路樁](https://www.google.com/maps/@-21.2427103,55.3131219,3a,75y,99.88h,80.84t,358.51r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sfAEf2UYNe56no-OLI1RWoA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)與[電線桿](https://www.google.com/maps/@-21.281482,55.4317286,3a,90y,19.99h,96.64t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sm6b5qi8oScL85YCcGo5E_g!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)。

text: Signposts in Russia often have **black painted bottoms**.
NOTE: This is also common in Kazakhstan.
text_zh: 俄羅斯的指路標誌通常有著**漆成黑色的底部**。
注意：這在哈薩克也很常見。

text: This **black traffic sign bottom** is primarily found in Stavropol and Chechnya, as well as western Dagestan. Rarely, exceptions can be found in other southern federal subjects such as [Kabardino Balkaria](https://goo.gl/maps/XeKf78CHzYCEtTQX8), but these will typically be uncolored.
text_zh: 這種**黑色交通標誌底部**主要見於斯塔夫羅波爾與車臣，以及達吉斯坦西部。極少數情況下，其他南方聯邦主體（如[卡巴爾達-巴爾卡爾](https://goo.gl/maps/XeKf78CHzYCEtTQX8)）也能找到例外，但這些通常是沒有顏色的。

text: **Clips** on edges of signposts are found in Leningrad and St. Petersburg, and very rarely in Pskov, Novgorod or elsewhere.
text_zh: 標誌牌邊緣的**夾子**常見於列寧格勒與聖彼得堡，在普斯科夫、諾夫哥羅德或其他地方則非常罕見。

text: Some republics of Russia with minority languages use bilingual town entry and directional signs, such as in Bashkortostan and Tatarstan displaying Bashkir and Tatar respectively.
text_zh: 一些擁有少數族群語言的俄羅斯共和國會使用雙語的城鎮入口與方向標誌，例如巴什科爾托斯坦和韃靼斯坦分別顯示巴什基爾語和韃靼語。

text: These **brown signs**, pointing to typical tourist attractions, are common in Moscow Oblast and the oblasts bordering it. However, they can also less commonly be seen in city centres or near tourist attractions of [other regions](https://www.google.com/maps/@61.821949,34.3074923,3a,17.8y,22.25h,94.58t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1stZhKu0HYudsYXdctQ9_AyQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu).
text_zh: 這些指向典型觀光景點的**棕色標誌**，在莫斯科州及與其接壤的州很常見。然而，在[其他地區](https://www.google.com/maps/@61.821949,34.3074923,3a,17.8y,22.25h,94.58t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1stZhKu0HYudsYXdctQ9_AyQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)的市中心或觀光景點附近也較少見到它們。

text: Pedestrian signs with a **U-shaped hook** attached to a pole are unique to Chelyabinsk.
text_zh: 附有連接到電線桿的**U型鉤**的行人標誌是車里雅賓斯克特有的。

text: Road signs and bollards are **generally identical** to the ones used in Italy.
NOTE: Many road signs give directions to the nearby Italian city of **Rimini**.
text_zh: 道路標誌與路樁**大致與**義大利使用的相同。
注意：許多道路標誌會指引通往鄰近的義大利城市**里米尼**。

text: Being a former French colony, Senegal uses French infrastructure such as **bollards**, **poles**, **signs** and **road** **lines**.
text_zh: 作為前法國殖民地，塞內加爾使用法國的基礎設施，例如**路樁**、**電線桿**、**標誌**與**道路** **標線**。

text: **Bilingual signs** with Serbian alongside Hungarian can be seen in northern Vojvodina, where there is a Hungarian majority.
text_zh: 在匈牙利族人口佔多數的北部伏伊伏丁那，可以看到並列塞爾維亞語與匈牙利語的**雙語標誌**。

text: Street signs will be blue, **arrow-shaped** and commonly **hanging** from a metal bar mounted to utility poles.
text_zh: 街道標誌將是藍色、**箭頭形狀**，並且通常**懸掛**在安裝在電線桿上的金屬桿上。

text: These **small yellow signs** advertising tree felling are commonly found on utility poles and lamp posts in the suburbs of Stockholm. While the phone code for Stockholm is usually written on the signs, it is often difficult to make out [from a distance](https://maps.app.goo.gl/vu1DKvwVwfjsGnEd9).
text_zh: 這些宣傳砍樹的**小型黃色標誌**常見於斯德哥爾摩郊區的電線桿和燈柱上。雖然斯德哥爾摩的電話區號通常寫在標誌上，但[從遠處](https://maps.app.goo.gl/vu1DKvwVwfjsGnEd9)往往很難看清。

text: On top of the language, the Portuguese influence can also be seen in infrastructure, such as ladder poles and pedestrian signs with the same design as in Portugal.
text_zh: 除了語言之外，葡萄牙的影響也能在基礎設施中看到，例如與葡萄牙相同設計的階梯電線桿和行人標誌。

text: Street signs in Bursa are **green**, and generally have slightly **extruded letters**, meaning the signs are not completely flat.
NOTE: Several other types of infrastructure in Bursa, such as [fences](https://goo.gl/maps/EHzDyAUKLCQySbyB7) and [guardrails](https://goo.gl/maps/nF72j1rxibsT8weR8), may also be coloured green.
text_zh: 布爾薩的街道標誌為 **綠色**，且通常帶有微幅 **凸出的字體**，這意味著標誌並非完全平坦。
註：布爾薩的其他幾種基礎設施（例如[圍欄](https://goo.gl/maps/EHzDyAUKLCQySbyB7)與[護欄](https://goo.gl/maps/nF72j1rxibsT8weR8)）也可能漆成綠色。

text: Pedestrian crossing signs are almost non-existent in the UK. Instead, pedestrian crossings will often have these distinctive **black and white striped poles**, with a yellow light bulb on top.
NOTE: These signposts are also common in Ireland.
text_zh: 英國幾乎不存在行人穿越道標誌。取而代之的是，行人穿越道通常會有這些獨特的**黑白相間電線桿**，頂部帶有一個黃色燈泡。
注意：這些路標在愛爾蘭也很常見。

text: The majority of poles and signposts in Birmingham have either **yellow tape** or yellow paint wrapped around them. Lampposts will also usually have this yellow sticker.
text_zh: 伯明罕多數的電線桿和標誌桿上都纏繞著**黃色膠帶**或塗有黃漆。燈桿通常也會貼有這種黃色貼紙。

text: The US uses the phrase ‘**Speed Limit**’ on their speed signs.
The numbers on American speed signs are usually lower than on Canadian ones, since they use miles instead of kilometres. In addition, speed limits ending in 5 are more common in the US.
NOTE: [Canada](https://goo.gl/maps/zVYUCX62g3ENJct2A) uses the word ‘Maximum’ on their speed signs.
text_zh: 美國在速限標誌上使用「**Speed Limit**」這個詞組。
美國速限標誌上的數字通常比加拿大的低，因為他們使用英里而不是公里。此外，以 5 結尾的速限在美國更常見。
注意：[加拿大](https://goo.gl/maps/zVYUCX62g3ENJct2A)在速限標誌上使用「Maximum」這個詞。

text: Road signs in the US tend to use **more words** compared to their Canadian counterparts. A good example are railway crossing signs, which feature the literal words ‘railroad crossing’ on them. In Canada, these signs are typically blank.

This tendency is also noticeable on [yellow diamond warning signs](https://goo.gl/maps/ySfoRRrDjUqSRSub6). In Canada, the words will usually be on a rectangular sign below the yellow diamond, which would have a diagram on it instead.
text_zh: 相較於加拿大，美國的道路標誌傾向使用**更多文字**。一個很好的例子是鐵路平交道標誌，上面直接印有「railroad crossing」字樣。而在加拿大，這些標誌通常是空白的。
這種傾向在[黃色菱形警告標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/ySfoRRrDjUqSRSub6)上也特別明顯。在加拿大，文字通常會位於黃色菱形下方的一個長方形標誌上，而菱形本身則會改用圖示。

text: The US uses **American English** spelling (e.g. center, color).

In addition, the US primarily uses the [imperial system](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Imperial_units) for measurements. For example, speed and distance are measured in **miles**. You will also often see feet and inches on signs, indicating the height of bridges.

NOTE: This is useful to distinguish between the English-speaking parts of Canada, where British English spelling and (usually) the [metric system](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metric_system) are used. For example, Canada measures speed in kilometres.
text_zh: 美國使用**美式英語**拼寫（例如 center、color）。
此外，美國主要使用[英制單位](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Imperial_units)來進行測量。例如，速度和距離都是以**英里**來計算。你也會經常在標誌上看到用來標示橋樑高度的英尺和英寸。
注意：這有助於區分英語系的加拿大地區，因為當地使用英式拼法，且（通常）使用[公制系統](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metric_system)。例如，加拿大是以公里來測量速度。

text: **Triangular yellow signs** with the phrase ‘No Passing Zone’ are exclusive to the US.
text_zh: 印有「No Passing Zone」字樣的**三角形黃色標誌**是美國獨有的。

text: These rectangular **junction signs** with a single or double arrow are found in the US.

NOTE: [Canada](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.7445702,-84.128801,3a,19.9y,168.72h,80.95t,1.15r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1se1gQJA3H13DWO2lWqmbwAg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu) uses diamond-shaped junction signs.
text_zh: 這些帶有單箭頭或雙箭頭的長方形**路口標誌**常見於美國。
注意：[加拿大](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.7445702,-84.128801,3a,19.9y,168.72h,80.95t,1.15r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1se1gQJA3H13DWO2lWqmbwAg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)使用的是菱形分流標誌。

text: American **yield signs** are shaped like an upside-down triangle with a red border, a white field in the middle and the word ‘YIELD’.
NOTE: [Canadian](https://goo.gl/maps/zBwtzhBVjPgtw1628) yield signs look similar, but lack the ‘YIELD’ text.
text_zh: 美國的**讓路標誌**形狀像是一個倒三角形，具有紅色邊框、中間為白色底色，並印有「YIELD」字樣。
注意：[加拿大](https://goo.gl/maps/zBwtzhBVjPgtw1628)的讓路標誌看起來很相似，但缺少「YIELD」文字。

text: American one-way signs are usually a **horizontal black rectangle** with a **white arrow** inside of it. These signs will also always have the words ‘ONE WAY’ printed on them. In cities, they are a white vertical rectangle with the words ‘ONE WAY’ on them and an arrow underneath.
NOTE: [Canadian](https://goo.gl/maps/f9n6jHbEQJFrNY5e6) one-way signs are of the same shape and colour, but might not have the words ‘ONE WAY’ on them.
text_zh: 美國的單行道標誌通常是**橫向黑色長方形**，內部含有**白色箭頭**。這些標誌也一定會印有「ONE WAY」字樣。在城市中，它們則是印有「ONE WAY」字樣且下方帶有箭頭的白色直向長方形。
注意：[加拿大](https://goo.gl/maps/f9n6jHbEQJFrNY5e6)的單行道標誌形狀和顏色相同，但可能沒有印上「ONE WAY」字樣。

text: Large highways in the US use large, rectangular, **green metal signs** with curved edges and white text to mark highway exits, distances to nearby towns, and the names of upcoming roads (mainly in cities).
NOTE: [Canadian](https://goo.gl/maps/JBuxw1mVSSq1cRy37) highway signs have a similar appearance, but will typically have squared instead of curved edges.
text_zh: 美國的大型高速公路使用大型、長方形、邊緣帶有弧度且配有白字的**綠色金屬標誌**，來標示高速公路出口、附近城鎮的距離，以及前方道路的名稱（主要在城市中）。
注意：[加拿大](https://goo.gl/maps/JBuxw1mVSSq1cRy37)的高速公路標誌外觀相似，但通常是直角邊緣而非圓弧邊緣。

text: Leading up to exits on large highways, you commonly see large, **blue rectangular signs** with white text, highlighting services, such as food, lodging and petrol, that are available at the upcoming highway exit.
NOTE: Canada uses [similar signs](https://goo.gl/maps/14FARb11GKUu4sBG6) on some of their highways.
text_zh: 在接近大型高速公路出口時，你經常會看到大型的**藍色長方形標誌**搭配白字，用來標示前方高速公路出口處提供的服務，例如餐飲、住宿和汽油。
注意：加拿大在其部分高速公路上使用[類似的標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/14FARb11GKUu4sBG6)。

text: **Parking indicator signs** in the US are typically white metal signs with red, green, or black text. They may include specific information about when you can park on said road, and arrows indicating where parking is (or is not) allowed.
NOTE: [Canadian](https://goo.gl/maps/WWt6d3SRhG4B61Q19) parking signs use similar styles and colours, but typically are less ‘wordy,’ instead using more symbols when applicable.
text_zh: 美國的**停車指示標誌**通常是印有紅、綠或黑字的白色金屬標誌。它們可能會包含關於何時能在該道路停車的具體資訊，以及指示哪裡可以（或不可以）停車的箭頭。
注意：[加拿大](https://goo.gl/maps/WWt6d3SRhG4B61Q19)的停車標誌使用類似的風格和顏色，但通常「字比較少」，在適用的情況下會使用更多符號代替。

text: Thin metal signposts are common. They will typically either have several small holes or have a [U-profile](/images/united-states/u-profile.jpg?).
text_zh: 細金屬路標很常見。它們通常要麼有幾個小孔，要麼具有 [U 型斷面](/images/united-states/u-profile.jpg?)。

text: Most states have unique, distinct and learnable [Adopt-a-Highway](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adopt-a-Highway) signs, which can be seen on the side of roads. A map of those can be seen here. Keep in mind, some states have slight variations in design.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 大多數州都有獨特、鮮明且易於學習的[認養公路](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adopt-a-Highway)標誌，這些標誌可以在道路旁看到。可以在這裡查看這些標誌的地圖。請記住，有些州的設計有些許差異。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: **Blue and yellow** shields are used for county roads, and can be seen in certain states in the US. Keep in mind, unique designs can be found in some counties in certain states. For more information, see [here](https://geohints.com/countries/us/signs/countyRoads).
text_zh: **藍色和黃色**的盾牌用於郡道，可以在美國的特定州看到。請記住，某些州的特定郡中可以找到獨特的設計。欲了解更多資訊，請參閱[此處](https://geohints.com/countries/us/signs/countyRoads)。

text: Guardrails, signs, and signposts are commonly painted a **medium brown colour** in US National Parks, which are often located in the west. Guardrails that are painted brown can be made out of both [wood](https://goo.gl/maps/syWa2BkK99zBRmzv5) and metal. [Rock walls](https://goo.gl/maps/bU1rFbRpVUP1LzRD7) can also sometimes be seen in place of guardrails.
[Here](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_national_parks_of_the_United_States#/map/0) you can find a map showing where all US National Parks are located.
NOTE: There are occasional exceptions to this rule, so consider other clues before guessing in a National Park.
text_zh: 在美國國家公園中，護欄、標誌和路標通常漆成**中棕色**，而這些國家公園大多位於西部。漆成棕色的護欄可以由[木頭](https://goo.gl/maps/syWa2BkK99zBRmzv5)和金屬製成。有時也能看到[石牆](https://goo.gl/maps/bU1rFbRpVUP1LzRD7)代替護欄。
[這裡](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_national_parks_of_the_United_States#/map/0)可以找到顯示所有美國國家公園位置的地圖。
注意：這項規則偶爾會有例外，因此在國家公園內盲猜之前，請先考慮其他線索。

text: Maine, New Hampshire, and Massachusetts use **small green and red rectangular signs** to mark the ends of bridges and guardrails.
NOTE: Not all bridges and guardrails in these states will have these markers.
text_zh: 緬因州、新罕布夏州和麻薩諸塞州使用**小型綠紅相間的長方形標誌**來標示橋樑和護欄的端點。
注意：這些州並非所有橋樑和護欄都有這些標示。

text: In Minnesota, these yellow signs with **vertical, black triangles** are placed before bridges at most major river crossings and at the beginnings and ends of guardrail sections on large highways.
text_zh: 在明尼蘇達州，這些帶有**垂直黑色三角形**的黃色標誌放置在多數主要河流交叉口的橋樑前，以及大型公路護欄區段的起點和終點。

text: Wisconsin and Missouri are the only two states that use a **lettering system** (A - ZZZ) for their county highways. Wisconsin signs typically have the word ‘county’ above the letter, while Missouri signs typically do not. The borders of the signs also vary slightly.
text_zh: 威斯康辛州和密蘇里州是僅有的兩個在其郡道使用**字母系統**（A - ZZZ）的州。威斯康辛州的標誌通常在字母上方有「county」一詞，而密蘇里州的標誌通常沒有。標誌的邊框也略有不同。

text: Speed signs in Oregon often simply have the word ‘**Speed**’ instead of the standard ‘Speed Limit’.
text_zh: 奧勒岡州的速限標誌通常只有「**Speed**」這個單字，而不是標準的「Speed Limit」。

text: **Yellow** or **red** bands can commonly be seen around signposts in Texas.
NOTE: Similar reflectors can sometimes be seen in other states, such as Hawaii.
text_zh: 在德州的標誌桿周圍常可以看到**黃色**或**紅色**帶狀標示。
注意：有時在其他州（例如夏威夷）也能看到類似的反光板。

text: Signs attached to **two** **signposts** can be seen in Michigan, Ohio, Minnesota, and New York. Not all signs are attached to two signposts.
NOTE: Double signposts can also be seen in other states, but are not as common.
text_zh: 在密西根州、俄亥俄州、明尼蘇達州和紐約州可以看到附著在**兩根****標誌桿**上的標誌。並非所有標誌都附著在兩根標誌桿上。
注意：雙標誌桿在其他州也能看到，但沒那麼常見。

text: West Virginia sometimes features street signs with a symbol that resembles a **fraction** inside a **circle**.
text_zh: 西維吉尼亞州的街道標誌有時會帶有一個圖案，該圖案類似**圓圈**內的**分數**。

text: North Carolina commonly uses a style of street signs showing **street numbers** and **arrows** in addition to the street name.
NOTE: Other states occasionally feature street signs with similar designs, so use other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 北卡羅萊納州常使用一種街道標誌風格，除了街道名稱外，還顯示**街道號碼**與**箭頭**。
注意：其他州偶爾也會出現類似設計的街道標誌，因此在猜測前請利用其他線索。

text: In Oklahoma, you can often find a green rectangular sign with **3 rows of numbers** attached to the back of stop signs at rural intersections.
text_zh: 在奧克拉荷馬州，你常能在鄉村交叉口的「停車」標誌背面找到綠色長方形標誌，上面有 **3 排數字**。

text: These green **ATV Route signs** are unique to Wisconsin.
text_zh: 這些綠色的 **ATV Route 標誌**是威斯康辛州特有的。

text: Rectangular **white** signs can sometimes be seen attached to signposts at intersections in Pennsylvania. On top, the number of the converging state route is written.
text_zh: 在賓州的交叉口，有時可以看到附在標誌桿上的長方形**白色**標誌。最上方寫著匯流州道的編號。

text: Rectangular **white** signs can sometimes be seen at intersections in Virginia.
text_zh: 在維吉尼亞州的交叉口，有時可以看到長方形**白色**標誌。

text: **White signs** attached to signposts can commonly be seen in North Carolina.
text_zh: 在北卡羅萊納州，常可見到附在標誌桿上的**白色標誌**。

text: New York and Vermont have **small rectangular green signs **with three rows of horizontal numbers. The top row of numbers correlates to the highway or road number the sign is on. For example, the sign in the image is on road NY-345.

Signs for Vermont will almost always start with 0 on the second row. The second row in New York will start with a number which corresponds to a district of the NYSDOT ([link)](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/c/ce/NYSDOT_regions_map.svg) which will help with narrowing a region.
text_zh: 紐約州和佛蒙特州有帶三排水平數字的**小型長方形綠色標誌**。最上面一排數字對應標誌所在的公路或道路編號。例如，圖片中的標誌位於 NY-345 道路上。
佛蒙特州的標誌第二排幾乎總是從 0 開始。紐約州的第二排將從一個數字開始，該數字對應於 NYSDOT 的一個區劃（[連結](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/c/ce/NYSDOT_regions_map.svg)），這將有助於縮小區域範圍。

text: In New Hampshire there will often be a **white metal sign** with the characters ‘**E-2**’ on it adjacent to the road, typically at either end of bridges.
text_zh: 在新罕布夏州，道路旁通常會有一個**白色金屬標誌**，上面帶有字元「**E-2**」，通常位於橋樑的兩端。

text: On some rural ‘stop’ signposts in Minnesota, a **black-and-white marker** is attached to the posts horizontally. The shape may vary slightly.
text_zh: 在明尼蘇達州的一些鄉村「停車」標誌桿上，水平附有一個**黑白標記**。形狀可能會略有不同。

text: These **white reflectors** on signposts are unique to Kansas. They are most commonly seen on ‘stop’ signs in rural areas.
text_zh: 標誌桿上的這些**白色反光板**是堪薩斯州特有的。它們最常出現在鄉村地區的「停車」標誌上。

text: Many large intersections in Michigan have stop lights and signs that **hang from wires** that stretch across the middle of the intersection. These markers are commonly in yellow boxes.
NOTE: These are not completely unique to Michigan, but are most commonly seen there.
text_zh: 密西根州許多大型交叉口都有紅綠燈和標誌，**懸掛在橫跨交叉口中段的電線上**。這些標記通常在黃色方框中。
注意：這並非密西根州獨有，但在那裡最常看到。

text: Interstate 19 in Arizona from Tucson to the Mexico border uses **kilometres** on the exit and distance signs. This is the only part of the country that uses kilometres instead of miles for highway signs.
NOTE: Speed limit signs in this area still use MPH instead of KPH.
text_zh: 亞利桑那州從土遜（Tucson）到墨西哥邊境的 19 州際公路（Interstate 19），其出口與距離標示使用的是 **公里**。這是全美唯一在高速公路標誌上使用公里而非英裡的地區。
注意：該地區的速限標誌仍然使用 MPH（英裡/小時）而非 KPH（公里/小時）。

text: Pedestrian signs** **have **8 stripes**.
NOTE: Spain is the only other European country that has pedestrian signs with 8 stripes.
text_zh: 行人標誌** **有 **8 條條紋**。
注意：西班牙是歐洲唯一另一個行人標誌有 8 條條紋的國家。

text: The tripod at the **south pole** can be recognized by numerous countries’ flags around the tripod, and a sign with ‘Geographic South Pole’ written on it.
This location is often on community-made world maps for a better scoring range.
text_zh: **南極點** 的三腳架街景，可以透過周圍許多國家的國旗，以及寫有「Geographic South Pole」字樣的標誌來辨識。
這個地點經常出現在社群製作的世界地圖上，以提供更好的計分範圍。

text: T-Junctions in La Pampa sometimes have these **yellow rectangular signs**, with a chevron pattern on the bottom, and the Road Number(s) above, with an arrow on both sides.
text_zh: 拉潘帕的T字路口有時會出現這些**黃色矩形標誌**，底部帶有轉彎標誌圖案，上方是道路編號，兩側都有箭頭。

text: **Give-way signs** in Australia have a white border and black text.
NOTE: New Zealand’s give-way signs use red, instead of black, text. Give-way signs are very rarely seen in South Africa.
text_zh: 澳洲的**讓路標誌**有白色邊框和黑色文字。
注意：紐西蘭的讓路標誌使用紅色文字，而非黑色。南非則非常罕見讓路標誌。

text: **Green **signs with white arrows on either side can be seen at intersections which show nearby towns or cities. A number indicating the number of **kilometres **away the town can sometimes be seen.
text_zh: 在路口可見**綠色**標誌，兩側有白色箭頭，顯示附近的城鎮。有時可見標示城鎮距離的**公里數**。

text: Australian speed limit signs have black text in a red circle on a large white **rectangle**.
NOTE: New Zealand speed limit signs normally do not have the white rectangular background.
text_zh: 澳洲的速限標誌為黑色文字，位於紅色圓圈內，並置於大型白色**矩形**背景上。
注意：紐西蘭的速限標誌通常沒有白色矩形背景。

text: **Yellow signposts** are specific to Western Australia.
NOTE: Although South Australia does not use yellow signposts for regular road signs, SA bus stops will have yellow posts.
text_zh: **黃色標誌桿**是西澳州特有的。
備註：雖然南澳州的一般道路標誌不使用黃色標誌桿，但南澳州的公車站牌會使用黃色桿子。

text: Some signposts in South Australia and Western Australia are **flat **rather than round.
NOTE: These signposts are usually yellow in Western Australia.
text_zh: 南澳州與西澳州的部分標誌桿是**扁平的 **，而不是圓形的。
備註：這些標誌桿在西澳州通常是黃色的。

text: Signposts in the Northern Territory can feature these **yellow **stickers.
text_zh: 北領地的標誌桿上可能會有這些**黃色 **貼紙。

text: Road signs with a **fluorescent border** are almost exclusively found in Queensland.
text_zh: 帶有**螢光邊框**的道路標誌幾乎只出現在昆士蘭州。

text: New South Wales is the only state to use **red ‘No Stopping’ signs**.
NOTE: All other states use white versions.
text_zh: 新南威爾斯州是唯一使用**紅色的 ‘No Stopping’ 標誌**的州。
備註：其他所有的州都使用白色版本。

text: The white ‘No Stopping’ and ‘No Parking’ signs that** include text** are unique to the Australian Capital Territory.
text_zh: **包含文字 **的白色 ‘No Stopping’ 與 ‘No Parking’ 標誌是澳洲首都領地特有的。

text: **White **directional signs can only be found in Tasmania.
text_zh: **白色 **的方向指示標誌僅見於塔斯馬尼亞。

text: Some ‘Keep Left’ signs in New South Wales, Queensland, and the Northern Territory use this thinner version, which does **not **include an arrow.
text_zh: 新南威爾斯州、昆士蘭州和北領地的部分 ‘Keep Left’ 標誌使用這種較薄的版本，其中**不 **包含箭頭。

text: This street sign is unique to **Brisbane **City Council.
text_zh: 這種路牌是**布里斯本 **市議會特有的。

text: This street sign is unique to **Gold Coast** City Council.
text_zh: 這種路牌是**黃金海岸**市議會特有的。

text: This street sign is unique to the City of **Sydney**.
text_zh: 這種路牌是**雪梨**市特有的。

text: **Green** “[Güterweg](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/G%C3%BCterweg)” signs are found in Burgenland.
text_zh: 布根蘭州可見**綠色**的“[Güterweg](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/G%C3%BCterweg)”標誌。

text: **White** “Güterweg” signs with a **black outline** are mainly found in Upper Austria.
text_zh: 帶有**黑色外框**的**白色**「Güterweg」標誌主要見於上奧地利州。

text: In Lower Austria, you may find signs with **yellow and blue sign borders**, corresponding to the [flag of the region](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/b/b1/Flag_of_Lower_Austria_%28state%29.svg/2560px-Flag_of_Lower_Austria_%28state%29.svg.png).
text_zh: 在下奧地利州，你可能會看到帶有**黃藍相間標誌邊框**的標誌，這對應了[該地區的旗幟](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/b/b1/Flag_of_Lower_Austria_%28state%29.svg/2560px-Flag_of_Lower_Austria_%28state%29.svg.png)。

text: **Vienna street signs** are extremely recognizable dark blue plaques with a traditional-looking white serif font. The number at the start will indicate which district you are in (see the map).
_You can click the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: **維也納的路牌**極具辨識度，為深藍色牌子，印有傳統風格的白色襯線字體。開頭的數字標示你所在的區（參見地圖）。
_你可以點擊圖片放大。_

text: Most other major cities in Austria also have their own **unique street signs**.
NOTE: Many of the arbitrary blue ones can look similar, but the 4 listed in the graphic can be differentiated by:
- Vienna - District Number
- Salzburg - Unique Font
- Klagenfurt - Irregular White Border
- St Polten - Rounded White Border
_You can click the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 奧地利大多數其他主要城市也有其**獨特的路牌**。
註：許多隨處可見的藍色路牌看起來很像，但圖表中列出的 4 個可以透過以下方式區分：
- 維也納 - 區號
- 薩爾斯堡 - 獨特字體
- 克拉根福 - 不規則白色邊框
- 聖帕爾滕 - 圓角白色邊框
_你可以點擊圖片放大。_

text: Street signs in the Azores are almost exclusively painted ceramic tiles, with blue letters and, typically, a decorative pattern around the edge.
text_zh: 亞速群島的路牌幾乎清一色是彩繪磁磚，帶有藍字，邊緣通常有裝飾花紋。

text: Signposts on the Azores are often striped.
NOTE: These are also seen on Madeira.
text_zh: 亞速群島上的標誌桿通常帶有條紋。
註：這些在馬德拉也能看到。

text: Signposts in Bangladesh often have **black-and-white stripes**.
NOTE: Within Asia, these posts are also found in Sri Lanka, Bhutan, India, Nepal and Malaysia. Make sure to check other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 孟加拉的標誌桿經常有**黑白相間條紋**。
註：在亞洲境內，斯里蘭卡、不丹、印度、尼泊爾和馬來西亞也能找到這種桿子。在選擇地點之前，請務必確認其他線索。

text: Signs will be in Belarusian or Russian. Both languages use the Cyrillic alphabet.
NOTE: The letters ў and і are not found in Russian.
text_zh: 指示牌會使用白俄羅斯語或俄語。兩種語言都使用西里爾字母。
備註：字母 ў 和 і 在俄語中看不到。

text: The Minsk centre street signs are **sea-green**, and can be seen almost everywhere.
NOTE: If you are close enough to the sign, you can make out the Cyrillic letters “вул (vul)”, the Belarusian name for “street”.
text_zh: 明斯克市中心的路牌是**海藍綠色**，幾乎隨處可見。
備註：如果你足夠靠近路牌，可以辨認出西里爾字母「вул (vul)」，這是白俄羅斯語中「街」的意思。

text: Directional signs in Belgium are most often blue or [white](https://goo.gl/maps/xWnWdzWmbcPDPTE4A).
text_zh: 比利時的方向路牌最常是藍色或[白色](https://goo.gl/maps/xWnWdzWmbcPDPTE4A)。

text: Road signs often have an additional **small blue sign**. In other European countries, these small signs are usually just white.
text_zh: 道路標誌通常帶有一個額外的**藍色小標誌**。在其他歐洲國家，這些小標誌通常只是白色的。

text: Belgium uses pedestrian crossing signs without any stripes, but with **two horizontal dotted lines**. The man on the sign has a **square head**.
NOTE: France and the Netherlands use a pedestrian sign with a regular zebra crossing with five vertical stripes.
text_zh: 比利時使用的行人穿越道標誌沒有斑馬線圖案，而是帶有**兩條水平虛線**。標誌上的人有一個**方頭**。
備註：法國和荷蘭使用帶有普通斑馬線（五條垂直條紋）的行人標誌。

text: Signposts in Belgium are often **orange**. The backs of signs are also sometimes orange. This is unique to Belgium.
text_zh: 比利時的路牌柱通常是**橘色**的。標誌背面有時也是橘色的。這是比利時獨有的。

text: Street name signs in Belgium are very diverse, and often unique to a city. Most common colours are **white **and **dark** **blue**. They often have the** town or city name** written on them.
NOTE: These signs often have variable designs, but most of them are fairly short and tall. In comparison, Dutch street signs are almost always much longer than they are tall.
text_zh: 比利時的街名牌非常多樣化，且通常為某個城市所獨有。最常見的顏色是**白色**和**深** **藍色**。它們上面通常寫有**城鎮或城市名稱**。
備註：這些標誌的設計往往不盡相同，但大多數都相當短而高。相比之下，荷蘭的路牌幾乎總是寬度遠大於高度。

text: **Town entry signs** in Belgium are white with a black border. They also mention the name of the city or municipality in bold, black text.
text_zh: 比利時的**城鎮入口標誌**為白底黑邊。它們還會以黑色粗體字註明城市或市鎮的名稱。

text: Priority signs in Belgium have an **orange **diamond and are much **smaller **than in other countries.
text_zh: 比利時的幹線優先標誌有一個**橘色**菱形，且比其他國家**小得多**。

text: Bus stops are always marked by **yellow signposts**. Bus shelters often have **yellow roofs**.
text_zh: 公車站總是標有**黃色站牌柱**。公車亭通常有**黃色屋頂**。

text: Belgium uses these **red** water hydrants signs with the letter **H **on top.
NOTE: You can also find these in Germany.
text_zh: 比利時使用這種**紅色**消防栓標誌，頂部帶有字母 **H**。
備註：你在德國也能看到這些。

text: Brussels, the capital of Belgium, is **bilingual**. You will see both French and Dutch on signs.
text_zh: 比利時首都布魯塞爾是**雙語區**。你會在標誌上同時看到法語和荷蘭語。

text: Bus stop signs in Flanders (and Brussels) have a **white rectangle** at the top. In Wallonia they will have a [**yellow top**](https://goo.gl/maps/RXMysmC593bvR99HA).
text_zh: 法蘭德斯（以及布魯塞爾）的公車站牌頂端有一個**白色長方形**。瓦隆尼亞的公車站牌則有[**黃色頂端**](https://goo.gl/maps/RXMysmC593bvR99HA)。

text: In Flanders (and Brussels), 95% of warning signs have a **thick red outline**, without a white border. Contrarily, you will most often find warning signs with a [**small white outline**](https://goo.gl/maps/UAv4N67VDRvvcSjJ7) in Wallonia.
NOTE: The signs found in Flanders are the same as the Spanish ones.
text_zh: 在法蘭德斯（以及布魯塞爾），95% 的警告標誌都有**粗紅邊框**，且沒有外圍白邊。相反地，在瓦隆尼亞最常看到的警告標誌則帶有[**細白外框**](https://goo.gl/maps/UAv4N67VDRvvcSjJ7)。
注意：法蘭德斯看到的標誌與西班牙的標誌相同。

text: As mentioned before, **municipality names** are often mentioned on street signs, usually in smaller font than the street name. The map shows a selection of recognizable street signs in the bigger cities.
NOTE: Of the big cities, **Bruges **(Brugge) is an exception to the rule of signs usually mentioning the municipality name.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 如前所述，路牌上經常會標示**自治市名稱**，字體通常比路名小。地圖展示了較大城市中一些具辨識度的路牌選輯。
注意：在大城市中，**布魯日**（Brugge）是不適用「路牌通常會標示自治市名稱」這項規則的例外。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Baarle-Hertog, located north-east of Antwerp, is composed of several exclaves and enclaves of Belgium and the Netherlands. You can often see the country's borders in this city (indicated by **small white crosses**). Street name signs tell you whether you are in Belgium or The Netherlands.
text_zh: 巴勒海托赫位於安特衛普東北方，由比利時和荷蘭的多個飛地與嵌入地組成。在這個城市裡你經常可以看到國界（由**白色小十字**標示）。街道路牌會告訴你你是在比利時還是荷蘭。

text: These signs are frequently found in the cities of Bhutan and are often coloured **red** or **blue**.
NOTE: As seen here, they will typically have the town name you are in written on them.
text_zh: 這些標誌經常在不丹的城市中看到，顏色通常為**紅色**或**藍色**。
注意：如這裡所示，上面通常會寫有你所在城鎮的名稱。

text: Signposts in Bhutan frequently have black-and-white **stripes**.
NOTE: Within Asia, these posts are also found in Sri Lanka, India, Nepal, Malaysia and Bangladesh. Make sure to check other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 不丹的標誌桿經常帶有黑白相間的**條紋**。
注意：在亞洲，斯里蘭卡、印度、尼泊爾、馬來西亞和孟加拉也可以看到這種立桿。在猜測前請務必確認其他線索。

text: Bolivia typically uses **bulky, white square signposts**.
NOTE: Peru typically uses black and white striped “zebra” signposts.
text_zh: 玻利維亞通常使用**笨重、白色的方形標誌桿**。
注意：秘魯通常使用黑白條紋的「斑馬」標誌桿。

text: Bolivia has a **second official flag**, called the [Wiphala](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wiphala). It is a square patchwork of seven diagonally arranged colours. It is sometimes seen on government buildings and project signs.
text_zh: 玻利維亞有一面**第二官方國旗**，稱為 [Wiphala](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wiphala)。它是一個由七種對角排列顏色組成的方形拼布旗幟。有時可以在政府大樓和工程標誌上看到它。

text: Signs in Botswana are usually in **English**. Most town names, however, are derived from any of the indigenous languages spoken in the country.
NOTE: The Afrikaans language, which is closely related to Dutch and common in South Africa, is very rare in Botswana. You will almost never find Afrikaans place names.
text_zh: 波札那的標誌通常使用**英文**。然而，大多數城鎮名稱是源自該國所使用的某種原住民語言。
註：南非語（Afrikaans，與荷蘭語密切相關且在南非很常見）在波札那非常罕見。你幾乎不會看到南非語的地名。

text: Botswana has a unique **black-and-yellow striped signpost**. More rarely, you can see red-and-white signposts.
NOTE: In Southern Africa, these signposts are only found in Botswana.
text_zh: 波札那擁有特殊的**黃黑相間條紋標誌桿**。較罕見的情況下，你也可以看到紅白相間的標誌桿。
註：在非洲南部，這種標誌桿只會在波札那看到。

text: Just like the other Southern African countries, direction signs have a **green background**.
The numbers of major roads start with **A**. These road numbers frequently appear on direction signs.
NOTE: Road numbers in South Africa never start with A.
text_zh: 就像其他南部非洲國家一樣，方向指示標誌採用**綠色背景**。
主要道路的編號開頭為 **A**。這些道路編號經常出現在方向指示標誌上。
註：南非的道路編號絕不會以 A 開頭。

text: Some road signs have a **blue background**. This is an older style of sign that was used before signs with white backgrounds were introduced. They are relatively unique to Botswana.
Note that most road signs will have the newer white background.
text_zh: 有些道路標誌採用**藍色背景**。這是引入白色背景標誌前使用的較舊樣式標誌。這在波札那算是相當獨特。
請注意，大多數道路標誌都會使用較新的白色背景。

text: Bulgaria mainly uses the **Cyrillic alphabet**. However, a lot of signs will also have the Latin alphabet.
The letter “Ъ” is only found in Bulgarian and Russian, although it is fairly uncommon in Russian.
text_zh: 保加利亞主要使用**西里爾字母**。然而，許多標誌上也會有拉丁字母。
字母「Ъ」只出現在保加利亞文和俄文中，不過它在俄文中相當罕見。

text: The Bulgarian word for street is **улица** (ulitsa), sometimes abbreviated **ул.** (ul.).
NOTE: In older street signs seeing only Cyrillic is more common.
Russia also uses улица/ulitsa.
text_zh: 保加利亞文中的街道一詞是 **улица** (ulitsa)，有時簡寫為 **ул.** (ul.)。
注意：在較舊的路標上，只看到西里爾字母更為常見。
俄羅斯也使用 улица/ulitsa。

text: Bulgarian directional signs are blue, arrow-shaped, and use both the **Cyrillic and Latin** alphabet. Importantly, even if you are far away and cannot decipher the script, you can still see that the sign has two lines of text instead of one.
text_zh: 保加利亞的方向指示牌是藍色箭頭形，並同時使用**西里爾和拉丁**字母。重要的是，即使你身在遠處看不清文字，你仍能看出指示牌有兩行文字而非一行。

text: Town entry signs have a simple white design and also use both the Cyrillic and Latin alphabet. Like with the directional signs, the two lines of text are obvious, even when seen from far away.
text_zh: 城鎮入口標誌採用簡單的白色設計，同樣同時使用西里爾和拉丁字母。與方向指示牌一樣，即使從遠處看，兩行文字也很明顯。

text: Bulgarian pedestrian signs have **four stripes**, and the person is wearing a hat.
NOTE: No other eastern or central European pedestrian signs have four stripes.
text_zh: 保加利亞的行人標誌有**四條條紋**，且圖案中的人戴著帽子。
注意：東歐或中歐沒有其他國家的行人標誌具有四條條紋。

text: White street signs with **two red strips**; one covering the bottom and one covering part of the top, can be found in Sofia.
NOTE: You can also find [other types](https://maps.app.goo.gl/EUVuwa83zMGYrP398) of street signs in Sofia.
text_zh: 帶有**兩條紅色條紋**（一條覆蓋底部，一條覆蓋部分頂部）的白色路標可以在索菲亞找到。
注意：你也可以在索菲亞找到[其他類型](https://maps.app.goo.gl/EUVuwa83zMGYrP398)的路標。

text: **Brown street signs** with bright yellow text can be found in Stara Zagora.
text_zh: 帶有鮮黃色文字的**棕色路標**可以在斯塔拉扎戈拉找到。

text: Throughout the country, you can find distinct **blue signs** from the Cambodian People’s Party (CPP).
These signs occasionally feature the likenesses of major party politicians: usually [three men](https://goo.gl/maps/uWwgvxjSdKMp7W676) side by side.
text_zh: 在全國各地，你都可以看到柬埔寨人民黨（CPP）標誌性的**藍色招牌**。
這些招牌偶爾會印有該黨主要政治人物的肖像：通常是並排的[三位男性](https://goo.gl/maps/uWwgvxjSdKMp7W676)。

text: Bilingual signs with **Chinese** writing can commonly be found in Preah Sihanouk.
text_zh: 在 Preah Sihanouk 常能看到帶有**中文**的雙語指示牌。

text: In the US and Canada, especially at large intersections, **long metal bars** with **stop lights** attached to them hang over the street. These bars also commonly have street signs, highway signs, or other signs attached to them.
text_zh: 在美國和加拿大，特別是在大型路口，街道上方會懸掛掛有**紅綠燈**的**長金屬桿**。這些橫桿上也經常掛有路名牌、公路標誌或其他標誌。

text: You will often find these **yellow fire hydrant markers** atop signposts in Québec.

In [Québec City](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tXPTbFvb8CWHFhFa7) these markers will usually have a blue rectangle and markers in [Trois-Rivières](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UZwuZs8zfPbjdAFX7) are distinctly small.

NOTE: Sometimes the markers will have [different colours](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dMcGqrRcNb4nB15dA). Beware that [Edmundston](https://maps.app.goo.gl/J3AV6ZypEukym8p96), in New Brunswick, uses these too.
text_zh: 在魁北克省，你經常會在標誌桿頂端看到這種**黃色消防栓標記**。
在[魁北克市](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tXPTbFvb8CWHFhFa7)，這些標記通常會有一個藍色矩形，而[三河市](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UZwuZs8zfPbjdAFX7)的標記則明顯偏小。
註：有時這些標記會呈現[不同顏色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dMcGqrRcNb4nB15dA)。注意紐布倫斯威克省的[艾德蒙斯頓](https://maps.app.goo.gl/J3AV6ZypEukym8p96)也使用這種標記。

text: Iqaluit is the capital of Nunavut, meaning it is **more urban**, and built up compared to other Nunavut settlements. The city features bilingual **turquoise street signs**. Speed limit signs are also uniquely bilingual. And on the outskirts of the city, these unique road markers can be seen.
text_zh: 伊奎特（Iqaluit）是努納福特（Nunavut）的首府，這意味著與其他努納福特定居點相比，這裡**較為都市化**且建設較完善。該市特色是擁有雙語的**綠松石色街道標誌**。速限標誌也是獨特的雙語標誌。而在城市郊區，可以看到這些獨特的道路標記。

text: The remote town of Churchill in northern Manitoba features a trekker with a distinct thin **antenna **visible on the front right side of the car. The town also has unique street signs.
NOTE: This coverage is also seen in the surrounding area.
text_zh: 曼尼托巴省北部的偏遠小鎮邱吉爾（Churchill）具有徒步拍攝街景，其車頭右前方明顯可見一根細長的**天線**。該鎮也擁有獨特的街道標誌。
注意：周遭地區也能看到這種街景覆蓋。

text: **Slots** can often be seen at the top of signposts.
text_zh: 標誌桿的頂部經常可以看到**缺口**。

text: **Orange street signs** can be seen at almost every intersection in the city of Lanco, and occasionally in the nearby town of Malalhue.
text_zh: **橘色街道標誌**幾乎可以在蘭科市的每個路口看到，在附近的馬拉爾韋鎮則偶爾可見。

text: Villa O’Higgins can be recognized by the large **mountains** located immediately to the east. To the west, [snow-capped mountains](https://maps.app.goo.gl/QGUzYaHWvb8PphP99) are seen in the distance. Street signs, fences and many other structures throughout the village are made of orange-stained wood.
text_zh: 維拉奧伊金斯（Villa O’Higgins）可以透過位於正東方的大型**山脈**來辨認。向西望去，遠處可以看到 [覆雪山脈](https://maps.app.goo.gl/QGUzYaHWvb8PphP99)。村莊各處的街道標誌、柵欄和許多其他結構都是由染成橘色的木頭製成的。

text: Christmas Island is famous for its **red crabs**. Near Ethel Beach, you can find a trekker walking among hundreds of these crabs. Another smaller trekker where you can see crabs is [near The Dales](https://goo.gl/maps/deYXgd8DDC3RfBbd6), on the West Coast. Throughout the island, you can find [references](https://goo.gl/maps/jhXdg6Yp6Yo9LpMA9) on signs to these crabs.
text_zh: 聖誕島以其**紅蟹**聞名。在埃特爾海灘（Ethel Beach）附近，你可以找到一個徒步拍攝走在數百隻這些螃蟹之中。另一個可以看到螃蟹較小的徒步拍攝位於西海岸的[戴爾斯（The Dales）附近](https://goo.gl/maps/deYXgd8DDC3RfBbd6)。在全島各處，你都可以在標誌上找到對這些螃蟹的[參考提及](https://goo.gl/maps/jhXdg6Yp6Yo9LpMA9)。

text: Signposts in Colombia are made of white metal, and join to form a distinct **cross on the back** of signs.
NOTE: White metal signposts can also be found in Brazil, however these are usually wider.
text_zh: 哥倫比亞的指路標誌由白色金屬製成，拼接起來會在標誌**背面形成明顯的十字**。
註：白色金屬指路標誌也可以在巴西找到，但這些通常較寬。

text: Like in Mexico, Panama and Guatemala, Costa Rican stop signs display the word **“ALTO”**.
NOTE: Stop signs in [Panama](https://goo.gl/maps/LaAjCE36HSZziiCg8) use a thicker font. Furthermore, in the rest of Spanish Latin America they say “PARE”.
text_zh: 就像在墨西哥、巴拿馬和瓜地馬拉一樣，哥斯大黎加的停止標誌顯示 **“ALTO”** 字樣。
[巴拿馬](https://goo.gl/maps/LaAjCE36HSZziiCg8)的停車標誌字體較粗。此外，在西班牙語拉丁美洲的其他地區，他們說「PARE」。

text: Many road signs have a distinct **cross **on the back. This is most common on diamond-shaped warning signs, while others are mostly attached regularly.
NOTE: Signs in Colombia almost always have a cross at the back, but they use white signposts.
text_zh: 許多道路標誌背面都有一個明顯的**十字**。這在菱形警告標誌上最常見，而其他標誌大多是正常安裝的。
注意：哥倫比亞的標誌背面幾乎總是有一個十字，但他們使用的是白色標誌柱。

text: The provinces are sometimes written on signs, so they are useful to know. We will also refer to them in the clues below.
text_zh: 省份有時會寫在標誌上，所以知道這些很有用。我們也會在下面的線索中提及它們。

text: The entire municipality of San José consistently uses these **green **street signs with a **white rectangle** containing an emblem. Calle/Avenida streets are numerically ordered, increasing from downtown outwards.
text_zh: 整個聖荷西自治市 consistently 使用這些帶有包含徽章的**白色矩形**的**綠色**街牌。Calle（街道）/Avenida（大道）是按數字順序排列的，從市中心向外遞增。

text: By the entrance of Jardín Botanico Lankester, located southeast of Cartago, you can find a poorly maintained dirt road, surrounded by mountains in the distance, as well as a [sign](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ieKVnVBKyytKZxRw5#extra%5Btags%5D=aigen&extra%5Btags%5D=jardin&extra%5Btags%5D=pinpointable&extra%5Btags%5D=urban&extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng) with the name of the garden.
Within the garden itself you will find a plethora of different plants, with the [walkways](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ZeyMUPjpFPoufVLk9) having many soft curves, and almost never being straight.
text_zh: 在位於卡塔戈東南方的蘭克斯特植物園（Jardin Botanico Lankester）入口處，你可以找到一條維護不良的泥土路，遠處環繞著群山，還有一塊寫著植物園名稱的[標示牌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ieKVnVBKyytKZxRw5#extra%5Btags%5D=aigen&extra%5Btags%5D=jardin&extra%5Btags%5D=pinpointable&extra%5Btags%5D=urban&extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng)。
在花園內部，你會發現大量不同的植物，其[步道](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ZeyMUPjpFPoufVLk9)有許多平緩的彎道，幾乎從不筆直。

text: Croatia has direction signs with a **yellow background** and a **black **outline. They often have a pencil-shaped tip.
NOTE: The other former Yugoslav countries of Slovenia, Serbia, Montenegro and North Macedonia have similar signs. A comparison can be seen [here](/images/croatia/croatia_directionsigncomp.png).
text_zh: 克羅埃西亞的方向指示牌具有**黃色背景**與**黑色**外框。它們通常帶有鉛筆形狀的尖端。
注意：其他前南斯拉夫國家如斯洛維尼亞、塞爾維亞、蒙特內哥羅和北馬其頓也有類似的標誌。可以[在這裡](/images/croatia/croatia_directionsigncomp.png)看到對照。

text: Croatia’s pedestrian sign features a **pedestrian with a belt** and a zebra path with 5 stripes.
NOTE: The pedestrian on Slovenia’s sign does not have a belt.
text_zh: 克羅埃西亞的行人標誌上有一個**繫著皮帶的行人**以及帶有 5 條斑馬紋的斑馬線。
注意：斯洛維尼亞標誌上的行人沒有皮帶。

text: Bilingual street name signs with Croatian and **Italian** are typically found in Istria, especially in the western cities.
text_zh: 標示克羅埃西亞文與**義大利文**的雙語街道名稱標誌通常出現在伊斯特拉，尤其是西部城市。

text: The coloured border or road signs can typically be seen continuing onto the back of the signs. These will generally be red or blue.
text_zh: 道路標誌的彩色邊框或標誌本身通常會延續到標誌背面。這些通常是紅色或藍色的。

text: Blue street signs attached to the top of **yellow signposts** are common in Curaçao.
text_zh: 固定在**黃色路標**頂部的藍色路牌在古拉索很常見。

text: A former crown colony of the United Kingdom until 1960, Cyprus continues to use some **borrowed infrastructure**, like signs and roadlines. This is also why Cyprus drives on the **left**, and why** English** is so widely used.
text_zh: 賽普勒斯在 1960 年以前曾是大英帝國的皇家殖民地，至今仍保留了一些**借用自英國的基礎設施**，例如標誌和道路標線。這也是為什麼賽普勒斯是靠**左**駕駛，以及**英文**如此普及的原因。

text: Directional signs are very similar to Greek directional signs, with the one notable difference being that the Greek text is written in **all-caps**.
text_zh: 方向標誌與希臘的方向標誌非常相似，一個明顯的區別是希臘文全部使用**大寫字母**書寫。

text: Town entry signs consist of either a yellow rectangle with a red border, or just the smaller white rectangle that contains the town name in both Greek and English. The signs will also contain a speed limit sign above them. These designs are unique to Cyprus.
text_zh: 城鎮入口標誌是由一個帶有紅邊的黃色長方形，或是僅有較小的白色長方形組成，上面同時以希臘文和英文標示城鎮名稱。這些標誌上方也常有速限標誌。這些設計是賽普勒斯特有的。

text: Cyprus uses four-digit postal codes, grouped by region. They can be [found on street signs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/QLKgfjhF61xNEmVu9), and are denoted by either T.K. or T.T.
The first digits can be useful to memorise.
text_zh: 賽普勒斯使用四位數郵遞區號，依地區分組。這些號碼可以在 [路標上找到](https://maps.app.goo.gl/QLKgfjhF61xNEmVu9)，通常會標示 T.K. 或 T.T.。
記住第一位數字會很有幫助。

text: With a Russian-speaking population of around 17%, many commercial signs in Limassol feature **Russian **translations.
text_zh: 由於擁有約 17% 的俄語人口，利馬索爾（Limassol）的許多商業招牌都有**俄語**翻譯。

text: It is common in both Czechia and Slovakia to see temporary square sign posts coated in red and white stripes.
text_zh: 捷克和斯洛伐克都很常見到塗有紅白相間條紋的臨時方形標誌桿。

text: Hiking markers, made up of one colourful strip between two white ones, are commonly found in Czechia and Slovakia. They sometimes form an [arrow](https://goo.gl/maps/6XHw2gHa8VDWvhgh7).

NOTE: While by far being the most common in Czechia and Slovakia, similar signs can be found in other European countries such as [Poland](https://goo.gl/maps/aXtx3dQZAxJDEo9u6), [Hungary](https://goo.gl/maps/Rc9N8toac29Zq5Df8) and [Germany](https://goo.gl/maps/W2ek9Z81Qx9ZXStS7).
text_zh: 由兩條白色夾著一條彩色條紋組成的健行標記，在捷克和斯洛伐克很常見。它們有時會組成一個[箭頭](https://goo.gl/maps/6XHw2gHa8VDWvhgh7)。
注意：雖然這在捷克和斯洛伐克最為常見，但在其他歐洲國家如[波蘭](https://goo.gl/maps/aXtx3dQZAxJDEo9u6)、[匈牙利](https://goo.gl/maps/Rc9N8toac29Zq5Df8)和[德國](https://goo.gl/maps/W2ek9Z81Qx9ZXStS7)也能找到類似的標誌。

text: These **black **signs can often be found by the end of bridges in Generation 4 coverage. The road number is displayed on the left.
text_zh: 這些**黑色**標誌經常可以在相機世代 4 街景覆蓋的橋梁盡頭找到。道路編號顯示在左側。

text: Czechia uses **arrow-shaped** directional signs with a filled in tip. Due to the shape, they are recognizable from [behind](https://goo.gl/maps/Zqsh9W6Fbfyz2VAm8).
NOTE: [Slovakia](https://www.google.se/maps/@48.4606372,17.9419945,3a,15y,86.64h,88.47t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sESbNzDre3j8pPlgC-FhT8A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) has small white arrows instead.
text_zh: 捷克使用**箭形**且填滿箭頭的方向指示標誌。由於這個形狀，從[背面](https://goo.gl/maps/Zqsh9W6Fbfyz2VAm8)也能辨識。
注意：[斯洛伐克](https://www.google.se/maps/@48.4606372,17.9419945,3a,15y,86.64h,88.47t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sESbNzDre3j8pPlgC-FhT8A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)則是使用白色的小箭頭。

text: The borders of Czech road signs are almost always **separated from the edge** by a strip in the same colour as the sign background.

NOTE: In [Slovakia](https://www.google.se/maps/@48.1580681,17.1258261,3a,24.6y,115.44h,98.53t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sNnRd9IA8rxp5Vc2nYvUN9A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192!5m1!1e4), it is more common for signs to have the border on the edge of the sign.
text_zh: 捷克道路標誌的邊框幾乎總是與標誌邊緣**保持距離**，中間隔著一道與標誌背景同色的小條紋。
注意：在[斯洛伐克](https://www.google.se/maps/@48.1580681,17.1258261,3a,24.6y,115.44h,98.53t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sNnRd9IA8rxp5Vc2nYvUN9A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192!5m1!1e4)，標誌的邊框通常緊貼在標誌邊緣上。
