text: Czech highway signs can be either blue or [green](https://goo.gl/maps/fBxJ3iU9UXQPgkjR8), and have a thin white border, which is separated from the edge by a **second** coloured border.

NOTE: [Slovak](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.3562921,18.0491906,3a,21.7y,86.73h,109.67t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sbD26GncxCrFlCaY-jYpwQg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) highway signs have a white border right on the edge.
text_zh: 捷克的高速公路標誌可以是藍色或[綠色](https://goo.gl/maps/fBxJ3iU9UXQPgkjR8)，帶有細白邊，且該白邊與標誌邊緣之間隔著**第二道**顏色的邊框。
注意：[斯洛伐克](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.3562921,18.0491906,3a,21.7y,86.73h,109.67t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sbD26GncxCrFlCaY-jYpwQg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)的高速公路標誌白邊是直接貼在邊緣上的。

text: The most common type of street sign in Czechia are **bright red** signs, which can either be wide and stuck on walls, or thin and attached to [signs posts](https://goo.gl/maps/ikgYSMAs1jAg8rqMA). Note that other street signs do occur in some areas, most notably in [Brno](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.1989638,16.6165572,3a,35y,97.05h,95.53t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s4kmt2ZzZOxhdBnJR1Ge13A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192). Similarly designed [blue](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.2119242,15.8240056,3a,15y,292.91h,96.94t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1suOJ7x-GhmeTeCT9Pa6vWng!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) signs are also fairly common.

Furthermore, the Czech word for street is “ulice”, unlike most Slavic languages which use “ulica”. This word is usually omitted, but finding “ulice” on [street signs](https://goo.gl/maps/U6pq8zx1eJPVVHuq9) is still possible.
NOTE: [Slovakia](https://goo.gl/maps/CkdiggTX35tAuRZG8) typically uses white street signs with a red border and blue text.
text_zh: 捷克最常見的街道標誌是**亮紅色**標誌，可以是寬版並貼在牆上，或是窄版並固定在[標誌桿](https://goo.gl/maps/ikgYSMAs1jAg8rqMA)上。請注意，某些地區也會出現其他顏色的街道標誌，最明顯的是在[布爾諾](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.1989638,16.6165572,3a,35y,97.05h,95.53t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s4kmt2ZzZOxhdBnJR1Ge13A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)。類似設計的[藍色](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.2119242,15.8240056,3a,15y,292.91h,96.94t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1suOJ7x-GhmeTeCT9Pa6vWng!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)標誌也相當常見。
此外，捷克語中的「街道」是「ulice」，這與大多數使用「ulica」的斯拉夫語言不同。這個字通常會被省略，但在[街道標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/U6pq8zx1eJPVVHuq9)上還是找得到「ulice」。
注意：[斯洛伐克](https://goo.gl/maps/CkdiggTX35tAuRZG8)通常使用帶有紅邊和藍字白色街道標誌。

text: House numbers in Czechia are generally written on **blue** or **red signs** with thin white borders.
NOTE: On the contrary, Slovak house numbers are typically written on [**white signs**](https://goo.gl/maps/arqzJku5JuJJ3CcQ8)** **with a thin red or black border.
text_zh: 捷克的門牌號碼通常寫在帶有細白邊的**藍色**或**紅色標誌**上。
注意：相對地，斯洛伐克的門牌號碼通常寫在帶有細紅邊或黑邊的[**白色標誌**](https://goo.gl/maps/arqzJku5JuJJ3CcQ8)** **上。

text: Czech sign posts typically have **thick, black caps**.
NOTE: While some European countries have similar caps, Slovakia usually does not have them.
text_zh: 捷克的標誌桿通常有**厚實的黑色頂蓋**。
注意：雖然某些歐洲國家也有類似的頂蓋，但斯洛伐克通常沒有。

text: Czech pedestrian signs have **five** stripes.

NOTE: The stripes on [Slovak pedestrian signs](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.1706981,17.1749503,3a,15y,50.47h,103.76t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sdNUjkc5XVOND2uDxppzW1A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) are a smaller scale. This is noticeable when comparing the outermost stripes to the edge of the triangle.
text_zh: 捷克的行人穿越道標誌有**五條**條紋。
注意：[斯洛伐克行人穿越道標誌](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.1706981,17.1749503,3a,15y,50.47h,103.76t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sdNUjkc5XVOND2uDxppzW1A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)上的條紋比例較小。當你比較最外側條紋與三角形邊緣的距離時，就會發現這點。

text: Czech road signs have a fairly** thin font**.

NOTE: [Slovak](https://www.google.se/maps/@48.6121158,17.8343458,3a,15y,35.68h,88.71t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s7V5Bac7DZqw_gIaMTTy6zw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) signs normally have a much bolder font. The same font is however used in [Luxembourg](https://goo.gl/maps/G2VWXYozceB7FjgD6) and [Germany](https://goo.gl/maps/S4zvN55HUprvgY6n8).
text_zh: 捷克道路標誌採用相當**纖細的字體**。

注意：[斯洛伐克](https://www.google.se/maps/@48.6121158,17.8343458,3a,15y,35.68h,88.71t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s7V5Bac7DZqw_gIaMTTy6zw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)標誌通常使用粗得多的字體。然而，同樣的字體也見於[盧森堡](https://goo.gl/maps/G2VWXYozceB7FjgD6)與[德國](https://goo.gl/maps/S4zvN55HUprvgY6n8)。

text: Bicycle signs in Czechia are yellow. You may also find markings similar to hiking markers, but with [yellow stripes](https://goo.gl/maps/toztoSy8i79p6pNk8) instead of white.
text_zh: 捷克的自行車標誌是黃色的。你可能也會找到類似健行步道標誌的記號，但它是[黃色條紋](https://goo.gl/maps/toztoSy8i79p6pNk8)而非白色。

text: Czech railway crossing signs do **not** have a background.

NOTE: [Slovak](https://www.google.se/maps/@48.5221855,17.4540175,3a,15y,74.7h,97.77t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sD6lspMXwIUgsJJU74xCt6Q!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) railway crossing signs have a white rectangular background.
text_zh: 捷克的鐵路平交道標誌**沒有**背景。
注意：[斯洛伐克](https://www.google.se/maps/@48.5221855,17.4540175,3a,15y,74.7h,97.77t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sD6lspMXwIUgsJJU74xCt6Q!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)的鐵路平交道標誌有白色的長方形背景。

text: While possible to find in most of the country, **blue street signs** are more common in the east of the country, with Ostrava being the only major city to mainly use them.
text_zh: 雖然在全國大部分地區都能找到，但**藍色街道路牌**在該國東部更為常見，奧斯特拉瓦是唯一主要使用這種路牌的主要城市。

text: If you see a white street sign with **blue text** and a **red border**, the same as is typical for Slovakia, then you should be near the Slovak border.
text_zh: 如果你看到白底、配有**藍色文字**和**紅色邊框**的街道標示（這跟斯洛伐克的典型風格一樣），那麼你應該就在斯洛伐克邊境附近。

text: White street signs with **red text** are most commonly found in the eastern parts of the country. They can also be found in the southernmost parts.
NOTE: Brno notably uses this design.
text_zh: 白底、配有**紅色文字**的街道標示最常見於該國東部地區，在最南部地區也能找到。
注意：布爾諾特別常使用這種設計。

text: White street signs with **blue text** are most common in the eastern parts of the country, but can also be seen in the central northern parts.
text_zh: 白底、配有**藍色文字**的街道標示最常見於該國東部地區，但在中北部地區也能見到。

text: White street signs with **black text** are most commonly found in the southeastern parts of the country. Note that these can look very similar to the ones with blue text.
text_zh: 白底、配有**黑色文字**的街道標示最常見於該國東南部地區。請注意，這些標示看起來可能與藍字標示非常相似。

text: Polish bilingual street signs are found in Český Těšín, and very rarely in other [nearby towns](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.5752315,18.7627604,3a,15y,178.22h,95.37t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s99563llRkK9adal39xiU6w!2e0!7i16384!8i8192).
text_zh: 波蘭語雙語路牌可在切申找到，在其他[附近的城鎮](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.5752315,18.7627604,3a,15y,178.22h,95.37t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s99563llRkK9adal39xiU6w!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)則非常罕見。

text: The street signs in Šumperk can be recognized by being blue, with **text** filling out almost the **entire sign**.
text_zh: 森珀克的路牌特徵為藍色底，且**文字**幾乎填滿了**整個路牌**。

text: Denmark has very unique-looking direction signs that are very useful to recognize the country. They are low to the ground and **framed by pipes**. They are either coloured [red and white](https://goo.gl/maps/xt2jxMHjMQivxS8B7) or [blue and white](https://goo.gl/maps/zC5mi95DGrvhHD8W6), with a directional arrow incorporated into the background. Signs often feature road numbers.

Some larger road signs have a more [standard layout](https://goo.gl/maps/oXjRzsLL2PQBcJC89) without the pipe frame. Highway signs have [blue or green](https://goo.gl/maps/SZ3AQjYCNbzxErT68) backgrounds.
text_zh: 丹麥有外觀非常獨特的方向指示牌，對於識別這個國家非常有用。它們位置很低，且**由管子框住**。它們的顏色不是[紅白相間](https://goo.gl/maps/xt2jxMHjMQivxS8B7)就是[藍白相間](https://goo.gl/maps/zC5mi95DGrvhHD8W6)，背景中整合了一個方向箭頭。標誌上通常帶有道路編號。
一些較大的道路標誌採用更[標準的版面](https://goo.gl/maps/oXjRzsLL2PQBcJC89)，沒有管狀外框。高速公路標誌具有[藍色或綠色](https://goo.gl/maps/SZ3AQjYCNbzxErT68)背景。

text: Most Danish street names end in **“vej.”** This is the Danish word for “street.” Street signs most commonly have a blue background with white text.
text_zh: 大多數丹麥的街道名稱都以 **“vej.”** 結尾。這是丹麥語中「街道」的意思。路牌通常為藍底白字。

text: This signpost, where the pipe frame is **bent around the sign**, is unique to Denmark.
text_zh: 這種管狀支架**繞著標誌彎曲**的指示牌是丹麥特有的。

text: This Danish pedestrian sign has **5 stripes. **Uniquely, the first and fifth stripe touch the edge of the white triangle.
NOTE: Sweden’s pedestrian sign has 4 stripes. Norway almost always has 4 stripes too, but very rarely you can find signs with 5 stripes.
text_zh: 這個丹麥行人標誌有 **5 條條紋。**獨特的是，第一條和第五條條紋觸及白色三角形的邊緣。
注意：瑞典的行人標誌有 4 條條紋。挪威幾乎也總是 4 條條紋，但極少數情況下可以找到有 5 條條紋的標誌。

text: This unique sign is found when entering a town. When leaving, there will be a red slash through the sign.
text_zh: 這個獨特的標誌會在進入城鎮時看到。當離開時，標誌上會有一道紅色斜線。

text: In addition, these regions each have their own **bus stop sign**.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 此外，這些地區各自擁有專屬的**公車站牌**。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: These **green bicycle signs** are found on the island of Bornholm.
text_zh: 這些**綠色自行車標誌**可以在博恩holm島上找到。

text: Despite being located in Central America, stop signs in DR contain the South American “PARE”. Moreover, many signs are attached to **yellow signposts**.
NOTE: ‘PARE’ is also used in all of South America as well as Puerto Rico.
text_zh: 儘管位於中美洲，多明尼加的停止標誌上卻包含南美洲的「PARE」。此外，許多標誌都固定在**黃色路標柱**上。
注意：「PARE」也用於整個南美洲以及波多黎各。

text: Street name signs in Santo Domingo often contain the letters **“ADN”**, a reference to the Distrito Nacional, which the city is located in.
text_zh: 聖多明哥的路名標牌通常包含字母 **“ADN”**，這是該市所在國家特區（Distrito Nacional）的縮寫。

text: Ecuador uses a lot of **square road signs** with a white background, of the design shown in the image.
text_zh: 厄瓜多使用許多白底的**方形道路標誌**，採用圖片中所示的設計。

text: Sometimes, the back of the signs are painted a **teal blue** colour. The signposts are thin and made of metal.
NOTE: Ecuador is the only country in Latin America to use teal blue sign backs.
text_zh: parfois，標誌背面會被漆成**藍綠色**。路標柱很細且由金屬製成。
注意：厄瓜多是拉丁美洲唯一使用藍綠色標誌背面的國家。

text: Ecuador uses these signs to indicate one or two-way streets.

NOTE: The [Dominican Republic](https://maps.app.goo.gl/NbmAmmV68vqXA6JW9) and [Puerto Rico](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7ihNZDn6wtVLZ1187) are the only two other Latin American countries to use similar signs with **text inside the arrow**.
text_zh: 厄瓜多使用這些標誌來指示單行道或雙行道。
注意：[多明尼加共和國](https://maps.app.goo.gl/NbmAmmV68vqXA6JW9)和[波多黎各](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7ihNZDn6wtVLZ1187)是僅有的另外兩個在拉丁美洲使用類似標誌且**箭頭內有文字**的國家。

text: The official language in Egypt is **Arabic**. You can occasionally see it on signs in several of the trekkers. Its script can be identified by its lines and dots.
text_zh: 埃及的官方語言是**阿拉伯語**。你偶爾可以在幾個徒步拍攝點的標誌上看到它。其文字可以透過線條和點來辨識。

text: Each Baltic country has a slightly different border for its warning and speed signs.
Estonian signs have a **thin** red border, with **no white outline** around it (the red border extends all the way to the edge of the sign).
text_zh: 每個波羅的海國家的警告標誌與速限標誌邊框略有不同。
愛沙尼亞的標誌具有**細的**紅邊，且**沒有白色外框**（紅色邊框一直延伸到標誌邊緣）。

text: Estonian pedestrian signs have **3 stripes**. The shape of the pedestrian has a relatively high level of detail, detailing **shoes** and an **attached head**.
NOTE: Lithuanian signs also have 3 stripes, but the pedestrian looks less detailed.
!!Latvian pedestrian signs have 5 stripes.
text_zh: 愛沙尼亞的行人標誌有 **3 條紋**。行人的形狀具有相對高等級的細節，描繪出**鞋子**與**連體的頭部**。
注意：立陶宛的標誌也有 3 條紋，但行人看起來細節較少。
!!拉脫維亞的行人標誌有 5 條紋。

text: Estonian bus stop signs have this design.
The bus has **four windows**. This is mostly useful to distinguish it from the Latvian bus stop sign, which has five windows.
Note, however, that Lithuania has the same bus stop signs as Estonia.
text_zh: 愛沙尼亞的公車站牌採用這種設計。
公車有**四扇窗戶**。這主要有助於將其與擁有五扇窗戶的拉脫維亞公車站牌區分開來。
不過請注意，立陶宛使用與愛沙尼亞相同的公車站牌。

text: These **blue and white** signpost wrappings are very common in Estonia.
NOTE: They are also common in Finland and Sweden.
text_zh: 這些**藍白相間**的指標包覆在愛沙尼亞非常常見。
注意：它們在芬蘭和瑞典也很常見。

text: Directional signs in Estonia are blue with white text and a white outline.

NOTE: In [Finland](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SsE9X8eTamwvhp1T6), the arrow is built into the white border instead of being an icon inside the border. The arrow on [Latvian](https://goo.gl/maps/g3aqkLH6yjQwrCSF7) signs is more stylized than in Estonia and [Lithuania](https://goo.gl/maps/17A5xxGivFmbs4ae8), where the back part of the arrowhead is vertical.
text_zh: 愛沙尼亞的指標是藍底白字，帶有白色外框。
注意：在[芬蘭](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SsE9X8eTamwvhp1T6)，箭頭是內建在白色邊框中，而不是邊框內的圖示。[拉脫維亞](https://goo.gl/maps/g3aqkLH6yjQwrCSF7)標誌上的箭頭比愛沙尼亞和[立陶宛](https://goo.gl/maps/17A5xxGivFmbs4ae8)更具設計感，後者的箭頭尾部是垂直的。

text: Estonia has a large Russian minority. In most of Ida-Viru County, they form a majority. As a result, you will sometimes see bilingual signs with **Russian Cyrillic** and Estonian in the region in and around Narva.
Note that the majority of signs will still be in Estonian. You may occasionally see Cyrillic in other places.
text_zh: 愛沙尼亞有龐大的俄羅斯少數族群。在伊達-維魯縣（Ida-Viru County）的大部分地區，他們佔了多數。因此，納爾瓦（Narva）及其周邊地區有時會看到帶有**俄羅斯西里爾字母**與愛沙尼亞語的雙語標誌。
請注意，多數標誌仍會是愛沙尼亞語。你偶爾可能會在其他地方看到西里爾字母。

text: Directional signs are **yellow** with a **thin black border** and a metal frame, very similar to the ones in [Iceland](https://maps.app.goo.gl/5HsMnQt8A7fSwKpo6).
text_zh: 方向指標牌是**黃色**的，帶有**細黑色邊框**和金屬外框，非常類似於[冰島](https://maps.app.goo.gl/5HsMnQt8A7fSwKpo6)的指標牌。

text: Most Finnish street names end in “**tie**” or “**katu**.” These are the Finnish words for road and street. Street signs most commonly have a white background with black text.
NOTE: You may find roads ending in “polku” and “kuja”.
text_zh: 大多數芬蘭的街道名稱以“**tie**”或“**katu**”結尾。這是芬蘭語中道路和街道的意思。路牌通常為白底黑字。
注意：你也可能會發現以「polku」和「kuja」結尾的道路。

text: Finnish road signs have a **yellow background**.
NOTE: Signs in Sweden and Iceland also have yellow backgrounds. Norway, however, has signs with a white background.
text_zh: 芬蘭的道路標誌採用**黃色背景**。
注意：瑞典和冰島的標誌也是黃色背景。然而，挪威的標誌則是白色背景。

text: On traffic signs that have a red border, you will find a thin **yellow stroke** on the edge of the sign.
NOTE: You will not see this in any other Nordic country.
text_zh: 在帶有紅色邊框的交通標誌上，你會發現標誌邊緣有一道細細的**黃色外框**。
注意：你在其他任何北歐國家都看不到這個特徵。

text: Finnish pedestrian signs have **5 stripes**.
NOTE: Pedestrian signs in Sweden and Norway **usually** have 4 stripes. In [rare cases](https://goo.gl/maps/wMS7W2CWGyAi4DJt9), you can find 5 stripes in Norway.
text_zh: 芬蘭的行人穿越標誌有 **5 條條紋**。
注意：瑞典和挪威的行人標誌**通常**有 4 條線紋。在[罕見情況下](https://goo.gl/maps/wMS7W2CWGyAi4DJt9)，你可以在挪威找到 5 條線紋。

text: Finnish **directional signs** consist of a solid blue background, white text, and a white border with guiding arrows.
text_zh: 芬蘭的**方向指示標誌**由純藍色背景、白色文字、白色邊框以及指引箭頭組成。

text: Traffic signposts often have **blue and white** striped markings.

NOTE: This pattern can also be found in Sweden. While the same colour scheme is also common in [Estonia](https://www.google.com/maps/@58.3430383,26.7407475,3a,22.2y,264.88h,67.51t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sP587UApP9JnjyawxVML4YA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656), the markings typically have a wider shape and attach to the signpost in a looser way.
text_zh: 交通標誌柱通常有**藍白相間**的條紋標記。
註記：這種圖案在瑞典也能找到。雖然相同的配色方案在[愛沙尼亞](https://www.google.com/maps/@58.3430383,26.7407475,3a,22.2y,264.88h,67.51t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sP587UApP9JnjyawxVML4YA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656)也很常見，但標記通常形狀較寬，且與標誌柱的連接方式較鬆散。

text: Finland has two styles of **bus stop signs**, a blue and white one, and a yellow and black one.

NOTE: This can be used to tell Finland apart from Sweden, which has many different bus stop signs ([example](https://goo.gl/maps/h4BWBzQgVu4mtNgr6)), most of which have the names of the stops on them.
text_zh: 芬蘭有兩種風格的**公車站牌**，一種是藍白相間的，另一種是黃黑相間的。
註記：這可用於區分芬蘭和瑞典，瑞典有許多不同的公車站牌（[範例](https://goo.gl/maps/h4BWBzQgVu4mtNgr6)），其中大多數都標有站名。

text: Finnish regional roads have 3- or 4-digit road numbers. The **first digit** of those road numbers is **region-specific**. These regions are distributed in a rough south-to-north order, starting from 1 in the south to 9 in the north.
These road numbers often appear on direction signs. Learning the regions can help with cutting down on scanning time for 5k’s, or give you a rough region to plonk in during quick no move games.
NOTE: Major roads with 2-digit road numbers do not adhere to this geographic pattern.
text_zh: 芬蘭的區域道路有 3 位數或 4 位數的道路編號。這些道路編號的**第一位數**是**依區域而異**的。這些區域大致由南向北排列，從南部的 1 開始到北部的 9 結束。
這些道路編號常出現在方向標誌上。熟悉這些地區有助於縮短完成 5k 的掃描時間，或在快速無移動遊戲中讓你有個大致的落點區域。
註記：具有 2 位數道路編號的主要道路不遵循這種地理模式。

text: The [**Sámi languages**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/S%C3%A1mi_languages) are spoken in the far north of Finland. In this region, you can sometimes find bilingual signs with place names in both Finnish and Sámi. Unlike Finnish, its alphabet uses the letter **c**.
text_zh: [**薩米語**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/S%C3%A1mi_languages)通行於芬蘭的最北部。在該地區，有時可以找到同時標有芬蘭語和薩米語地名的雙語標誌。與芬蘭語不同的是，它的字母表使用了字母 **c**。

text: Some pedestrian signs on Åland have **four stripes**, with the exact same design found in Sweden. Beware that many pedestrian signs will still be the typical Finnish design.
text_zh: 奧蘭的一些行人標誌有**四條條紋**，其設計與瑞典完全相同。請注意，許多行人標誌仍然會是典型的芬蘭設計。

text: Bus stops on Åland include a **white plate** with 4 numbers. Some also include this semicircle sign on top.
NOTE: Some bus stops in Mariehamn do not follow this rule.
text_zh: 奧蘭的公車站包括一個帶有 4 個數字的**白色牌子**。有些也在頂部包含這個半圓形標誌。
註記：瑪麗港的一些公車站不遵循這項規則。

text: You can find **Red rectangular metallic plates** with 7 golden or dark red coloured protrusions that form a rounded hexagon shape on houses, lamp posts, and signposts in Tampere.
text_zh: 你可以在坦佩雷的房屋、路燈桿和路標上找到**紅色金屬長方形牌子**，上面有 7 個金色或深紅色的突起，形成一個圓潤的六邊形形狀。

text: This style of **blue street sign **with white text is unique to the cities of Seinäjoki and [Isokyrö](https://goo.gl/maps/SdmNDAwLzkXPyN6z6) southeast of Vaasa.
text_zh: 這種帶有白字的**藍色路標**風格是瓦薩東南方的塞伊奈約基和[伊索屈勒](https://goo.gl/maps/SdmNDAwLzkXPyN6z6)兩市所特有的。

text: Lahti uses these street signs with a **black border** and all capital letters.

NOTE: You can rarely find similar signs in other cities, but Lahti almost exclusively uses this design. Notably, Kuopio can use these [signs](https://goo.gl/maps/wjdzkPYj7ba2NRGN7), which use a thicker, more compact font.
text_zh: 拉赫蒂使用這些帶有**黑色邊框**且全是大寫字母的路牌。
注意：你很少能在其他城市找到類似的標誌，但拉赫蒂幾乎完全使用這種設計。值得注意的是，庫奧皮奧可以使用這些[標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/wjdzkPYj7ba2NRGN7)，它們使用的是更粗、更緊湊的字體。

text: The city of Kerava uses street signs with this **blue-**and-**yellow **[coat of arms](https://fi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Keravan_vaakuna#/media/Tiedosto:Kerava.vaakuna.svg) in the top-left corner.
text_zh: 克拉瓦市使用左上角帶有這個**藍**黃相間[市徽](https://fi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Keravan_vaakuna#/media/Tiedosto:Kerava.vaakuna.svg)的路標。

text: The city of Järvenpää uses street signs with this **blue-**and-**grey **[coat of arms](https://fi.wikipedia.org/wiki/J%C3%A4rvenp%C3%A4%C3%A4n_vaakuna#/media/Tiedosto:Jarvenpaa.vaakuna.svg) in the top-left corner. The [neighbourhood](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1045971390202925086/1063500707099070514/Jarvenpaan_Alueet.png) name is also written above the street name.
NOTE: If you see a street sign with a coat of arms not mentioned in this guide, you should be near Kerava or Lahti.
text_zh: 耶爾文佩市使用左上角帶有這個**藍**灰相間[市徽](https://fi.wikipedia.org/wiki/J%C3%A4rvenp%C3%A4%C3%A4n_vaakuna#/media/Tiedosto:Jarvenpaa.vaakuna.svg)的路標。[鄰里](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1045971390202925086/1063500707099070514/Jarvenpaan_Alueet.png)名稱也寫在街道名稱的上方。
注意：如果你看到的街牌上有本指南未提及的市徽，你應該就在凱拉瓦或拉赫蒂附近。

text: **Paris**, **Lyon** and **Marseille** are the three largest cities in France and the only ones divided into **municipal arrondissements **(Arrᵗ or Arrt.** **for short). The arrondissements appear on google maps, so finding these street signs can help a lot with pinpointing.
The street signs of these three cities will be further described in the following tips.
text_zh: **巴黎**、**里昂**與**馬賽**是法國前三大城市，也是唯一劃分**市轄區**（municipal arrondissements，簡稱 Arrᵗ 或 Arrt.** **）的城市。這些行政區會顯示在 Google 地圖上，因此找到這些街道招牌對於精準定位非常有幫助。
這三個城市的街道招牌將在接下來的提示中進一步介紹。

text: Germany also has a wide variety of sign backs. Notably, you can commonly find **black** or **dark grey** sign backs, which are rather rare in Europe. Most signs will also feature this sticker, with an upside-down red triangle on a black rectangle.
NOTE: Italy, Romania and Albania also have black sign backs, however landscape should be sufficient to tell them apart.
text_zh: 德國也有各式各樣的標誌背面。值得注意的是，你經常可以找到**黑色**或**深灰色**的標誌背面，這在歐洲相當罕見。大多數標誌也都會貼上這個貼紙，上面是一個黑色長方形，裡面有倒置的紅色三角形。
註記：義大利、羅馬尼亞與阿爾巴尼亞也有黑色的標誌背面，但周遭景色通常就足以辨別它們。

text: German town entry signs are **yellow** with black text and have a **metallic frame**.
NOTE: These signs can include a lot of useful information too:
- !!The town and/or city name on the top.
- !!The Municipality in the middle.
- !!And the county on the bottom.
text_zh: 德國的城鎮入口標誌是**黃色**的，配有黑色文字和**金屬框**。
註記：這些標誌也可以包含許多實用的資訊：
- !!頂部是城鎮名稱。
- !!中間是市鎮名稱。
- !!底部是郡名。

text: German pedestrian signs have **five stripes** and the person has a **belt**.
NOTE: The same design is used in Luxembourg.
text_zh: 德國的人行穿越道標誌有**五條線**，且行人繫有**皮帶**。
註記：盧森堡也使用相同的設計。

text: These one-way traffic signs, with the word ‘**Einbahnstraße**’ written on them, are unique to Germany.
NOTE: In Austria, there will be “EINBAHN” written on the sign.
text_zh: 這些印有「**Einbahnstraße**」字樣的單行道標誌是德國特有的。
註記：在奧地利，標誌上會寫「EINBAHN」。

text: “No Stopping” and “No Waiting” signs in Germany will often have **white arrows** drawn on them.
text_zh: 德國的「禁止停車」與「禁止臨時停車」標誌通常會畫有**白色箭頭**。

text: **Bicycle direction signs** typically feature a white background with green lettering. In Hamburg, North Rhine-Westphalia and a neighbouring part of Lower Saxony, you will instead find red lettering. The Saarland has its own distinctive design, with white text on a dark green background.
text_zh: **自行車指示標誌**通常採用白底綠字。在漢堡、北萊茵-威斯伐倫以及下薩克森鄰近地區，你會看到紅字。薩爾蘭則有其獨特的設計，採用深綠底白字。

text: You can use the backs of street signs to regionguess Germany.
Here are examples of a [folded](https://goo.gl/maps/edxgzquC6mXrySvh9), and [flat](https://goo.gl/maps/5cw4KiWCdgYQXFzy7) sign back.
text_zh: 你可以利用路標的背面來對德國進行地區猜測。
以下是[折疊式](https://goo.gl/maps/edxgzquC6mXrySvh9)與[平整式](https://goo.gl/maps/5cw4KiWCdgYQXFzy7)標誌背面的範例。

text: You can also use the sign back connectors on street signs to regionguess Germany.
NOTE: The double connector on triangular signs are generally [wider](https://goo.gl/maps/zNwkDqQkt5vCVAGx7). T-shaped connectors may look like [this](https://goo.gl/maps/ru72EcB1fE3dt8zZA).
text_zh: 你也可以利用路標背面的連接器來對德國進行地區猜測。
NOTE: 三角形標誌上的雙連接器通常[較寬](https://goo.gl/maps/zNwkDqQkt5vCVAGx7)。T 型連接器看起來可能像[這樣](https://goo.gl/maps/ru72EcB1fE3dt8zZA)。

text: - [Berlin](https://goo.gl/maps/byoGqSgok1uhmjCy6) uses white signs with a grey border, and a separate section for numbers under the street name. Also note how the letter ß looks.
- [Munich](https://goo.gl/maps/RMshmDUSNucokmWN9) has blue street signs with a white decorative border that does not touch the corners. Also note the unique font.
- [Stuttgart](https://goo.gl/maps/fPFeuNukTiRTWoki7) uses **black** signs without a border.
- [Düsseldorf](https://goo.gl/maps/L9kbaYYwzV2iFE9n9) has **black** signs with a white border, similar to Munich. The signs have a **metallic frame.**
- [Dortmund](https://goo.gl/maps/3PhsxrNkq7oduns59) uses blue signs with a white border and a grey frame. The signs also have a separate section for numbers under the street name.
- [Essen](https://goo.gl/maps/wXngUHVBa2eS9CH2A) has blue signs with a very **thick** metallic frame.
- [Dresden](https://goo.gl/maps/S83P48x1grRfYR8H8) has blue signs with a unique font.
- [Hanover](https://goo.gl/maps/4oWah3dfDGep5sR6A) uses white signs with a **wider** than usual gap between the sign and metallic frame.
- [Nuremberg](https://goo.gl/maps/fUp3W4uEMsbFGtYH6) has blue signs with a unique font. The signs also have a grey frame with a small gap between it and the sign.
- [Wuppertal](https://goo.gl/maps/SUe7ExCD7S7SJDye7) uses white signs with a unique font and a white painted frame with a small gap between it and the sign.
- [Mainz](https://goo.gl/maps/bj8Mt4jAxn9duXodA) has a mix of blue signs, and this unique **red** variant.
- [Frankfurt ](https://goo.gl/maps/FDzr8ZLrSehrSAoC8)uses blue street signs with a metallic border around the sign, as well as the separate section for numbers under the street name.
NOTE: More rarely, some smaller towns can use similar signs to those in this graphic.
text_zh: - [柏林](https://goo.gl/maps/byoGqSgok1uhmjCy6)使用帶有灰色邊框的白色標誌，街道名稱下方有一個獨立區域來放置數字。同時注意字母 ß 的外觀。
- [慕尼黑](https://goo.gl/maps/RMshmDUSNucokmWN9)擁有藍色街道標誌，配有白色裝飾邊框，且邊框不觸及角落。同時注意其獨特的字型。
- [斯圖加特](https://goo.gl/maps/fPFeuNukTiRTWoki7)使用無邊框的**黑色**標誌。
- [杜塞道夫](https://goo.gl/maps/L9kbaYYwzV2iFE9n9)擁有帶有白色邊框的**黑色**標誌，類似於慕尼黑。這些標誌具有**金屬框。**
- [多特蒙德](https://goo.gl/maps/3PhsxrNkq7oduns59)使用帶有白色邊框和灰色框的藍色標誌。標誌在街道名稱下方也有一個獨立區域來放置數字。
- [埃森](https://goo.gl/maps/wXngUHVBa2eS9CH2A)擁有帶有非常**厚**金屬框的藍色標誌。
- [德勒斯登](https://goo.gl/maps/S83P48x1grRfYR8H8)擁有使用獨特字型的藍色標誌。
- [漢諾威](https://goo.gl/maps/4oWah3dfDGep5sR6A)使用白色標誌，標誌與金屬框之間的間距比平常**更寬**。
- [紐倫堡](https://goo.gl/maps/fUp3W4uEMsbFGtYH6)擁有使用獨特字型的藍色標誌。這些標誌還具有灰色框，且框與標誌之間有一小段間距。
- [伍珀塔爾](https://goo.gl/maps/SUe7ExCD7S7SJDye7)使用帶有獨特字型的白色標誌，以及白色塗漆框，框與標誌之間有一小段間距。
- [梅因斯](https://goo.gl/maps/bj8Mt4jAxn9duXodA)混合使用了藍色標誌以及這種獨特的**紅色**變體。
- [法蘭克福](https://goo.gl/maps/FDzr8ZLrSehrSAoC8)使用藍色街道標誌，標誌周圍有金屬邊框，且街道名稱下方有放置數字的獨立區域。
NOTE: 更罕見的是，某些較小的城鎮可能會使用與此圖形相似的標誌。

text: [Sorbian](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sorbian_languages), a **Slavic** language, is spoken near the Polish and Czech border. You can find it on a variety of signs in these regions.
text_zh: [索布語](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sorbian_languages)是一種**斯拉夫**語言，通行於波蘭和捷克邊境附近。你可以在這些地區的各種標誌上找到它。

text: Every city state uses a unique and recognisable bus stop.
- Berlin uses **segmented** bus stops, with a **yellow** signpost.
- Hamburg bus stops have a **red signpost**, and the route numbers are within **hexagons**. Note that they can be found outside of Hamburg as well.
- Bremen proper uses simple bus stops, which have the bus stop name within a **red section**. The edges can be rounded.
- Bremerhaven, which is still part of Bremen, uses bus stops with a **grey section** on the opposite side of the signpost. And the bus stop name is **red** within a **yellow** section.
text_zh: 每個城市邦都使用獨特且易於辨識的公車站。
- 柏林使用**分段式**公車站，配有**黃色**標誌柱。
- 漢堡公車站有一個**紅色標誌柱**，路線編號位於**六邊形**內。請注意，它們也可以在漢堡以外地區找到。
- 不萊梅本市使用簡單的公車站，其公車站名稱位於**紅色區段**內。邊緣可以是圓角。
布勒梅港（Bremerhaven）仍屬於布萊梅的一部分，其公車站牌的背面有一個**灰色區塊**。公車站名則顯示在**黃色**區塊內的**紅色**字體。

text: **Black and white **striped signposts in Ghana are typically seen in cities. On rural roads, you will mostly see classic, non-painted, metal signposts.
NOTE: Black and white signposts can be seen in other countries as well. Make sure to look at other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 迦納的**黑白**相間路標通常出現在城市中。在鄉村道路上，你主要會看到傳統、未上漆的金屬路標。
註：黑白路標在其他國家也能看到。在作猜測之前，務必觀察其他線索。

text: The main language used in Gibraltar is **English**. This can be especially helpful if you see English on official signs in a Mediterranean setting.
NOTE: Note that English is also one of the main languages of Malta, which also has a Mediterranean landscape and vibe.
text_zh: 直布羅陀使用的主要語言是**英語**。如果你在地中海風情的環境中看到英文，這會特別有幫助。
註：請注意，英語也是馬爾他（Malta）的主要語言之一，馬爾他同樣擁有地中海景觀和氛圍。

text: Greek warning signs have a red border and a **yellow background**.
text_zh: 希臘的警告標誌具有紅色邊框和**黃色背景**。

text: Greek directional signs are typically blue and arrow shaped. One of the most recognisable features are the place names, which are written in Greek with a **yellow font**, and in English with a white font.
text_zh: 希臘的方向標誌通常是藍色且呈箭頭形。最具辨識度的特徵之一是地名，這些地名是用**黃色字體**的希臘文以及白色字體的英文書寫的。

text: Greek town entry signs are white with thick **horizontal blue stripes** at the top and bottom.
text_zh: 希臘城鎮入口標誌為白色，頂部和底部都有厚實的**水平藍色條紋**。

text: Pedestrian signs have **two dotted horizontal lines**, rather than vertical stripes.
text_zh: 行人標誌有**兩條虛線水平線**，而不是垂直條紋。

text: Guam uses **green** street signs, unlike the Northern Mariana Islands, which use blue street signs.
text_zh: 關島使用**綠色**的街道標誌，這點與使用藍色街道標誌的北馬利安納群島不同。

text: Some Signposts near the town of Apra View are coloured **yellow**.
text_zh: 阿普拉景觀（Apra View）城鎮附近的某些路標是**黃色**的。

text: Like Mexico, Panama and Costa Rica, Guatemala uses the word “**ALTO**” on stop signs.
text_zh: 如同墨西哥、巴拿馬與哥斯大黎加，瓜地馬拉在停止標誌上使用「**ALTO**」這個詞。

text: Hawaii is the only state to use its own language, though English is still predominantly used. Most **place names** are in Hawaiian, so you can spot it on street signs, and other road markers.
- Hawaiian is a vowel-oriented language that only uses eight consonants: H, K, L, M, N, P, W, and (ʻ), called an [ʻOkina](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/%CA%BBOkina).
- Every Hawaiian word ends in one of 5 vowels: A, E, I, O, or U.
- Each vowel can also have a [macron](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Macron_(diacritic)) over it: Ā, Ē, Ī, Ō, and Ū.
These vowels are often combined to make [Diphthongs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Diphthong). I.e. UI, AI, AE, etc...
text_zh: 夏威夷是唯一使用自身語言的州，不過英語仍然佔壓倒性多數的使用率。大多數**地名**都是夏威夷語，因此你可以在路標和其他道路標誌上發現它。
- 夏威夷語是一種以母音為主的語言，只使用八個子音：H、K、L、M、N、P、W 和 (ʻ)，稱為 [ʻOkina](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/%CA%BBOkina)。
- 每個夏威夷單字都以 A、E、I、O 或 U 這 5 個母音之一結尾。
- 每個母音上方也可以加上[長音符](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Macron_(diacritic))：Ā、Ē、Ī、Ō 和 Ū。
這些母音經常組合在一起形成[雙母音](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Diphthong)。例如 UI、AI、AE 等...

text: Hawaii uses highway shields that resemble a **guitar pick**, with the numbers on the bottom of the shield. Most highway signs also use [yellow signposts](https://www.google.com/maps/@20.0269917,-155.6992435,3a,23y,129.32h,81.85t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s6nWi-67_zbEbhaLQER2TOg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?coh=205409&entry=ttu).
text_zh: 夏威夷使用酷似**吉他彈片**的高速公路盾牌標誌，數字位於盾牌底部。大多數公路標誌也使用[黃色路標柱](https://www.google.com/maps/@20.0269917,-155.6992435,3a,23y,129.32h,81.85t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s6nWi-67_zbEbhaLQER2TOg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?coh=205409&entry=ttu)。

text: Hong Kong has two official languages: **English and Chinese** (legally, no variety is specified, but residents primarily speak Cantonese).
Bilingual signs are common, with English next to traditional Chinese characters.
text_zh: 香港有兩種官方語言：**英文與中文**（法律上未指定具體語種，但居民主要說粵語）。
雙語標誌很常見，英文與繁體中文並列。

text: Road signs are white and rectangular, with a thick black outline and **bilingual **text.
text_zh: 道路標誌為白色長方形，帶有粗黑色邊框以及**雙語**文字。

text: Give way signs feature a white upside down triangle with a **thick red** border and bilingual text.
text_zh: 讓路標誌為白色的倒三角形，帶有**粗紅色**邊框與雙語文字。

text: Hong Kong taxis come in two variants: sedans or station wagons, with the **sedans **most commonly seen. They can be easily identified by their silver roofs, green stickers on the front and rear bumper, and the taxi sign on the roof.

Red taxis are most common on Hong Kong Island and Kowloon, green taxis in the New Territories in the northern region and blue taxis on Lantau Island and Chek Lap Kok. Keep in mind, Hong Kong is a small city and taxis travel all around it.
text_zh: 香港計程車有兩種車型：轎車（sedan）或旅行車（station wagon），其中以**轎車**最為常見。它們的特徵很容易辨認：銀色車頂、前後保險桿上的綠色貼紙，以及車頂上的計程車招牌。
紅色的士（計程車）最常出現在香港島和九龍，綠色的士出現在北部地區的新界，藍色的士則出現在大嶼山和赤鱲角。請記住，香港是個小城市，計程車會開到各個地方。

text: Hungarian sign posts commonly appear to be **abnormally tall**, often taller than the Street View camera.
text_zh: 匈牙利的路標通常看起來**異常高**，往往比街景相機還要高。

text: Hungarian signs are usually bolted to the sign post using **four bolts**, going through the sign, in the shape of a tall rectangle.
NOTE: This is not common in any other Eastern European countries.
text_zh: 匈牙利的路標通常使用**四個螺栓**固定在路標柱上，螺栓穿過路標，呈高大的長方形形狀。
注意：這在其他東歐國家並不常見。

text: Hungarian pedestrian crossing signs have **five stripes**. The person is wearing a **belt**. There is also a second, less common, type with four stripes and the person holding a bag.
The belt is located noticeably **low** on the person’s body, almost as if the person is sagging his pants. This is unique to Hungary.
NOTE: Among neighbouring countries, Croatia and Slovakia also have five stripes and a belt.
text_zh: 匈牙利的人行穿越道標誌有**五條條紋**。行人繫著**皮帶**。還有第二種較不常見的類型，有四條條紋且行人拿著包包。
皮帶位於行人身體明顯**偏低**的位置，幾乎就像那個人把褲子穿得很垮一樣。這是匈牙利特有的。
注意：在鄰國中，克羅埃西亞和斯洛伐克也有五條線條與皮帶。

text: Apart from European highways, there are two types of numbered roads in Hungary; roads marked with **green signs**, and highways beginning with the letter ‘**M**’, marked with **blue signs**. These road numbers are contained within a small shield shape on the sign.
text_zh: 除了歐洲高速公路外，匈牙利還有兩種編號道路；標有**綠色標誌**的道路，以及以字母「**M**」開頭、標有**藍色標誌**的高速公路。這些道路編號包含在標誌上的一個小型盾形圖案中。

text: Most directional signs are green, having a white inner border and a green outer border. Directional signs on M-numbered highways are blue, having a white inner border and a blue outer border.
text_zh: 多數方向指標誌為綠色，具有白色內邊框與綠色外邊框。M 字開頭的高速公路方向指標誌則為藍色，具有白色內邊框與藍色外邊框。

text: If you see a street sign with a **thick metal frame** around it, you are very likely to be in the **western** parts of the country.
text_zh: 如果你看到路標周圍有**厚金屬框**，你非常有可能身處該國的**西部**地區。

text: This infographic showcases ten of the largest towns and cities with **unique street signs**, and explains what makes them unique.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 這張資訊圖表展示了十個擁有**獨特路標**的較大城鎮與城市，並解釋了它們獨特的原因。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: The road direction signs of Iceland are **yellow**. They usually have a white inset box that shows the road numbers. If the inset box has a dashed border, the number listed refers to a nearby road, not the road you are currently on.
NOTE: Direction signs for very local destinations, such as farmsteads, typically have different background colours: blue or white.
text_zh: 冰島的道路方向標誌是**黃色**的。它們通常帶有一個白色的嵌入方框，上面顯示道路編號。如果嵌入方框有虛線邊框，則所列出的編號是指附近的道路，而非你目前所在的道路。
注意：非常本地的目的地（例如農莊）的方向標誌，通常具有不同的背景顏色：藍色或白色。

text: Icelandic pedestrian signs feature **four stripes** and often have a **slight yellow tint**.
NOTE: Iceland is the only European country that uses pedestrian signs with a yellow background.
text_zh: 冰島的行人穿越道標誌具有**四條條紋**，且通常帶有**微弱的黃色調**。
注意：冰島是唯一使用黃底行人穿越道標誌的歐洲國家。

text: Iceland’s street signs use a white background and black text. They often have a **thin metal rim** and are attached to lampposts or traffic lights.
text_zh: 冰島的街道標誌使用白色背景與黑色文字。它們通常有**細金屬邊框**，並固定在路燈桿或紅綠燈上。

text: Just like Sweden and Finland, Icelandic signs feature a **yellow background**.
text_zh: 就像瑞典和芬蘭一樣，冰島的標誌具有**黃色背景**。

text: Iceland has a very sensible **road numbering system** that allows for quick 5k’s, provided you find the yellow direction signs that list the road numbers of the intersection you are on.
The main ring road, which circles the entire island, simply has the number 1. There are no other roads that start with 1.

The first digit of the other road numbers is region-specific. These regions have a sequential distribution around the island, starting from 2 in the south and increasing up until 9 in a clockwise direction (see map for approximate distribution).
text_zh: 冰島有一個非常合理的**道路編號系統**，只要你能找到列有所處路口道路編號的黃色方向標誌，就能快速進行 5k（滿分猜題）。
環繞整座島嶼的主要環島公路編號就是簡單的 1。沒有其他道路以 1 開頭。
其他道路編號的第一位數是依地區而定。這些地區在島上呈順序分佈，從南部的 2 開始，以順時針方向遞增直到 9（大致分佈請參見地圖）。

text: Barren landscapes consisting mostly of** dark volcanic gravel**, with little to no vegetation or signs of life, are typical of the inland regions of Iceland. Most such covered roads are located in the east.
text_zh: 主要由**深色火山礫石**組成的荒涼地景，幾乎沒有植被或生命跡象，是冰島內陸地區的典型特徵。大多數此類有覆蓋的道路都位於東部。

text: India typically has **black and white striped signposts**.
NOTE: Bangladesh, Nepal and Sri Lanka also have black and white signposts.
text_zh: 印度通常有**黑白相間的標示柱**。
注意：孟加拉、尼泊爾和斯里蘭卡也有黑白標示柱。

text: The City of Chandigarh is a **planned industrial city**. As a result, the city features a lot of unique infrastructure, such as [blue signs](https://goo.gl/maps/HAYdSmx9sEsf2kbZ8) mentioning sectors and industrial areas, round yellow markings on street lights, and [street signs](https://www.google.com/maps/@30.7499192,76.7780503,3a,16.1y,130.5h,95.4t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sPVs101xGkIhtQvDG4dwKtA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) which will typically feature [several numbers](https://www.google.com/maps/@30.7250865,76.7767257,3a,15y,43.08h,74.38t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1shEU9Ii83j_XOg74Ltm5G1Q!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) rather than street names.

NOTE: The nearby cities of [Sahibzada Ajit Singh Nagar](https://www.google.com/maps/@30.7021706,76.7282816,3a,15y,307.52h,103.68t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sq0D20ET6KxQ-CQ2ZRgdqog!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) and [Panchkula](https://www.google.com/maps/@30.6802307,76.8513495,3a,15y,85.06h,89.37t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sOcviMvOxgJKg32g23wdDhg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) are also planned industrial cities, which feature somewhat similar signs.
text_zh: 昌迪加爾市是一座**計畫工業城市**。因此，該市擁有許多獨特的基礎設施，例如提及區塊和工業區的[藍色標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/HAYdSmx9sEsf2kbZ8)、路燈上的圓形黃色標記，以及通常會標示[多個數字](https://www.google.com/maps/@30.7499192,76.7780503,3a,16.1y,130.5h,95.4t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sPVs101xGkIhtQvDG4dwKtA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)而非街道名稱的[街道標誌](https://www.google.com/maps/@30.7250865,76.7767257,3a,15y,43.08h,74.38t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1shEU9Ii83j_XOg74Ltm5G1Q!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)。

注意：附近的[薩希卜扎達阿吉特辛格納加爾](https://www.google.com/maps/@30.7021706,76.7282816,3a,15y,307.52h,103.68t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sq0D20ET6KxQ-CQ2ZRgdqog!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)和[潘奇庫拉](https://www.google.com/maps/@30.6802307,76.8513495,3a,15y,85.06h,89.37t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sOcviMvOxgJKg32g23wdDhg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)等鄰近城市也是計畫工業城市，擁有類似的標誌。

text: Ireland is the only European country that uses yellow **diamond-shaped** warning signs.
Note that this only applies to warning signs. Regulatory signs (circles and upside down triangles) have the normal red border and white background, like most other European countries.
text_zh: 愛爾蘭是唯一使用黃色**菱形**警告標誌的歐洲國家。
請注意，這僅適用於警告標誌。管制標誌（圓形和倒三角形）具有正常的紅邊和白底，就像大多數其他歐洲國家一樣。

text: Irish yield signs feature the word “**YIELD**”.
NOTE: UK yield signs have the phrase “GIVE WAY”.
text_zh: 愛爾蘭的讓路標誌上有「**YIELD**」這個字。
注意：英國的讓路標誌上有「GIVE WAY」字樣。

text: Pedestrian crossing signs are somewhat rare in Ireland. They are yellow and diamond-shaped, like other road signs.
Instead of pedestrian signs, you will often see these **black and white signposts** with a yellow bulb on top.
Note that the UK uses exactly the same signposts.
text_zh: 愛爾蘭的行人穿越道標誌相對罕見。它們是黃色且呈菱形，與其他道路標誌類似。
你會經常看到這些**黑白標誌柱**上方帶有黃色燈泡，而不是行人穿越道標誌。
請注意，英國使用的標誌柱完全相同。

text: Many street signs in Ramsey feature the** oval shaped coat of arms**.
text_zh: 拉姆齊的許多路標上都有**橢圓形紋章**。

text: The** coat of arms** is placed** above the text** on many signs in Port Erin.
text_zh: 在埃林港（Port Erin）的許多標誌上，**紋章**被放置在**文字上方**。

text: Rather than having a word meaning ‘stop’ written on them, stop signs have a **hand** painted on them.
text_zh: 停止標誌上面沒有寫著代表「停止」的單詞，而是畫了一隻**手**。

text: These **white** rectangular signs with a thin **blue border** are typically found in Jerusalem.
text_zh: 這些帶有細**藍色邊框**的**白色**長方形標誌通常可以在耶路撒冷找到。

text: These **yellow** fences and signposts are unique to Kiryat Motzkin.
text_zh: 這些**黃色**圍欄和路標是基爾亞特莫茨金（Kiryat Motzkin）特有的。

text: Blue house numbers with the number written with [Arabic numerals](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arabic_numerals) in the top left and with [Eastern Arabic numerals](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eastern_Arabic_numerals) in the bottom right, with a thin **diagonal line** between them, can be found in Bethlehem. [Street signs](https://goo.gl/maps/eouNa6SnvDgD8WQr9) will generally have the same format.
text_zh: 藍色門牌號碼，左上角用[阿拉伯數字](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arabic_numerals)書寫，右下角用[東阿拉伯數字](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eastern_Arabic_numerals)書寫，兩者之間有一條細**斜線**，可以在伯利恆找到。[街道標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/eouNa6SnvDgD8WQr9)通常也會採用相同的格式。

text: Roundabout signs which are either very **thick** or attached to a **large cube**, can be found in the city of Raanana.
text_zh: 非常**厚**或附著在**大立方體**上的圓環標誌，可以在賴阿納納（Raanana）市找到。

text: Japanese is written with a mixture of **three main systems**: kanji and two syllabic scripts: hiragana and katakana. Formal signs and texts will mostly use kanji and hiragana. The kanji system is directly borrowed from Chinese and thus looks very similar, while the syllabic scripts are more loosely inspired by Chinese. Hiragana generally looks simpler than Chinese characters, many of the symbols have loops, which are not present in Chinese. The shapes are also typically slightly softer than the shapes present in most kanji.
_You can learn more about hiragana, katakana and kanji in the region guessing section, learning frequent terms and names._
text_zh: 日文由**三套文字系統**混合書寫：漢字，以及平假名與片假名兩種音節文字。正式標誌與文書多以漢字和平假名為主。漢字直接源自中文，因此外觀非常相似；音節文字則只是鬆散地受中文啟發。平假名整體比漢字簡單，許多字符帶有圈狀的迴繞筆畫，這在中文裡看不到，字形線條也通常比漢字柔和一些。
_平假名、片假名與漢字的細節，以及常見詞彙與地名，可參考「都道府縣專屬線索」那一節。_

text: Prefecture roads are identified by their **hexagonal-shaped** shields. The prefecture is often written under the road number in kanji. While the shield design remains, other variations can be found:
- On [prefectural highway shields](https://goo.gl/maps/6PsFbdz9gtDyGWbs9) (with kanji).
- On directional [intersection](https://goo.gl/maps/jsWfsJUW3r7JjE8v5) signs.
- Or on small, directional [arrow](https://goo.gl/maps/WrtbZh2DYQ6B4YYh7) signs.
As multiple prefectures can have the same road number, it is recommended to first find the prefecture you are in.
text_zh: 縣道以**六角形**路牌標示，編號下方通常用漢字寫著所屬都道府縣。六角形的樣式不變，但會出現在不同載體上：
- [縣道標誌牌](https://goo.gl/maps/6PsFbdz9gtDyGWbs9)本身（附漢字）。
- 路口的[方向指示牌](https://goo.gl/maps/jsWfsJUW3r7JjE8v5)上。
- 或是小型的[箭頭指示牌](https://goo.gl/maps/WrtbZh2DYQ6B4YYh7)上。
由於不同都道府縣可能有相同的道路編號，建議先確認自己在哪一縣再查編號。

text: Some frequently seen infrastructure in Japan consists of:
- This unique [stop sign](https://goo.gl/maps/RYbbcM52HxH5rjvB6).
- A school [pedestrian crossing](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kp1Biy8pumCZtfsu5).
- And these traffic [mirrors](https://goo.gl/maps/RvMvRRrnmGWL4Z9CA).
While many infrastructural clues exist, these three are very common, and may very well help you identify Japan on a difficult round.
text_zh: 日本常見的道路設施還包括：
- 這種獨特的[停車標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/RYbbcM52HxH5rjvB6)。
- 學校周邊的[行人穿越道標誌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kp1Biy8pumCZtfsu5)。
- 以及這種[反射鏡](https://goo.gl/maps/RvMvRRrnmGWL4Z9CA)。
道路設施的線索很多，但這三種特別常見，在難題回合中往往就靠它們認出日本。

text: Most Japanese prefectures have unique stickers you can find on their signposts.
text_zh: 多數都道府縣的標誌桿上都貼有各自專屬的貼紙。

text: These specific **black **signs with **two yellow circles** are found in Kagawa. Other variations can be seen, including them [stacked](https://goo.gl/maps/vu57GaqMEYEVbA8h6) on top of each other, or with an [arrow attached](https://goo.gl/maps/ijaCjxnsvDk9ohwZ7) above.
text_zh: 這種**黑底**加**兩個黃色圓點**的標誌出現在香川縣。也有其他變體，例如[上下疊放](https://goo.gl/maps/vu57GaqMEYEVbA8h6)，或上方[加裝箭頭](https://goo.gl/maps/ijaCjxnsvDk9ohwZ7)。

text: **Cyrillic **can be found on signs in the cities of Wakkanai and Nemuro, in northern Hokkaido.
text_zh: 北海道北部的稚內市與根室市，招牌上找得到**西里爾字母**。

text: In general, road infrastructure is **similar **to that found in the United Kingdom. This includes driving on the [left](https://goo.gl/maps/fcPxAUuyzEzRf9Ak7), as well as [directional signs](https://goo.gl/maps/kNsowiMi9Dd68QKt5), [chevrons](https://goo.gl/maps/NBkNUYfGXL1baFQr8) and [warning signs](https://goo.gl/maps/dK5pbVjsHtbSjTAo6). Some of the subtle differences are discussed below.
text_zh: 一般來說，道路基礎設施與英國發現的**相似**。這包括靠[左](https://goo.gl/maps/fcPxAUuyzEzRf9Ak7)行駛，以及[方向標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/kNsowiMi9Dd68QKt5)、[轉彎標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/NBkNUYfGXL1baFQr8)與[警告標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/dK5pbVjsHtbSjTAo6)。以下將討論一些細微的差異。

text: Due to its proximity to France, the vast majority of street and locality names contain **French **words. The island’s traditional language, known as [Jèrriais](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/J%C3%A8rriais), is closely related to French and appears on some [signs](https://goo.gl/maps/gfXPVEU3CehwnLD79).
text_zh: 由於鄰近法國，絕大多數的街道和地名都包含**法文**單字。該島的傳統語言被稱為[澤西語](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/J%C3%A8rriais)，與法語密切相關，並出現在一些[路標](https://goo.gl/maps/gfXPVEU3CehwnLD79)上。

text: Jersey has an extensive network of cycling routes. Most notably, you will find [signs](https://goo.gl/maps/i9MW5htcqMZYhqRq9) referencing the start or end of a **“Green Lane”**. Blue [**route markers**](https://goo.gl/maps/kqz88wFjRsujGHFx5), containing a map of the island in the centre, are also common.
text_zh: 澤西島擁有廣泛的自行車道網路。最值得注意的是，你會找到提及**「綠色通道」**起點或終點的[標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/i9MW5htcqMZYhqRq9)。中心印有該島地圖的藍色[**路線標記**](https://goo.gl/maps/kqz88wFjRsujGHFx5)也很常見。

text: Some road signs are **asymmetrically **attached to their signposts. This appears to be more prevalent on Jersey than on the British mainland.
NOTE: Keep in mind that this only applies to a minority of signs. Most are attached regularly.
text_zh: 有些道路標誌是**非對稱地**固定在支柱上。這在澤西島似乎比在英國本土更為普遍。
註：請記住，這僅適用於少數標誌。大多數都是正常安裝的。

text: Most street name signs in Jersey are adorned with the **coat of arms** of the parish in which they are located.
_You can click on the graphic to enlarge it._
text_zh: 澤西島的大多數路名標誌都裝飾有所屬教區的**紋章**。
_你可以點擊圖片將其放大。_

text: The official language used in Jordan is **Arabic** and can be identified by its lines and dots.
NOTE: Unlike the UAE, Jordan does not have English writing on most commercial signs. This can be helpful to distinguish the two countries.
text_zh: 約旦使用的官方語言是**阿拉伯語**，可以透過其線條和點來辨識。
註：與阿拉伯聯合大公國不同，約旦的大多數商業標誌上沒有英文書寫。這有助於區分這兩個國家。

text: Street Signs in Kazakhstan are often attached to buildings and are **blue **in colour, with white intricate patterns on the top and bottom. They are usually **bilingual or trilingual** and can also contain a **QR code**.
NOTE: They are often inconsistent, with many designs being found in a single city.
text_zh: 哈薩克的路標通常固定在建築物上，呈**藍色**，頂部和底部有白色的複雜圖案。它們通常是**雙語或三語**的，並且可能包含 **QR 碼**。
注意：這些標誌通常很不一致，在同一個城市中可以找到許多不同的設計。

text: While rarely possible, being able to read the letters under a QR code on a street sign will give you the region.
text_zh: 雖然極少數情況下可行，但如果能讀懂路牌上 QR 碼下方的字母，就能知道所在的地區。

text: These street signs attached to buildings are generally quite inconsistent, but there are some worth knowing.
- Aktobe has compact signs where half of the space is taken by the QR code.
- Petropavl uses white signs, with a blue semicircle below the street names.
- Astana consistently uses this fairly generic design.
- Zhetisay also uses a fairly generic design, but it is not found in Turkistan or Shymkent.
text_zh: 這些貼在建築物上的街道標示通常不太一致，但有些值得知道。
- 阿克托貝有精巧的標示，其中一半的空間被 QR 碼佔據。
- 彼得羅巴夫爾使用白色標示，街名下方有一個藍色半圓形。
- 阿斯塔納一直以來都使用這種相當通用的設計。
- 熱特阿賽（Zhetisay）也使用相當通用的設計，但在突厥斯坦或奇姆肯特找不到。

text: This section of road goes through mountains that have **rocky cliffs**. These mountains are a habitat for lots of [spruce trees](https://goo.gl/maps/6ykqFWDntTbrPQnX6) that grow on the cliff sides. A more diverse selection of trees grows next to the river that follows the road. You can see that [some mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/ZYdKwBNtUvT3WQH8A) still have snow on the peaks. Most [signposts](https://goo.gl/maps/bRKCMi9bDmj5YCQV6) along the road are coloured blue.
NOTE: The southern section of the road features more rocky cliffs that cannot sustain any trees.
text_zh: 這段路穿過擁有**岩石懸崖**的山區。這些山脈是許多生長在懸崖邊的[雲杉樹](https://goo.gl/maps/6ykqFWDntTbrPQnX6)的棲息地。順著道路流淌的河流旁生長著更多樣化的樹木。你可以看到[有些山峰](https://goo.gl/maps/ZYdKwBNtUvT3WQH8A)頂端仍有積雪。沿路的 plupart [路標](https://goo.gl/maps/bRKCMi9bDmj5YCQV6)都是藍色的。
注意：該道路的南部路段有更多無法支撐任何樹木生長的陡峭岩壁。

text: **Stop signs** feature the Lao script. Sometimes, the sign features the word ‘stop’ in Latin script below the Lao script.
NOTE: In Laos, stop signs only have **2 characters,** compared to 3 in Thailand.
text_zh: **停止標誌**具有寮國文字。有時，標誌在寮國文字下方會標有拉丁字母的「stop」一詞。
註記：在寮國，停止標誌只有**2個字元，**相較之下泰國有3個。

text: Within Laos, **blue sign backs** are only found in Luang Prabang.
text_zh: 在寮國境內，**藍色標誌背面**僅見於龍坡邦。

text: Vang Vieng is also very **touristic**: you will see a lot of signs for hotels, guesthouses, and other tourism-related enterprises. In the (very few) rounds that the distinct mountains are blocked by buildings, this is a good way to recognize the town.
text_zh: 旺陽也非常**觀光化**：你會看到大量關於飯店、民宿和其他旅遊相關企業的招牌。在特異山脈被建築物擋住的（極少數）回合中，這是識別該城鎮的好方法。

text: Each Baltic country has a slightly different border for its warning and speed signs.
Latvian signs have a **thick** red border, with a **thin white outline** around it.
text_zh: 每個波羅的海國家的警告標誌與速限標誌邊框略有不同。
拉脫維亞標誌具有**粗**紅邊框，周圍有一圈**細白外框**。

text: Latvian pedestrian signs have **five stripes**, which is unique within the Baltics. Uniquely, the pedestrian has noticeably **long legs** compared to pedestrian signs in other European countries.
The other two Baltic countries have three stripes on their pedestrian signs.
text_zh: 拉脫維亞的行人標誌有**五條條紋**，這在波羅的海國家中是獨一無二的。獨特的是，與其他歐洲國家的行人標誌相比，行人的**腿明顯很長**。
其他兩個波羅的海國家的行人標誌上有三條條紋。

text: Latvian bus stop signs have this design.
Most importantly, the bus has **five windows**. Within the Baltics, this is unique to Latvia. The other two Baltic countries have four windows.
text_zh: 拉脫維亞公車站牌採用這種設計。
最重要的是，公車有**五扇窗戶**。在波羅的海國家中，這是拉脫維亞獨有的。其他兩個波羅的海國家有四扇窗戶。

text: Latvian directional signs are blue with white text.

NOTE: The arrow on Latvian signs is more stylized than in [Estonia](https://goo.gl/maps/eW7AJWdVriTfsprx7) and [Lithuania](https://goo.gl/maps/17A5xxGivFmbs4ae8), where the back part of the arrowhead is vertical.
text_zh: 拉脫維亞的指路標誌為藍底白字。
注意：拉脫維亞標誌上的箭頭比[愛沙尼亞](https://goo.gl/maps/eW7AJWdVriTfsprx7)和[立陶宛](https://goo.gl/maps/17A5xxGivFmbs4ae8)的箭頭更具設計感，後兩者的箭頭後方是垂直的。

text: Bus stops in Liechtenstein use a **green-and-white** design, with a black metallic border around the sign. The phrase LIEMOBIL is written at the top.
NOTE: The metallic frame is not always black.
text_zh: 列支敦斯登的公車站採用**綠白相間**的設計，標誌周圍有一圈黑色金屬邊框。頂部寫著 LIEMOBIL 字樣。
注意：金屬框不一定都是黑色的。

text: Like Switzerland, directional signs in Liechtenstein are generally white (smaller roads) or blue (bigger roads), and they have a pointed arrowhead, with a contrasting colour.
text_zh: 如同瑞士，列支敦斯登的指示牌通常是白色（較小的道路）或藍色（較大的道路），且它們有帶有對比顏色的尖形箭頭。

text: Liechtenstein pedestrian signs have **seven stripes**. The signs also have an oddly tall rectangle.
NOTE: Switzerland uses identical signs.
text_zh: 列支敦斯登的行人標誌有**七條條紋**。這些標誌也是奇特的長方形。
注意：瑞士使用相同的標誌。

text: Road signs in Liechtenstein commonly have a round, grey **metal border** around them.
NOTE: Swiss and German signs can also have similar metallic borders.
text_zh: 列支敦斯登的路標周圍通常有一個圓形的灰色**金屬邊框**。
注意：瑞士和德國的標誌也可能有類似的金屬邊框。

text: Unlike the rest of Liechtenstein, Vaduz sometimes uses **red bus stop signs.**
NOTE: ** **Regular bus stops are also present.
text_zh: 與列支敦斯登其他地區不同，瓦都茲（Vaduz）有時會使用**紅色的公車站牌。**
注意：** **一般公車站也看得到。

text: Unlike the rest of Liechtenstein, Balzers sometimes uses **black bus stop signs.**
NOTE: ** **Regular bus stops are also present.
text_zh: 與列支敦斯登其他地區不同，巴爾澤斯（Balzers）有時會使用**黑色的公車站牌。**
注意：** **一般公車站也看得到。

text: Blue street signs with a thin white border will place you either in the south of Liechtenstein or in the north around Bandern.
text_zh: 帶有細白邊框的藍色街道標誌會將你定位在列支敦斯登南部，或是北部班德恩周圍。

text: Blue street signs that don’t have an outline are found in Eschen.
text_zh: 沒有外框的藍色街道標誌可以在埃申找到。

text: Flat black signs are found in eastern Liechtenstein.
text_zh: 扁平的黑色標誌可以在列支敦斯登東部找到。

text: Black signs with a white border and embossed letters can be found in Schaan.
text_zh: 帶有白色邊框和浮雕字體的黑色標誌可以在沙恩找到。

text: These brown street signs with a font reminiscent of **traditional German typefaces**, along with a white border, are found in Vaduz and the northern towns.
text_zh: 這些棕色路標具有讓人聯想起**傳統德文字體**的字型以及白色邊框，可以在瓦都茲和北部城鎮找到。

text: Brown street signs that have an **arrow design** are unique to Ruggell.
NOTE: The regular brown signs are also present in Ruggell.
text_zh: 具有**箭頭設計**的棕色路標是魯格爾（Ruggell）特有的。
注意：一般的棕色標誌在魯格爾也找得到。

text: Browns signs which have a more ‘generic’ font will place you in Planken.
text_zh: 字體更「通用」的棕色標誌會將你定位在普蘭肯。

text: Lithuania uses **white chevrons with red arrows**. The small single chevrons (pictured here) usually have a **red outline** on the edge of the sign.
NOTE: Many other European countries, including Latvia and Poland, use the same chevrons (though without the red outline).
!!However, Estonia, Russia and Ukraine use chevrons with the opposite colour scheme: red with white arrows.
text_zh: 立陶宛使用**白底紅箭頭的轉彎標誌**。小型單個轉彎標誌（如圖所示）通常在標誌邊緣帶有**紅色外框**。
注意：許多其他歐洲國家（包括拉脫維亞和波蘭）也使用相同的轉彎標誌（但沒有紅色外框）。
!!然而，愛沙尼亞、俄羅斯和烏克蘭使用的是配色相反的轉彎標誌：紅底白箭頭。

text: All Baltic countries use the same blue kilometre marker. However, they can be distinguished from each other by their angle relative to the road.
In Lithuania, the marker will be at a **45° angle** towards the road. The sign itself has an L-shape.
For a quick overview of all three Baltic countries, see [this infographic](/images/lithuania/baltics_kmmarkerinfographic.png).
text_zh: 所有波羅的海國家都使用相同的藍色公里標示牌。不過，可以透過它們相對於道路的角度來彼此區分。
在立陶宛，標誌與道路呈**45度角**。標誌本身呈 L 形。
若要快速概覽所有三個波海國家，請參閱[這張資訊圖表](/images/lithuania/baltics_kmmarkerinfographic.png)。

text: Each Baltic country has a slightly different border for its warning and speed signs.
Lithuanian signs have a relatively **thin** red border, with a **thin white outline** around it.
text_zh: 每個波羅的海國家的警告標誌與速限標誌邊框略有不同。
立陶宛的標誌具有相對**較薄**的紅色邊框，周圍有一圈**細白色外框**。

text: Lithuanian pedestrian signs have **3 stripes**. The shape of the pedestrian has a relatively low level of detail.

NOTE: Both [Russia](https://www.google.com/maps/@55.7423905,37.5885686,3a,15y,227.43h,93.29t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sM2IafnQY_X5LJKXlumRVzQ!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3DM2IafnQY_X5LJKXlumRVzQ%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D122.40399%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu) and [Ukraine](https://goo.gl/maps/KBnV7gubZHs349dc8) share the same design.** **[Estonian](https://goo.gl/maps/5vqjNxsfM1wHnxSw5) signs also have 3 stripes, but the pedestrian looks more detailed.
!!Latvian pedestrian signs have 5 stripes.
text_zh: 立陶宛的行人號誌有 **3 條橫紋**。行人圖案的細節相對較少。

注意：[俄羅斯](https://www.google.com/maps/@55.7423905,37.5885686,3a,15y,227.43h,93.29t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sM2IafnQY_X5LJKXlumRVzQ!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3DM2IafnQY_X5LJKXlumRVzQ%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D122.40399%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)與[烏克蘭](https://goo.gl/maps/KBnV7gubZHs349dc8)採用相同的設計。** **[愛沙尼亞](https://goo.gl/maps/5vqjNxsfM1wHnxSw5)的標誌也有 3 條橫紋，但行人圖案看起來更精細。
!!拉脫維亞的行人標誌有 5 條紋。

text: Lithuanian bus stop signs have this design.
The bus has **four windows**. This is mostly useful to distinguish it from the Latvian bus stop sign, which has five windows.
Note however, that Estonia has the same bus stop signs as Lithuania.
text_zh: 立陶宛的公車站牌採用這種設計。
公車有**四扇窗戶**。這主要有助於將其與擁有五扇窗戶的拉脫維亞公車站牌區分開來。
不過要注意的是，愛沙尼亞的公車站牌跟立陶宛的一樣。

text: The Lithuanian word for street is **gatve**, often abbreviated as **g.** on signs and Google Maps.
This word is almost entirely unique to Lithuanian. However, very rarely, you might see ‘gatve’ (abbreviated as gat.) in the Latvian capital of Riga.
text_zh: 立陶宛語的街道是 **gatve**，在路標和 Google 地圖上通常縮寫為 **g.**。
這個詞幾乎是立陶宛語獨有。不過，在極少數情況下，你可能會在拉脫維亞首都里加看到「gatve」（簡寫為 gat.）。

text: Lithuanian directional signs are blue with white text.

NOTE: The arrow on [Latvian](https://goo.gl/maps/g3aqkLH6yjQwrCSF7) signs is more stylized than in [Estonia](https://goo.gl/maps/eW7AJWdVriTfsprx7) and Lithuania, where the back part of the arrowhead is vertical.
text_zh: 立陶宛的指示牌是藍底白字。
注意：[拉脫維亞](https://goo.gl/maps/g3aqkLH6yjQwrCSF7)標誌上的箭頭比[愛沙尼亞](https://goo.gl/maps/eW7AJWdVriTfsprx7)和立陶宛的還要來得有設計感，後兩者的箭頭尾部是垂直的。

text: In Generation 3 coverage, you will often see **random small blurs**. These blurs look similar to the ones that are used to blur out licence plates or faces, but instead they cover seemingly random parts of the image – often on direction signs.
NOTE: This is also common in the Russian oblast of Kaliningrad, just to the southwest of Lithuania.
!!These random blurs are not typically found in Estonia or Latvia.
text_zh: 在第三代（Generation 3）街景覆蓋中，你經常會看到**隨機的小模糊**。這些模糊看起來類似於用來遮蔽車牌或人臉的模糊，但它們遮蔽的卻是畫面中看似隨機的部分——通常在指示牌上。
注意：這在立陶宛西南方的俄羅斯加里寧格勒州也很常見。
!!這些隨機模糊通常不會出現在愛沙尼亞或拉脫維亞。

text: Rarely, you can see bilingual signs with **Polish language** in a small area southeast of Lithuania.
Note that this is by no means very common, but it can help with getting very close guesses if you do see bilingual Polish-Lithuanian signs in an otherwise obvious Lithuanian setting.
text_zh: 在立陶宛東南部的極小區域內，偶爾可以看到帶有**波蘭語**的雙語標誌。
請注意，這絕對不是很常見，但如果你在一個明顯是立陶宛的環境中看到波蘭語與立陶宛語的雙語標誌，它能幫助你做出非常精準的猜測。

text: Luxembourg is a highly **multilingual country**. It has three administrative languages: Luxembourgish, French, and German.
French is the language that is mostly used for public communication. Road signs and advertisements are usually in French.
Presence of German on signs is less common compared to French, but certainly not non-existent.
text_zh: 盧森堡是一個高度**多語言的國家**。它有三種官方語言：盧森堡語、法語和德語。
法語是用於公共交流最主要的語言。道路標誌和廣告通常都是法語。
與法語相比，標誌上出現德語的情況較少，但也並非完全沒有。

text: **Directional signs **are yellow with a thin black outline. Town names are written in uppercase. The signs have a pointed tip. They are completely surrounded by a **frame**, making them very recognizable.
Some directional signs feature road numbers:
- Regional road numbers have 1 or 2 digits and a red box.
- Local road numbers have 3 digits and a [yellow box](https://goo.gl/maps/vunmzYKY3iy5bEGk6).
text_zh: **方向標誌**是黃色的，帶有細黑邊框。城鎮名稱以大寫字母書寫。這些標誌有一個尖頭。它們完全被一個**框**包圍，這使得它們非常容易辨識。
一些方向標誌配有道路編號：
- 區域道路編號為 1 或 2 位數，並帶有紅色方框。
- 當地道路編號為 3 位數，並帶有[黃色方框](https://goo.gl/maps/vunmzYKY3iy5bEGk6)。

text: **Town entrance signs **are also yellow and surrounded by a frame.
Most of these signs have bilingual versions of the town name. They frequently have the road number on the top, along with a speed limit sign.
text_zh: **城鎮入口標誌**也是黃色的，周圍有邊框。
大多數這些標誌都有雙語版本的城鎮名稱。它們的頂部通常有道路編號，以及速限標誌。

text: Almost all Luxembourgish road signs will be supported by a **white signpost**.
NOTE: While not nearly as common, white signposts are also found in [France](https://maps.app.goo.gl/rYufTJHHu99ALVKf6).
text_zh: 幾乎所有盧森堡的道路標誌都由一根**白色標誌柱**支撐。
注意：雖然沒那麼常見，但[法國](https://maps.app.goo.gl/rYufTJHHu99ALVKf6)也能找到白色標誌柱。

text: **Street signs** are almost always short and usually have a white background. The exact designs vary from town to town.
A very common design is the one pictured on the left in the example image, with slanted blue corners.
NOTE: Belgian street signs often appear short as well, but can have other background colours – not just white.
In addition, Dutch street signs almost always have a blue background and tend to be much longer than they are tall.
text_zh: **街道標誌**幾乎總是短短的，通常有白色背景。確切的設計因城鎮而異。
非常常見的設計就像範例圖片左側所示，具有傾斜的藍色角落。
注意：比利時的街道標誌也經常顯得較短，但可以有其他背景顏色——不只是白色。
此外，荷蘭的街道標誌幾乎總是藍色背景，而且通常比高還要長得多。

text: Some signposts have this bulky, round reflector with **blue and white** markings.
NOTE: Similar markings are found in Sweden and Finland. Landscape should be sufficient to tell these apart from Luxembourg, however.
text_zh: 有些標誌柱有這種笨重的圓形反光器，帶有**藍白相間**的標記。
注意：瑞典和芬蘭也能找到類似的標記。不過，風景應該足以將這些與盧森堡區分開來。

text: **Pedestrian signs** have 5 vertical stripes.
NOTE: Belgian pedestrian signs have 2 horizontal stripes.
text_zh: **行人標誌**有 5 道垂直條紋。
注意：比利時的行人標誌有 2 道水平條紋。

text: **Bus stop signs** are blue and always have this exact design. The bus has six windows.
NOTE: Bus stop signs in Belgium and the Netherlands have significantly different designs. For example, the Belgian bus stop sign always has a [yellow signpost](https://goo.gl/maps/HRqx4mPFRvtkV2u2A).
text_zh: **公車站標誌**是藍色的，並且總是這種確切的設計。公車有六扇窗戶。
注意：比利時和荷蘭的公車站標誌設計有明顯的不同。例如，比利時的公車站標誌總是配有[黃色標誌柱](https://goo.gl/maps/HRqx4mPFRvtkV2u2A)。

text: These **white** street signs with a **blue border** around the Chinese and Portuguese text are unique to Macau.
text_zh: 這些在中葡文周圍帶有**藍色邊框**的**白色**街道標誌是澳門獨有的。

text: Madagascar has two official languages: **French** and [**Malagasy**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malagasy_language), which is written with the Latin alphabet and contains many long, multiple-syllable words.
NOTE: [English](https://maps.app.goo.gl/1GZYGSBw3AdKn7CF6) can still be found on some commercial signs.
text_zh: 馬達加斯加有兩種官方語言：**法語**與[**馬達加斯加語**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malagasy_language)，它是用拉丁字母書寫，並包含許多長音、多音節的單字。
注意：在某些商業招牌上仍然可以找到[英文](https://maps.app.goo.gl/1GZYGSBw3AdKn7CF6)。

text: Bus stops signs on Madeira follow a unique **black, white **and** yellow** colour scheme.
text_zh: 馬德拉島的公車站牌採用獨特的**黑色、白色**與**黃色**配色方案。

text: These speed limit signs are unique to Madeira and can be found on its highways.
text_zh: 這些速限標誌是馬德拉特有的，可以在公路沿線看到。

text: Signposts on Madeira are often striped.
NOTE: These are also seen on the Azores.
text_zh: 馬德拉的路標通常帶有條紋。
注意：這些在亞速群島（Azores）也能見到。

text: You can sometimes find **free roaming cows** on high-altitude roads on the island, as well as warning signs for those cows. The cows will typically be brown with white spots, contrary to the Azores, where the cows will typically be [black and white](https://maps.app.goo.gl/vsM6TJ2DnHi1vKEG7).
text_zh: 有時你可以在島上的高海拔道路上找到**自由放牧的乳牛**，以及這些乳牛的警告標誌。這些牛通常是棕色帶有白色斑點，這點與亞速群島不同，那裡的牛通常是[黑白相間](https://maps.app.goo.gl/vsM6TJ2DnHi1vKEG7)的。

text: **BERHENTI** stop signs and **BERI LALUAN** yield signs are both unique to Malaysia.
text_zh: **BERHENTI** 停止標誌與 **BERI LALUAN** 讓路標誌都是馬來西亞特有的。

text: This is a typical Malaysian directional sign. **Hexagonal yellow **highway shields** **are unique to Malaysia.
text_zh: 這是一個典型的馬來西亞方向標誌。**六角形黃色** **高速公路盾牌** 是馬來西亞特有的。

text: Signposts in Malaysia almost always have **black-and-white** **stripes**.
NOTE: Within Asia, these posts are also found in Sri Lanka, Bhutan, India, Nepal and Bangladesh. Make sure to check other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 馬來西亞的路標幾乎總是帶有 **黑白相間** 的 **條紋**。
NOTE: 在亞洲境內，斯里蘭卡、不丹、印度、尼泊爾和孟加拉也能看到這些柱子。在猜測之前，請務必檢查其他線索。

text: Malaysian postal codes are useful to know, since they can be found on most street signs in the country.
text_zh: 了解馬來西亞的郵遞區號很有幫助，因為該國的大多數路標上都能找到它們。

text: **Yellow street name signs** with a black outline are specific to the state of Johor.
NOTE: This **arrow-shaped** street sign, regardless of its colour, is exclusive to Malaysia.
NOTE: Yellow signs are also found in southern [Negeri Sembilan](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HG89SePzMd5WWheo6), however only the tip of the arrow will be black.
text_zh: 帶有黑色外框的**黃色路名標誌**是柔佛州特有的。
NOTE: 這個**箭頭形狀**的路標，無論其顏色為何，都是馬來西亞特有的。
NOTE: 黃色標誌也見於[森美蘭](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HG89SePzMd5WWheo6)南部，不過只有箭頭的尖端是黑色的。

text: **Green** street signs that form an arrow shape and have a **yellow hexagonal symbol **with the letters** JKR** on the left side are found in Sabah.
text_zh: 呈現箭頭形狀且左側有帶有 **JKR** 字樣的**黃色六角形符號**的**綠色**路名牌可以在沙巴找到。

text: The Maltese word for street is “**triq**”, which can be seen on almost every street sign.
text_zh: 馬爾他語的街道是「**triq**」，幾乎可以在每一個路名牌上看到。

text: These **blue signs** are unique to Valletta.
text_zh: 這些**藍色路標**是瓦etta（Valletta）獨有的。

text: Mexican directional signs have a distinctly large, **all-caps** white font.
text_zh: 墨西哥的指示標誌具有明顯大型、**全大寫**的白色字體。

text: Mexico uses the word “ALTO” on stop signs.
NOTE: All of South America, as well as Puerto Rico, use the word “PARE”. Panama, Costa Rica, and Guatemala also use “ALTO”.
text_zh: 墨西哥在停止標誌上使用「ALTO」這個詞。
注意：整個南美洲以及波多黎各都使用「PARE」這個詞。巴拿馬、哥斯大黎加和瓜地馬拉也使用「ALTO」。

text: Arrows on signs are noticeably **very thick**.
text_zh: 標誌上的箭頭明顯**非常粗**。

text: Similarly, Mexican **postal codes** can be seen on this map. They will commonly appear at the [bottom of street signs](https://goo.gl/maps/8bgZx7q8pjzzFSYi6), and are ordered alphabetically based on state names.
text_zh: 同樣地，墨西哥的**郵遞區號**也可以從這張地圖上看到。它們通常會出現在[路牌底部](https://goo.gl/maps/8bgZx7q8pjzzFSYi6)，並根據州名按字母順序排列。

text: A thick **cross** can be seen on the back of signs in Chihuahua.
text_zh: 在奇ihuahua州的路牌背面可以看到一個粗大的**十字**。

text: Choibalsan is the only major city to have several **concrete roads**. In most parts of the city there is a visible **smoke stack**, which is in the southeast corner of the city. It appears to have just rained as the roads are slightly wet and the sky is overcast. Additionally, you may occasionally find [unique pedestrian signs](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.071051,114.53028,3a,17.5y,333.1h,85.63t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1srKpPHHlyC9nza3yV3IaZ3w!2e0) with a short figure over three stripes.
text_zh: 喬巴山市是唯一擁有數條**混凝土道路**的主要城市。在城市的大部分地區都可以看到一個**煙囪**，位於城市的東南角。道路微濕且天空陰暗，看起來像是剛下過雨。此外，你偶爾可能會找到[獨特的行人標誌](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.071051,114.53028,3a,17.5y,333.1h,85.63t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1srKpPHHlyC9nza3yV3IaZ3w!2e0)，上面有一個矮小的人形走在三條條紋上。

text: The desert town of Zamiin-Uud on the border with China has unique **sailboat lamp posts **featuring a** golden flower pot** around them. Often, white signs with Mongolian folded script can be seen attached to these lamp posts.

NOTE: The other desert towns of Choir and Sainshand look similar to Zamiin-Uud and have the same Street View car but use different lamp posts. Choir can be identified by its [blue](https://www.google.com/maps/@46.356902,108.371902,3a,110.3y,325.7h,98.24t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1s6djXgVDAZ-fDj71h8NhXQA!2e0) lamp posts and Sainshand by its [white](https://www.google.com/maps/@44.893259,110.142104,3a,76.1y,92.3h,99.02t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sQ5CKt2u89UjuWb7RAyy5ig!2e0) lamp posts.
text_zh: 位於中蒙邊境的沙漠城鎮扎門烏德（Zamiin-Uud）擁有獨特的**風帆燈柱**，燈柱周圍帶有**金色花盆**。通常可以看到附掛在這些燈柱上、寫有蒙古垂直蒙文的白色標牌。

注意：其他沙漠城鎮喬伊爾和賽音山達看起來與扎門烏德相似，並使用相同的 Google 車，但使用的是不同的燈柱。喬伊爾可透過其[藍色](https://www.google.com/maps/@46.356902,108.371902,3a,110.3y,325.7h,98.24t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1s6djXgVDAZ-fDj71h8NhXQA!2e0)燈柱辨識，賽音山達則透過其[白色](https://www.google.com/maps/@44.893259,110.142104,3a,76.1y,92.3h,99.02t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sQ5CKt2u89UjuWb7RAyy5ig!2e0)燈柱辨識。

text: Namibia uses **green** directional signs with the road number in yellow.
NOTE: Green directional signs with yellow road numbers are also used in South Africa and the other Southern African countries.
- Namibia uses A, B, C, D, M, and sometimes F-roads.
- South Africa uses N and R-roads.
text_zh: 納米比亞使用 **綠色** 指示標誌，並以黃色標示道路編號。
注意：南非和其他南部非洲國家也使用綠色指示標誌搭配黃色道路編號。
- 納米比亞使用 A、B、C、D、M 級道路，有時也有 F 級道路。
- 南非則使用 N 和 R 級道路。

text: After the road climbs onto the plateau east of Kuibis, the landscape will seem mostly flat until you reach the [intersection with the D432](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LnyJcQw9FVFwQbiRA), but you can notice the road having a [gradual incline](https://maps.app.goo.gl/uKxxvnhYT7HLAqBk7) for long stretches. The soil around is very red in colour, with limited shrubbery or signs of life. The weather is clear, with some clouds far in the distance.
text_zh: 在道路爬升至庫伊比斯（Kuibis）以東的高原後，直到你抵達[`與 D432 的交會處`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LnyJcQw9FVFwQbiRA)之前，地景看起來大致平坦，但你可以注意到道路有[`長距離的漸進式爬坡`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/uKxxvnhYT7HLAqBk7)。周邊的土壤顏色非常紅，幾乎沒有灌木叢或生命跡象。天氣晴朗，遠處有些許雲朵。

text: Windhoek is by far the largest city in Namibia, as well as the richest, with many [high rise buildings](https://maps.app.goo.gl/2FUr1J4JEF7QN7D96) near downtown. Affluent and often gated single family houses are a common sight on the sides of hilly streets, which are often well marked with simple white street signs.
In the northwest of the city you’ll find the [slums ](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SfddeDfHCm1tL2Ds6)dotting the hills.
text_zh: 溫荷克 (Windhoek) 是納米比亞最大且最富裕的城市，市中心附近有許多[高樓大廈](https://maps.app.goo.gl/2FUr1J4JEF7QN7D96)。山坡街道兩旁常見到富裕且通常有圍牆的獨棟住宅，這些街道通常標示明確，配有簡單的白色路名牌。
在該市的西北部，你會發現[貧民窟](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SfddeDfHCm1tL2Ds6)散布在山丘上。

text: Gobabis is a big** north-south gridded** city in the desert, with** red soil** permeating the landscape and roads, which are very often unpaved. A faint green ridge is sometimes visible to the north to northwest. The [street signs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/yc9JLDVMMF9166Go7), while rare, are also green, with silver framing on the top and bottom. [Blue bins](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nEKjHa3Md6L2VEtr8) are also a good clue for Gobabis.
text_zh: 戈巴比斯 (Gobabis) 是沙漠中一個很大的**南北向網格狀**城市，景觀與道路中充斥著**紅土**，且大多是未鋪裝的泥土路。北方到西北方偶爾可見一道淡淡的綠色山脊。[路標](https://maps.app.goo.gl/yc9JLDVMMF9166Go7)雖然罕見，但也是綠色的，上下有銀色邊框。[藍色垃圾桶](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nEKjHa3Md6L2VEtr8)也是判斷戈巴比斯的好線索。

text: The coastal cities of Swakopmund and Walvis Bay are **flat **and often have** sandy streets**, with **palms** and Norfolk pines planted around. Street and road signs often have [square-shaped signposts](https://maps.app.goo.gl/wrtSH3P4gsmkEgXy6).
Road angles can be used to line up parts of the city, but a northeast bound angle is common in both.
These [white and blue plastic containers](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tqK6dNW6hqXnVhBR9) are common in Swakopmund, as are [yellow lamp posts](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8DgByYnCTwNfJgTG7) in downtown areas.
text_zh: 沿海城市斯瓦科普蒙德（Swakopmund）和鯨灣港（Walvis Bay）地勢**平坦**且經常有**沙質街道**，周圍種植了**棕櫚樹**和諾福克島杉。街道與道路標誌通常使用[方形支柱](https://maps.app.goo.gl/wrtSH3P4gsmkEgXy6)。
道路角度可用來對齊城市的各個部分，但東北走向的角度在這兩座城市都很常見。
這些[白色和藍色塑膠容器](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tqK6dNW6hqXnVhBR9)在斯瓦科普蒙德很常見，市中心地區的[黃色路燈](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8DgByYnCTwNfJgTG7)也是。

text: Oranjemund is a well-off gridded city with almost exactly east to west streets, with an abundance of** planted vegetation** all around the city. Multiple [Norfolk pines](https://maps.app.goo.gl/P3Su4Jd2vpxZqgDCA) can be seen almost everywhere. Streets are well organised with E-W avenues and N-S streets, which can be seen written on [small blue markers](https://maps.app.goo.gl/3pZrSDpLRb4ZCa5E6) next to the gates or on [street signs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zQgR2ugtF3LkBsoZ7), which have varying designs.
text_zh: 奧蘭治蒙德（Oranjemund）是一座富裕的棋盤狀城市，街道幾乎呈正東西走向，全市周圍有大量**人工植被**。幾乎隨處可見多棵[諾福克島杉](https://maps.app.goo.gl/P3Su4Jd2vpxZqgDCA)。街道規劃完善，擁有東西向的大道和南北向的街道，這些名稱可以寫在大門旁或[路標](https://maps.app.goo.gl/3pZrSDpLRb4ZCa5E6)上的[小型藍色標記](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zQgR2ugtF3LkBsoZ7)上，其設計各有不同。

text: Nepal uses black-and-white striped signposts.
NOTE: Within South and Southeast Asia, India, Bhutan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and Malaysia also use black-and-white striped signposts.
text_zh: 尼泊爾使用黑白相間的標誌柱。
注意：在南亞和東南亞地區，印度、不丹、孟加拉、斯里蘭卡和馬來西亞也使用黑白相間的標誌柱。

text: Street signs are almost always **blue with white lettering**. Very rarely, you can find [yellow](https://goo.gl/maps/yMhbRKLJK1QuyEs68), [white](https://goo.gl/maps/8TuTmC7n7oLw8qAS9) or [green](https://goo.gl/maps/W3BrcUwTrYA4TeMC8) street signs.

The Dutch word for street is **straat**. Other common road name endings are -weg, -laan, -pad, and -plein. However, if you see a blue sign with the word ‘fietspad’, do not search for it; it simply means ‘bicycle path’.
NOTE: Street signs in Belgium come in a variety of colours and usually mention the municipality, which is rare in the Netherlands.
text_zh: 街道招牌幾乎總是**藍底白字**。極少數情況下，你可以找到[黃色](https://goo.gl/maps/yMhbRKLJK1QuyEs68)、[白色](https://goo.gl/maps/8TuTmC7n7oLw8qAS9)或[綠色](https://goo.gl/maps/W3BrcUwTrYA4TeMC8)的街道招牌。
荷蘭語的街道是 **straat**。其他常見的道路名稱結尾有 -weg、-laan、-pad 和 -plein。然而，如果你看到一個寫著「fietspad」的藍色標誌，請不要去搜尋它；它單純代表「單車道」。
註：比利時的街道招牌顏色多變，通常會標示市鎮名稱，這在荷蘭很少見。

text: Dutch **direction signs** are blue with white lettering. Signs for bicyclists are [white with a red border](https://goo.gl/maps/Ym8jxRtVRgdeJFgf6).
text_zh: 荷蘭的**方向指標**是藍底白字。給自行車騎士看的指標則是[白底紅框](https://goo.gl/maps/Ym8jxRtVRgdeJFgf6)。

text: Dutch **town entry signs** are blue. The signs sometimes have very [elaborate designs](https://goo.gl/maps/XAfoVPzYZfX83KoS9), often with frames and additional signs.

NOTE: Often, these signs list the municipality they are in, after the word ‘gemeente’ (gem). Many municipalities are named after larger towns or cities in the vicinity, which can help a lot with scanning.
text_zh: 荷蘭的**城鎮入口招牌**是藍色的。這些招牌有時會有非常[精緻的設計](https://goo.gl/maps/XAfoVPzYZfX83KoS9)，通常配有外框和額外的招牌。
註：通常這些招牌會在「gemeente」(gem) 一詞後面列出他們所在的市鎮。許多市鎮都是以鄰近的大城鎮或城市命名，這對地圖掃描非常有幫助。

text: Edges of Dutch road signs will extend to the back, creating a **border visible from behind**, sometimes retaining the colour of the sign. This is both consistent and unique to the country.
text_zh: 荷蘭道路標誌的邊緣會向後延伸，形成一個**從背面可見的邊框**，有時會保留標誌的顏色。這既一致又是該國獨有的特徵。

text: Many Dutch signposts feature **striped markings** with a black-and-white or blue-and-white colour scheme.
text_zh: 許多荷蘭的路標柱都有黑白或藍白配色的**條紋標記**。

text: Road signs on traffic islands often have these bulky **yellow signposts**.
text_zh: 交通島上的道路標誌通常有這些笨重的**黃色路標柱**。

text: In the province of Friesland, the Frisian language is commonly spoken. While Dutch language is still most prevalent on signs, a lot of town entry signs will feature **bilingual town names**.
Some street names in Friesland uniquely end in -wei or -strjitte.

NOTE: Frisian has vowels with [circumflex](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circumflex) diacritics (“little hats”): Â, Ê, Ô and Û. Dutch does not have these letters, except in loanwords. In addition, the Y is significantly more common compared to Dutch.
text_zh: 在弗里斯蘭省，人們普遍說弗里斯蘭語。雖然荷蘭語在招牌上仍然最為普遍，但許多城鎮入口招牌會採用**雙語城鎮名稱**。
弗里斯蘭省的一些路名獨特地以 -wei 或 -strjitte 結尾。
註：弗里斯蘭語有帶有[揚抑符](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circumflex)變音符號（「小帽子」）的母音：Â、Ê、Ô 和 Û。荷蘭語沒有這些字母，借詞除外。此外，與荷蘭語相比，Y 的使用頻率顯著更高。

text: **Amsterdam street signs** feature the city district in a smaller font size below the actual street name.
NOTE: This design is very uncommon in the rest of the Netherlands.
text_zh: **阿姆斯特丹路名牌**在實際路名下方會以較小的字體標示所屬的城市行政區。
注意：這種設計在荷蘭其他地區非常罕見。

text: The municipality of Oegstgeest, just northwest of Leiden, uses uniquely illegible street signs with** yellow text on a red background.**
text_zh: 位於萊頓（Leiden）西北方的奧格斯特赫斯特（Oegstgeest）市鎮，使用獨特且難以辨識的路牌，為**黃字紅底**。

text: **Baarle** is a town in the south of the Netherlands which contains a number of Belgian enclaves. Throughout the town, you can sometimes see signs of this, such as markings on the pavement and [Dutch and Belgian flags](https://goo.gl/maps/sKCBPk8vqM9AUrmB9) being flown together.
text_zh: **巴勒**是荷蘭南部的一個城鎮，包含多個比利時飛地。整個城鎮中，你偶爾可以看到這類的跡象，例如路面上的標記以及同時飄揚的[荷蘭與比利時國旗](https://goo.gl/maps/sKCBPk8vqM9AUrmB9)。

text: **Give-way signs** in New Zealand have a white border and red text.
NOTE: Australia’s give-way signs use black text.
text_zh: 紐西蘭的**讓路標誌**具有白色邊框和紅色文字。
注意：澳洲的讓路標誌使用黑色文字。

text: The majority of directional and warning signs in New Zealand are held up by **white posts**. Warning signs are [**diamond-shaped**](https://goo.gl/maps/Yc1aJRudbLkktBBQ8) and painted **yellow**.
text_zh: 紐西蘭的大多數方向標誌和警告標誌都由**白色柱子**支撐。警告標誌是[**菱形**](https://goo.gl/maps/Yc1aJRudbLkktBBQ8)且漆成**黃色**。

text: New Zealand often uses **blue street signs **with white text, particularly in rural areas. While street signs of other colours can be often seen, blue is by far the most common.
NOTE: Australia almost never has blue street signs.
text_zh: 紐西蘭經常使用**藍色路名牌**搭配白色文字，特別是在鄉村地區。雖然也常看到其他顏色的路名牌，但藍色絕對是最常見的。
注意：澳洲幾乎沒有藍色路名牌。

text: New Zealand uses **green directional signs. **If the sign is on a state highway, the highway number will always be shown in a **red crest**.
NOTE: Brown signs indicate the direction to landmarks, which can be useful when pinpointing.
text_zh: 紐西蘭使用**綠色方向指示牌**。如果指示牌位於國道上，公路編號一定會顯示在**紅色盾形徽章**內。
注意：棕色指示牌用來指示地標的方向，這在精準定位時會很有幫助。

text: Bridge markers can be found on most paved roads in New Zealand. If the sign is on a state highway, the highway number will always be shown in a **red crest** on a white marker. The yellow marker indicates the name of the river or bridge.
NOTE: Some bridge markers indicate very small streams or culverdens which can be hard to find.
text_zh: 紐西蘭多數鋪裝道路上都可以找到橋梁標示。如果指示牌位於國道上，公路編號一定會顯示在白色標示上的**紅色盾形徽章**內。黃色標示則用來標示河流或橋梁的名稱。
注意：有些橋梁標示指的是很小的溪流或涵洞，可能會比較難找到。

text: The first digit of [Fonterra farm signs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/iVEJfCaXqmsAC1qQ7) follows the regional pattern seen on the map.
_This image was provided by snowf\_lake and brainy. You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: [恆天然（Fonterra）農場招牌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/iVEJfCaXqmsAC1qQ7)的第一個數字遵循地圖上看到的地區規律。
_這張圖片由 snowf\_lake 和 brainy 提供。你可以點擊圖片將其放大。_

text: The cities of Auckland, Wellington and Christchurch all have unique bus stop signs.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 奧克蘭、威靈頓和基督城的公車站牌都各有特色。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: There are many town and city specific **street signs **in northern New Zealand, which can be seen in this graphic.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 紐西蘭北部有許多城鎮和城市專屬的**街道標誌**，這可以在此圖表中看到。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: There are many town and city specific **street signs **in southern New Zealand, which can be seen in this graphic.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 紐西蘭南部有許多城鎮和城市專屬的**街道標誌**，這可以在此圖表中看到。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: The Northern Mariana Islands uses **blue** street signs, unlike Guam, which use green street signs.
text_zh: 北馬利安納群島使用**藍色**的街道指標，不同於使用綠色街道指標的關島。

text: Norwegian pedestrian signs typically have **four stripes** and a very simply drawn person. Note however, that there is a version with [five stripes](https://www.google.com/maps/@69.6519241,18.9565431,3a,15y,247.79h,95.06t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sr44nQpcvP6QQiIoQ5x9iPg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) and a version where the person is more detailed and [wearing a hat](https://www.google.com/maps/@59.9150958,10.7314409,3a,15y,221.76h,97.28t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sxUjNRfgz1D4jn2MrTFqN3A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192).

NOTE: While [Finnish](https://www.google.com/maps/@61.4993731,23.759534,3a,15y,50.36h,98.09t,359.73r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sklmrQCHLp2po9CQARyRyMA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) pedestrian signs have five stripes, Swedish pedestrian signs have four stripes. However, the person on [Swedish](https://www.google.se/maps/@59.8459127,17.6306563,3a,15y,112.66h,95.96t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s-ODCYQW5xsTcVebPn08xRQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) signs is detailed, but without a hat.
text_zh: 挪威行人標誌通常有**四條條紋**和一個畫法非常簡單的人形。不過請注意，也有[五條條紋](https://www.google.com/maps/@69.6519241,18.9565431,3a,15y,247.79h,95.06t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sr44nQpcvP6QQiIoQ5x9iPg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)的版本，以及人形較為詳細且[戴著帽子](https://www.google.com/maps/@59.9150958,10.7314409,3a,15y,221.76h,97.28t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sxUjNRfgz1D4jn2MrTFqN3A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)的版本。

注意：雖然[芬蘭](https://www.google.com/maps/@61.4993731,23.759534,3a,15y,50.36h,98.09t,359.73r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sklmrQCHLp2po9CQARyRyMA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)行人標誌有五條條紋，但瑞典行人標誌有四條條紋。不過，[瑞典](https://www.google.se/maps/@59.8459127,17.6306563,3a,15y,112.66h,95.96t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s-ODCYQW5xsTcVebPn08xRQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)標誌上的人形很詳細，但沒有戴帽子。

text: Norwegian directional signs are **yellow** with a **black border**. You will commonly see the road number displayed, either in a green box for European highways and major roads, or in a white box, for smaller roads.
text_zh: 挪威的方向指標是**黃色**搭配**黑色邊框**。你通常會看到顯示的道路編號，歐盟公路和主要道路會放在綠色方框中，較小的道路則放在白色方框中。

text: On smaller roads, it is common to see these blue signs with a **large white M**.

NOTE: Similar signs can be found in [Sweden](https://goo.gl/maps/DqYAkha51nY72ao49), however the font is distinctly different. The middle point of the M does not extend to the bottom of the letter. There are no similar signs in Finland.
text_zh: 在較小的道路上，常見到這些帶有**大型白色 M** 的藍色標誌。
注意：類似的標誌可以在[瑞典](https://goo.gl/maps/DqYAkha51nY72ao49)找到，但字體明顯不同。M 的中點不會延伸到字母底部。芬蘭沒有類似的標誌。

text: Norwegian bus stops usually have this small, **blue sign** with a white bus.
NOTE: Sweden has a lot of different bus stops, none of which look like this.
text_zh: 挪威的公車站通常有這個帶有白色公車的小型**藍色標誌**。
注意：瑞典有許多不同的公車站，但沒有一個長這樣。

text: **White signs** with the text “**Sone**”, generally featuring a speed limit, are common in urban areas.
text_zh: 帶有「**Sone**」字樣且通常標示速限的**白色標誌**在市區很常見。

text: Street signs will generally be **centred** on top of sign posts.
NOTE: Street signs in Sweden will normally be attached either to the side of [sign posts](https://goo.gl/maps/YnsWJyWT27GYkDXGA) or [lamp posts](https://goo.gl/maps/JyeS5LBN8nZDyKrt8).
text_zh: 街道指標通常會**置中**固定在標誌桿的頂端。
注意：瑞典的街道指標通常會固定在[標誌桿](https://goo.gl/maps/YnsWJyWT27GYkDXGA)或[燈桿](https://goo.gl/maps/JyeS5LBN8nZDyKrt8)的側面。

text: Norwegian traffic signs have a red outline and a **white background**.

NOTE: Both [Swedish](https://www.google.se/maps/@60.2182208,17.4734016,3a,15y,311.3h,89.49t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1spg1fT6h2pXchIZ0XtF9UHA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) and [Finnish](https://www.google.com/maps/@65.00534,25.5795144,3a,15y,139.16h,87.81t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s17sGKjC9XHOAQHw_NCoL_A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) road signs have a yellow background.
text_zh: 挪威的交通標誌具有紅色外框和**白色背景**。
