注意：[瑞典](https://www.google.se/maps/@60.2182208,17.4734016,3a,15y,311.3h,89.49t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1spg1fT6h2pXchIZ0XtF9UHA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)和[芬蘭](https://www.google.com/maps/@65.00534,25.5795144,3a,15y,139.16h,87.81t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s17sGKjC9XHOAQHw_NCoL_A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)的道路標誌都有黃色背景。

text: You can also find these road construction signs, with a **bright yellow** background.
text_zh: 你也可以找到這些帶有**亮黃色**背景的道路施工標誌。

text: Most smaller road signs will be attached with four visible **sign bolts** in the shape of a tall rectangle. Beware that you may occasionally find [framed signs](https://www.google.com/maps/@58.8495149,5.7367006,3a,21.3y,31.15h,97.95t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sXRj68ZaFOCOFubBo1k50Nw!2e0!5s20221001T000000!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu) instead, particularly in urban settings.
text_zh: 大部分較小的道路標誌會用四個可見的長方形**標誌螺栓**固定。請注意，你偶爾可能會找到[有框標誌](https://www.google.com/maps/@58.8495149,5.7367006,3a,21.3y,31.15h,97.95t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sXRj68ZaFOCOFubBo1k50Nw!2e0!5s20221001T000000!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)，特別是在市區環境中。

text: Small **white square signs**, displaying the road number on top, and the distance to the closest town, are common to see along medium sized roads.

The road number will be preceded either by an R or an [F](https://www.google.se/maps/@62.2252395,6.269883,3a,15y,195.25h,79.98t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sz50wFAvEtsVFmAutPi8UBQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192). F roads show up as Fv on the map and are generally difficult to locate, while R roads lack any letters on the map and are generally more findable.
text_zh: 中型道路沿線常見到小型**白色正方形標誌**，上方顯示道路編號，下方顯示到最近城鎮的距離。
道路編號前面會加上 R 或 [F](https://www.google.se/maps/@62.2252395,6.269883,3a,15y,195.25h,79.98t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sz50wFAvEtsVFmAutPi8UBQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)。F 道路在地圖上顯示為 Fv，通常較難定位，而 R 道路在地圖上沒有任何字母，通常更容易找到。

text: Bilingual signs with **Sámi** can be found in several northern areas in Norway. While the Sámi languages are very different from Norwegian, the best way to recognize them are the letters Á, Đ and the use of several vowels in a row, something which is uncommon in Norwegian.
Note that not all signs in these areas will be bilingual.
text_zh: 在挪威的多個北部地區可以找到帶有**薩米語**（Sámi）的雙語標誌。雖然薩米語與挪威語非常不同，但辨識它們的最佳方式是字母 Á、Đ 以及連續使用多個母音，這在挪威語中是不常見的。
請注意，這些地區並非所有標誌都是雙語的。

text: **Russian** can sometimes be seen alongside Norwegian on signs near the Russian border. It is mostly found on roads E6 and E105 near Kirkenes.
text_zh: 在俄羅斯邊境附近的標誌上，有時可以看到**俄羅斯文**與挪威文並列。它主要出現在希克內斯附近的 E6 和 E105 公路上。

text: The official language in Oman is **Arabic**.
NOTE: Due to high tourism, signs in Oman often have English writing alongside Arabic. The same also applies to the UAE.
text_zh: 阿曼的官方語言是**阿拉伯文**。
注意：由於觀光業發達，阿曼的標誌上經常有英文與阿拉伯文並列。阿拉伯聯合大公國也是如此。

text: Directional signs are** blue with white text** and are usually in **Arabic and English**.
NOTE: The UAE and Qatar use similar signs.
text_zh: 方向指示牌為**藍底白字**，通常使用**阿拉伯文與英文**。
注意：阿拉伯聯合大公國與卡達使用類似的標誌。

text: Many signposts in Oman have **black-and-white stripes**.
NOTE: Within the Middle East, striped signposts are only found in Oman and the UAE.
text_zh: 阿曼的許多路標柱帶有**黑白條紋**。
注意：在中東地區，只有阿曼和阿拉伯聯合大公國能找到帶條紋的路標柱。

text: The road southeast of Ubar has a general northwest bound angle, along with a power line to the left of the road. You will often see signs of life in the form of farms or buildings on this road.

NOTE: Don’t mix this up with the 37, which has a similar angle, but is [more desolate](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8uU7Jw947G7wktyd7) and can have [sunset coverage](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dD63F9RyzyfugxBw9).
text_zh: 烏巴爾（Ubar）東南方的道路大致呈西北走向，道路左側有一條電線。在這條路上，你經常會看到農場或建築物等有人居住的跡象。
注意：不要把這條路跟 37 號公路搞混了，37 號公路的角度相似，但[更為荒涼](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8uU7Jw947G7wktyd7)，且可能帶有[日落街景覆蓋](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dD63F9RyzyfugxBw9)。

text: Peru is the only South American country to use **black-and-white** striped signposts. In some areas, [black-and-yellow](https://goo.gl/maps/4X8W8dd1mmrbhVLH7) signposts can be seen.
NOTE: Uruguay sometimes uses black-and-white posts for its traffic lights, but not for road signs.
text_zh: 祕魯是唯一一個使用**黑白**相間標誌柱的南美洲國家。在某些地區，可以看到[黑黃相間](https://goo.gl/maps/4X8W8dd1mmrbhVLH7)的標誌柱。
注意：烏拉圭有時會在交通號誌桿上使用黑白相間的柱子，但不用於道路標誌。

text: Peruvian metal signposts feature **concrete blocks** at the bottom.
NOTE: Within South America, Peru is the only country to do so.
text_zh: 祕魯的金屬標誌柱底部帶有**混凝土塊**。
注意：在南美洲內部，祕魯是唯一這樣做的國家。

text: Sign posts are often painted **red**, **orange** or **yellow**.
text_zh: 標誌支柱經常漆成 **紅色**、**橘色** 或 **黃色**。

text: Although Filipino is the official language of the Philippines, **English** is extremely common to find on signs. It is the only major Southeast Asian country where you’re likely to come across English.
text_zh: 雖然菲律賓語是菲律賓的官方語言，但標誌上出現 **英文** 的情況非常普遍。這是你可能會遇到英文的主要東南亞國家中唯一的一個。

text: **Province names** are very common to find on signs and can thus be very useful. However, they do not appear on the map, meaning they’re necessary to memorise in order to use them.
It is worth mentioning that Davao de Oro changed its name from Compostela Valley in 2019.
text_zh: **省份名稱**在標誌上非常常見，因此非常有用。然而，它們不會出現在地圖上，這意味著必須背下來才能使用它們。
值得一提的是，Davao de Oro 於 2019 年從 Compostela Valley 更名。

text: Warning signs are triangular and have a **yellow background** and a distinct **thin red border**.
NOTE: In Europe, this combination of a yellow background with a thin red border is unique to Poland.
text_zh: 警告標誌呈三角形，具有**黃色背景**和明顯的**細紅邊**。
注意：在歐洲，黃色背景搭配細紅邊的組合是波蘭特有的。

text: However, prohibitory signs are round and have a **white background** with a thicker red border.
text_zh: 然而，禁制標誌是圓形的，擁有**白色背景**和較粗的紅邊。

text: Poland has a unique **pedestrian sign**. Instead of the usual zebra stripes, it just has a single horizontal line.
NOTE: Austria and Belgium also have horizontal lines, but they use two lines instead of Poland’s single line.
text_zh: 波蘭有一個獨特的**行人穿越道標誌**。它沒有使用常見的斑馬線條紋，而只有一條水平線。
注意：奧地利和比國也有水平線，但牠們使用的是兩條線，而不是波蘭的單一線條。

text: Regular Polish direction signs have a **green background**. These signs use a distinct font, which is a good clue for Poland.
NOTE: Signs on expressways have a blue background.
text_zh: 波蘭的一般方向標誌具有**綠色背景**。這些標誌使用獨特的字體，是判斷波蘭的好線索。
注意：高速公路上的標誌為藍色背景。

text: Poland has two **town entry signs**: a green one with the locality’s name, and a white-and-black one with a stylized urban area.
NOTE: Like direction signs, town entry signs use a distinct font.
text_zh: 波蘭有兩種**城鎮入口標誌**：一種是帶有地名且背景為綠色的標誌，另一種則是帶有風格化城鎮圖示的黑白標誌。
注意：如同方向標誌，城鎮入口標誌也使用獨特的字體。

text: **Regional** **roads** have 3-digit road numbers. These numbers often appear in yellow boxes on direction signs. The first digit is usually region-specific, as there is a high level of geographic clustering of these road numbers.
There is some overlap between numbers near the margins of the regions. Some exceptions also exist.
NOTE: This tip only applies to 3-digit roads. Bigger roads with 2-digit road numbers mostly do not adhere to this geographic pattern.
text_zh: **區域** **道路**擁有 3 位數的道路編號。這些編號經常出現在方向標誌的黃色方框中。第一位數通常具備區域特異性，因為這些道路編號具有高度的地理群聚性。
在區域邊界附近，編號之間會有一些重疊。也存在一些例外情況。
NOTE: 這個小技巧僅適用於 3 位數的道路。擁有 2 位數路號的大型道路大多不遵循此地理規律。

text: While rare, bilingual signs can be found in the highlighted regions.
- **Kashubian**, found in the north, is another West Slavic Language, featuring a lot of umlauts and accents.
_Wszëtczi lëdze rodzą sã wòlny ë równy w swòji czëstnoce ë swòjich prawach. Mają òni dostóne rozëm ë sëmienié ë nôlégô jima pòstãpòwac wobec drëdzich w dëchù bracënotë._
- **German** is mostly found in the Opole Voivodeship.
- **Lithuanian **can be found around Puńsk, near the Lithuanian border.
- **Belarusian** is found near the Belarusian border.
- **Lemko, **another Cyrillic language, can be found in the southeast.
text_zh: 雖然罕見，但在突顯的地區中可以找到雙語標誌。
- **卡舒比語（Kashubian）**可在北部找到，是另一種西斯拉夫語言，帶有許多變音符號與腔調。
_Wszëtczi lëdze rodzą sã wòlny ë równy w swòji czëstnoce ë swòjich prawach. Mają òni dostóne rozëm ë sëmienié ë nôlégô jima pòstãpòwac wobec drëdzich w dëchù bracënotë._
- **德語**主要分佈在奧波萊省（Opole Voivodeship）。
- **立陶宛語**可以在立陶宛邊境附近的普恩斯克（Puńsk）周邊找到。
- **白俄羅斯語**可以在白俄羅斯邊境附近找到。
- **萊姆基語（Lemko）**是另一種西里爾字母語言，可在東南部找到。

text: Białystok uses **turquoise** street signs, with the district marked on the bottom.
text_zh: 比亚韦斯托克（Białystok）使用**土耳其玉色**的路標，底部標示著行政區。

text: Szczecin uses colourful **green** and **blue** signs. The city district is marked on the bottom.
text_zh: 什切青（Szczecin）使用色彩繽紛的**綠色**和**藍色**標誌。底部標示著城市行政區。

text: Street signs in Poznań are mainly **black**, with the district being marked on the blue section at the bottom.
text_zh: 波茲南（Poznań）的路標主要是**黑色**的，行政區標示在底部的藍色區塊上。

text: **Hunting signs** with a red and white colour scheme are a common sight in rural areas. They are either diamond shaped or rectangular.

NOTE: In contrast, [Spanish](https://www.google.com/maps/@39.9083771,-2.5360346,3a,15y,154.88h,76.9t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1se3LYRFex8eXCgocKMCvxPw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu) hunting signs are white and black.
text_zh: 採用紅白配色的**狩獵標誌**是鄉村地區常見的景象。它們呈菱形或長方形。
NOTE: 相比之下，[西班牙](https://www.google.com/maps/@39.9083771,-2.5360346,3a,15y,154.88h,76.9t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1se3LYRFex8eXCgocKMCvxPw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)的狩獵標誌是白底黑字的。

text: Directional signs are generally white, with **black arrows** that are **not** touching the borders of the sign.
NOTE: [Spanish](https://goo.gl/maps/NdKZE9FwK2q66enj6) directional signs will typically feature the road number in colourful boxes and do not have a black arrow, other than a thin black border.
text_zh: 方向標誌通常是白色的，帶有**黑色箭頭**，且箭頭**沒有**觸及標誌的邊框。
NOTE: [西班牙](https://goo.gl/maps/NdKZE9FwK2q66enj6)的方向標誌通常會在彩色方框中顯示道路編號，且沒有黑色箭頭，只有細黑邊框。

text: Most kilometre markers are wide rectangles with a **coloured section** on the left side divided diagonally from the white part. Every kilometre you will find a larger [square sign](https://goo.gl/maps/d31pnwB3RjC8JZWD8) with a coloured top half featuring the road number.
text_zh: 大多數公里碑都是寬闊的長方形，左側有一個**彩色區塊**，與白色部分呈對角線分隔。每隔一公里，你就會找到一個較大的[方形標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/d31pnwB3RjC8JZWD8)，其上半部帶有顯示道路編號的顏色。

text: Stop signs in Portugal feature a fairly large font.

NOTE: This is mostly useful to distinguish it from [Spain](https://www.google.com/maps/@41.4989864,-1.390895,3a,15y,67.65h,81.9t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sPtHx268nIZR2fqVugwTlsQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu), where stop signs have a distinctly small and compact font.
text_zh: 葡萄牙的停止標誌採用相當大的字體。
NOTE: 這主要有助於將其與[西班牙](https://www.google.com/maps/@41.4989864,-1.390895,3a,15y,67.65h,81.9t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sPtHx268nIZR2fqVugwTlsQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)區分開來，在西班牙，停止標誌採用明顯較小且緊湊的字體。

text: Pedestrian signs have **five stripes**, and the person is wearing a **belt**, which is noticeably high.

NOTE: [Spanish pedestrian signs](https://goo.gl/maps/tsQ3wkTxKwZuebwp9) have eight stripes, [Italian signs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RiDqBuojwMhYqgDCA) don't have a belt and [Greek signs](https://goo.gl/maps/RCxiJ5SWmjfFM3TB8) have two dotted lines instead of stripes.
text_zh: 行人標誌有 **五條線**，且行人繫著 **皮帶**，位置明顯偏高。
注意：[西班牙行人穿越道標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/tsQ3wkTxKwZuebwp9)有八條條紋，[義大利標誌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RiDqBuojwMhYqgDCA)沒有外框，而[希臘標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/RCxiJ5SWmjfFM3TB8)則是兩條虛線而不是條紋。

text: Portuguese road signs are typically encased by a **white border**.
NOTE: Most [Spanish](https://www.google.com/maps/@38.8639722,-4.7943486,3a,17.5y,29.06h,88.7t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1swJ7te-wPHR9taiHRqU2LIg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu) signs don’t have a white border.
text_zh: 葡萄牙的道路標誌通常包覆著 **白色邊框**。
注意：大多數[西班牙](https://www.google.com/maps/@38.8639722,-4.7943486,3a,17.5y,29.06h,88.7t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1swJ7te-wPHR9taiHRqU2LIg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)標誌沒有白色邊框。

text: **Lime green street signs** can be found in Porto.
text_zh: Porto 可以找到**萊姆綠的路牌**。

text: **Spanish**, instead of English, can commonly be seen on signs around Puerto Rico.
text_zh: 在 Puerto Rico 各地的招牌上，通常可以看到**西班牙文**而非英文。

text: Speed limit signs in Puerto Rico are identical in shape and size to speed limit signs seen in the mainland US. The major difference is that these signs will always be **in Spanish**, instead of English.
text_zh: Puerto Rico 的速限標誌在形狀和大小上與美國本土的速限標誌完全相同。主要的區別在於這些標誌一律**使用西班牙文**而非英文。

text: Stop signs in Puerto Rico say ‘**PARE**’ instead of stop.
NOTE: ‘PARE’ is also used in all of South America as well as the Dominican Republic.
text_zh: 波多黎各的停止標誌寫的是「**PARE**」而不是 stop。
注意：‘PARE’也用於整個南美洲以及 Dominican Republic。

text: Qatari crossing signs feature a man in a [**thobe**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thawb).
text_zh: 卡達的行人穿越道標誌上有一個穿著[**傳統長袍**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thawb)的男子。

text: Qatar is divided into municipalities, further divided into **numbered zones**, which can be seen on [street signs](https://goo.gl/maps/M8fdWeriuhXw3Meu5). This infographic shows which number corresponds to each zone.
text_zh: 卡達劃分為多個市鎮，並進一步劃分為 **編號分區**，這些編號可以在[路標](https://goo.gl/maps/M8fdWeriuhXw3Meu5)上看到。這張資訊圖表顯示了哪個編號對應到哪一個分區。

text: **Brown **street signs, often fixed to the ground, are seen in Education City.
text_zh: 教育城內常見到**棕色**的街道標誌，通常固定在地面上。

text: Romanian directional signs are blue, arrow shaped, and have a white border. They will very often display the **road number**, which can be either **red or **[**blue**](https://goo.gl/maps/62EzegUJUrbSQHwQ6).
text_zh: 羅馬尼亞的指路標誌是藍色的、箭頭形狀，並帶有白色邊框。它們非常常顯示**道路編號**，顏色可以是**紅色**或**[藍色](https://goo.gl/maps/62EzegUJUrbSQHwQ6)**。

text: The most common type of town entry sign in Romania is a **yellow sign** displaying a speed limit and a city skyline, with a **white sign** displaying the town name below.

NOTE: The upper sign can also either be [white](https://goo.gl/maps/nAGuvAEn4CDn1iQu5) or [completely absent](https://www.google.com/maps/@43.9295577,23.865666,3a,15y,60.5h,84.85t,358.78r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sXfkr8gj25si9PKl8IgR9Ew!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu).
text_zh: 羅馬尼亞最常見的城鎮入口標誌是一個**黃色標誌**，顯示速限與城市天際線，下方搭配一個顯示城鎮名稱的**白色標誌**。

注意：上方的標誌也可以是[白色](https://goo.gl/maps/nAGuvAEn4CDn1iQu5)或[完全不存在](https://www.google.com/maps/@43.9295577,23.865666,3a,15y,60.5h,84.85t,358.78r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sXfkr8gj25si9PKl8IgR9Ew!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)。

text: Romanian sign backs are often **black**.
NOTE: This is also common in Italy, Albania and Germany.
text_zh: 羅馬尼亞的標誌背面通常是**黑色**的。
注意：這在義大利、阿爾巴尼亞和德國也很常見。

text: This yield sign, with an extremely **thick red border**, with a **thin white outline**, is unique to Romania. Beware that different yield signs also exist in Romania.
text_zh: 這個讓路標誌帶有極為**寬的紅邊**與**細白外框**，是羅馬尼亞獨有的。請注意，羅馬尼亞也存在其他不同的讓路標誌。

text: Bilingual signs with **Hungarian** are mostly found in the central regions of Covasna, Harghita and Mureş, but also less commonly near the Hungarian border.
text_zh: 帶有**匈牙利語**的雙語標誌主要見於科瓦斯納縣、哈爾吉塔縣和穆列什縣等中部地區，但在匈牙利邊境附近也較不常見到。

text: Several Romanian cities and towns have **unique street signs**. This infographic covers all with a population above 100 000.
text_zh: 幾個羅馬尼亞城市和城鎮擁有**獨特的路牌**。這張資訊圖表涵蓋了所有人口超過 100,000 人的城市。

text: Russian pedestrian signs have a simply drawn person and **three stripes**. Signs will commonly have a **bright yellow border**.
NOTE: Ukraine, Lithuania, Mongolia, Kazakhstan and Kyrgyzstan use the same design.
text_zh: 俄羅斯的行人標誌有一個簡單繪製的人形和**三條橫紋**。標誌通常會有**明亮的黃色邊框**。
注意：烏克蘭、立陶宛、蒙古、哈薩克和吉爾吉斯也使用相同的設計。

text: These blue signs are only found in Moscow and usually feature **English translations** of important tourist points.
text_zh: 這些藍色標誌僅見於莫斯科，通常附有重要旅遊景點的**英文翻譯**。

text: St. Petersburg street signs include a **transliteration** of the street name on a black background. They are primarily found downtown.
text_zh: 聖彼得堡的街道標誌包含黑底的街道名稱**音譯**。它們主要分佈在市中心。

text: Saransk has an exclusive circular street sign design with the street name being written in up to **4 different languages**.
text_zh: 薩蘭斯克擁有獨特的圓形路標設計，路標上的街道名稱最多以 **4 種不同的語言**書寫。

text: **Tatar bilingual signs** use “урамы” (ур., abbreviated) for street instead of “улица” and are unsurprisingly found in Tatarstan.
text_zh: **韃靼語雙語標誌**使用「урамы」（縮寫為 ур.）來表示街道，而不是「улица」，這毫不意外地出現在韃靼斯坦。

text: **Bashkir bilingual signs** are found in Bashkortostan and use “урамы” for street, the same as Tatar, but are often not abbreviated.
text_zh: **巴什基爾語雙語標誌**見於巴什科爾托斯坦，與韃靼語一樣使用「урамы」表示街道，但通常不使用縮寫。

text: **Chuvash bilingual signs**, found in Chuvashia, use “урамӗ” for street.
text_zh: **楚瓦什語雙語標誌**見於楚瓦什，使用「урамӗ」表示街道。

text: **Mari bilingual signs**, found in Mari El, use “урем” for street.
text_zh: **馬里語雙語標誌**見於馬里埃爾，使用「урем」表示街道。

text: **Komi bilingual signs**, found in the Komi Republic, use “улича” for street.
text_zh: **科米語雙語標誌**見於科米共和國，使用「улича」表示街道。

text: On the main road of Murmansk in generation 4, as well as some roads in Karelia covered in 2018, the vast majority of signposts will have **two yellow bands** wrapped around them.
text_zh: 在莫爾曼斯克的世代 4 主幹道上，以及卡累利阿 2018 年拍攝的一些道路上，絕大多數的路標都會纏繞著**兩道黃色帶子**。

text: This **distinct decorative design** of pedestrian sign holders is specific to Pskov Oblast.
text_zh: 這種行人標誌支架的**獨特裝飾設計**是普斯科夫州特有的。

text: The city of Nizhnevartovsk has these unique **hanging pedestrian signs**.
text_zh: 下瓦爾托夫斯克市擁有這些獨特的**懸掛式行人標誌**。

text: These **elaborate pedestrian crossings**, with painted blue crosswalks and hanging signs, are specific to San Marino.
text_zh: 這些**精緻的人行穿越道**（繪有藍色斑馬線並懸掛標誌）是聖馬利諾特有的。

text: Most town entry signs in Senegal are white and feature a **thick pink** outline. The town is also written in a bold, black font.
text_zh: 塞內加爾的大多數城鎮入口標誌都是白色的，並帶有**粗粉紅色**外框。城鎮名稱則是以粗體黑色字體書寫。

text: All street name signs in Singapore follow this **unique format**. They are green, with rounded edges and a distinct white font.
text_zh: 新加坡所有的街道名稱標誌都遵循這種**獨特的格式**。它們是綠色的，邊緣圓潤，並採用獨特的白色字體。

text: Directional signs are also **green**, with white letters and English writing.
NOTE: Expressways each have a **three-letter code** (e.g. TPE), making them easy to spot on signs.
text_zh: 方向標誌也是**綠色**的，帶有白色字母和英文書寫。
注意：每條快速公路都有一個**三字母代碼**（例如 TPE），使得它們在標誌上很容易被認出。

text: Road signs in Singapore are unique in that they are always set on a **square white background**.
NOTE: Road signs in almost all other countries will not have this square background.
text_zh: 新加坡的道路標誌的獨特之處在於它們總是設置在**正方形的白色背景**上。
注意：幾乎所有其他國家的道路標誌都沒有這種正方形背景。

text: Many streets are named after the neighbourhood they are in, especially in the suburbs.

NOTE: These neighbourhood names appear very quickly on the map, so you can save yourself a lot of time scanning for 5k’s that way. For example, the sign in the image refers to Street 31 in the neighbourhood of Ang Mo Kio.
text_zh: 許多街道都以它們所在的社區命名，特別是在市郊地區。
注意：這些社區名稱在地圖上出現的速度非常快，因此你可以省下大量掃描 5k 的時間。例如，圖片中的招牌指的是宏茂橋（Ang Mo Kio）社區內的 31 街。

text: You can easily recognise the **island of Sentosa** thanks to the green signposts, winding roads and general resort feel. Occasionally you might see a green lane like [this](https://goo.gl/maps/hrc9MLAc4F6GQihy5) as well.
text_zh: 你可以透過綠色路標、蜿蜒的道路以及濃厚的度假村氛圍，輕鬆認出**聖淘沙島**。偶爾你也可以看到像[這樣](https://goo.gl/maps/hrc9MLAc4F6GQihy5)的綠色車道。

text: It is common in both Slovakia and Czechia to see temporary square sign posts coated in red and white stripes.
text_zh: 在斯洛伐克和捷克，經常可以看到塗有紅白相間條紋的臨時方形標誌桿。

text: Hiking markers, made up of one colourful strip between two white ones, are commonly found in Slovakia and Czechia. They sometimes form an [arrow](https://goo.gl/maps/rdpAP15NABRWY6J59).

NOTE: While by far being the most common in Slovakia and Czechia, similar signs can be found in other European countries such as [Poland](https://goo.gl/maps/aXtx3dQZAxJDEo9u6), [Hungary](https://goo.gl/maps/Rc9N8toac29Zq5Df8) and [Germany](https://goo.gl/maps/W2ek9Z81Qx9ZXStS7).
text_zh: 由兩條白色條紋夾著一條彩色條紋組成的健行標記，在斯洛伐克和捷克很常見。它們有時會形成一個[箭頭](https://goo.gl/maps/rdpAP15NABRWY6J59)。
注意：雖然這是斯洛伐克和捷克最常見的標誌，但在其他歐洲國家（例如[波蘭](https://goo.gl/maps/aXtx3dQZAxJDEo9u6)、[匈牙利](https://goo.gl/maps/Rc9N8toac29Zq5Df8)和[德國](https://goo.gl/maps/W2ek9Z81Qx9ZXStS7)）也能找到類似的標誌。

text: These **black **signs can often be found by the end of bridges in Generation 4 coverage. The road number is displayed on the left.
text_zh: 這些**黑色**標誌經常可以在相機世代 4 街景覆蓋的橋梁盡頭找到。道路編號顯示在左側。

text: Slovakia uses [blue directional signs](https://goo.gl/maps/2mkRyA6uUbEVFavi7), with **small** **white arrows**.
NOTE: [Czechia](https://www.google.se/maps/@50.1064121,14.913933,3a,15y,60.44h,88.2t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1so99PGzeEpfVrMqGK8iZJAg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) has large filled in white arrows instead.
text_zh: 斯洛伐克使用[藍色方向標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/2mkRyA6uUbEVFavi7)，配有**小**型的**白色箭頭**。
注意：[捷克](https://www.google.se/maps/@50.1064121,14.913933,3a,15y,60.44h,88.2t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1so99PGzeEpfVrMqGK8iZJAg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)則使用填滿的大型白色箭頭。

text: Slovak road signs commonly have the painted sign border right **at the edge** of the sign.
NOTE: The borders on [Czech signs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DjWmV787QcRDvfqd6) are almost always separated from the edge of the sign by a strip in the signs background colour.
text_zh: 斯洛伐克的道路標誌通常將彩繪的標誌邊框繪製在標誌的**最邊緣**。
注意：[捷克標誌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DjWmV787QcRDvfqd6)上的邊框幾乎總是與標誌邊緣隔開一段標誌背景顏色的帶子。

text: Slovak highway signs can be either blue or [green](https://maps.app.goo.gl/d3DyfWrkuaqj8KdeA), and have a white border right **at the edge** of the sign.
NOTE: The borders of [Czech](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xCNCvayFVSTaWKYh9) highway signs are separated from the edge.
text_zh: 斯洛伐克的高速公路標誌可以是藍色或[綠色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/d3DyfWrkuaqj8KdeA)，並且在標誌的**最邊緣**有一道白色邊框。
注意：[捷克](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xCNCvayFVSTaWKYh9)高速公路標誌的邊框與邊緣是分開的。

text: White street signs with **blue text** and a **thin red border** are by far the most common in Slovakia.
NOTE: The same design can also be found in Czechia, near the Slovak border. However, Czech street names **never** feature the word “ulica”.
text_zh: 配有**藍色文字**和**細紅色邊框**的白色街道標誌是斯洛伐克最常見的。
注意：同樣的設計也能在捷克靠近斯洛伐克邊境的地方找到。然而，捷克街道名稱中**絕不會**出現「ulica」這個詞。

text: House numbers in Slovakia are typically written on **white signs **with a thin red or black border.
text_zh: 斯洛伐克的門牌號碼通常寫在帶有細紅框或黑框的**白色標誌**上。

text: The top of Slovak sign posts are typically either open, have a [grey metal](https://goo.gl/maps/VHA8WCG3dJw9XWtW7) cap or a [thin black](https://goo.gl/maps/JYFx95Mmcoq6HvZBA) cap.
NOTE: Most [Czech](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.0862812,14.4369725,3a,49.6y,111.31h,103.69t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1siU7X9kVnn5rpAk12DE47pA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) sign posts have a thick black cap.
text_zh: 斯洛伐克標誌桿的頂部通常是開放式的、帶有[灰色金屬](https://goo.gl/maps/VHA8WCG3dJw9XWtW7)蓋或[細黑色](https://goo.gl/maps/JYFx95Mmcoq6HvZBA)蓋。
注意：大多數[捷克](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.0862812,14.4369725,3a,49.6y,111.31h,103.69t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1siU7X9kVnn5rpAk12DE47pA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)標誌桿都有一個厚重的黑帽。

text: Slovakia uses two major pedestrian signs, both having five stripes. The first has a simply drawn person with a belt, and the second has the stripes very close together.

NOTE: The same belted design is found in [Germany](https://goo.gl/maps/JswrpY6bbBQYzAmy8). A similar design, with a distinctly lower belt, is found in [Hungary](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dk233SspcTiQGdeG6). While very rare, pedestrian signs with similarly condensed stripes can also be found in Czechia.
text_zh: 斯洛伐克使用兩種主要的行人標誌，兩者都有五條條紋。第一種是一個簡單繪製、繫著皮帶的人，第二種的條紋非常密集。
注意：同樣繫著皮帶的設計可在[德國](https://goo.gl/maps/JswrpY6bbBQYzAmy8)找到。類似的設計、但皮帶位置明顯較低，可在[匈牙利](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dk233SspcTiQGdeG6)找到。雖然非常罕見，但在捷克也能找到條紋同樣緊密排列的行人標誌。

text: Slovak road signs normally feature a very [**bold font**](https://www.google.se/maps/@48.4928647,17.9733382,3a,15y,218.15h,88.03t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sY8wARZiZIiQjgt3CYNxqSg!2e0!5s20220801T000000!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu).
NOTE: The font on [Czech](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.1047918,14.8557813,3a,15y,16.35h,81.93t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sCynHQszUMJnLGBkvq608pQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) signs is much thinner.
text_zh: 斯洛伐克的道路標誌通常採用非常[**粗的字體**](https://www.google.se/maps/@48.4928647,17.9733382,3a,15y,218.15h,88.03t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sY8wARZiZIiQjgt3CYNxqSg!2e0!5s20220801T000000!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)。
注意：[捷克](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.1047918,14.8557813,3a,15y,16.35h,81.93t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sCynHQszUMJnLGBkvq608pQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)標誌上的字體要細得多。

text: Slovak cycling signs use the letter **C** as their symbol, unique to the country. They’re visually analogous to the Czechoslovak hiking markers mentioned in step 1.1, including the [yellow post](https://maps.app.goo.gl/CG99xS8ZvRjQEERg8) on directional signs.
text_zh: 斯洛伐克的自行車標誌使用字母 **C** 作為其符號，這是該國特有的。它們在視覺上類似於步驟 1.1 中提到的捷克斯洛伐克健行標記，包括方向標誌上的[黃色柱子](https://maps.app.goo.gl/CG99xS8ZvRjQEERg8)。

text: The Slovak railway crossing sign has a white **rectangular background**.
NOTE: [Czech](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.9821592,15.293333,3a,15y,252.56h,95.32t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1seauodxqef41k7Ijnp-XHVA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) railway crossing signs do not have a background.
text_zh: 斯洛伐克的鐵路平交道標誌具有白色的**矩形背景**。
注意：[捷克](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.9821592,15.293333,3a,15y,252.56h,95.32t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1seauodxqef41k7Ijnp-XHVA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)的鐵路平交道標誌沒有背景。

text: It is fairly common to see small signs with **double sign posts** in Slovakia.
NOTE: While large signs may have double sign posts, small signs rarely do in Czechia.
text_zh: 在斯洛伐克，看到帶有**雙標誌桿**的小型標誌相當常見。
注意：雖然大型標誌可能會配備雙標誌桿，但在捷克，小型標誌很少這樣做。

text: Several areas in southern Slovakia have a **Hungarian majority**, with bilingual street and information signs.
text_zh: 斯洛伐克南部的幾個地區擁有**匈牙利族多數人口**，並設有雙語街道和資訊標誌。

text: In the northeastern parts of the Prešov region, you may find bilingual town entry signs in [Rusyn](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rusyn_language), a Cyrillic based language closely related to Ukrainian.
text_zh: 在普雷紹夫（Prešov）地區的東北部，你可能會找到以[盧森尼亞語](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rusyn_language)書寫的雙語城鎮入口標誌，這是一種與烏克蘭語密切相關的斯拉夫語系語言。

text: Skalica, in the northwestern corner of the country, has **red street signs**, similar to the ones commonly found in Czechia. However, the somewhat stylized font distinguishes it from the Czech signs.
text_zh: 斯卡利卡（Skalica）位於該國西北角，擁有**紅色街道標誌**，類似於捷克常見的標誌。然而，其帶有某種風格化的字體使其與捷克標誌區分開來。

text: Slovenian directional signs are **yellow** with a **black border**.

NOTE: Croatia, North Macedonia, Serbia and Montenegro all have similar directional signs. [Austrian](https://www.google.com/maps/@46.5568458,13.9585166,3a,17.9y,222.77h,88.58t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sgiePX811VzIqDTkzzrcHsw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) directional signs are typically white with a blue outline.
text_zh: 斯洛維尼亞的指示標誌為**黃色**配有**黑色邊框**。

註：克羅埃西亞、北馬其頓、塞爾維亞和蒙特內哥羅都有類似的指示標誌。[奧地利](https://www.google.com/maps/@46.5568458,13.9585166,3a,17.9y,222.77h,88.58t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sgiePX811VzIqDTkzzrcHsw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)的指示標誌通常為白色配藍色外框。

text: Slovenian pedestrian signs have **five stripes** and a simply drawn person without a belt.
NOTE: [Austrian](https://goo.gl/maps/S3nXofrbfKot9eLD6) pedestrian signs have two dotted lines, while the person on [Croatian](https://maps.app.goo.gl/yy9Gf53S8AH7Areg6) signs has a belt.
text_zh: 斯洛維尼亞的行人標誌有**五條條紋**，且人物繪製簡單、沒有繫皮帶。
註：[奧地利](https://goo.gl/maps/S3nXofrbfKot9eLD6)的行人標誌有兩條虛線，而[克羅埃西亞](https://maps.app.goo.gl/yy9Gf53S8AH7Areg6)標誌上的人物則有繫皮帶。

text: Slovenian street signs are most commonly white with a **metal border** attached to signposts, or **red** and attached to house walls.

NOTE: [Czech](https://goo.gl/maps/gi5f8C9LNAUumAQFA) street signs are also typically red and attached to walls. However, Czech street names will not contain the word “ulica”, which most Slovenian street names have.
text_zh: 斯洛維尼亞的街道標誌通常為白色、帶有固定在柱子上的**金屬邊框**，或是**紅色**並固定在房屋牆壁上。
註：[捷克](https://goo.gl/maps/gi5f8C9LNAUumAQFA)的街道標誌通常也是紅色並固定在牆上。然而，捷克的街道名稱不會包含多數斯洛維尼亞街道名稱中會有的「ulica」一詞。

text: **Italian bilingual signs** can be found in the westernmost region.
text_zh: 最西部地區可以找到**義大利語雙語標誌**。

text: Instead of the normal red house numbers, Ljubljana will typically feature **green house numbers**.
NOTE: [Street signs](https://goo.gl/maps/h5GSwk121qRJantj8) in Ljubljana are also occasionally green.
text_zh: 盧比安納通常會使用**綠色門牌號碼**，而不是一般的紅色門牌號碼。
註：盧比安納的[街道標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/h5GSwk121qRJantj8)偶爾也是綠色的。

text: Street signs in Celje feature the emblem of the city, a blue shield with **three yellow stars**.
text_zh: 采列的街道標誌帶有該市的徽章，即一個繪有**三顆黃色星星**的藍色盾牌。

text: South Africa uses **green** directional signs with the road number in yellow.
NOTE: Green directional signs with yellow road numbers are also used in Lesotho, Eswatini, Botswana and Namibia. Here, the format of road numbers is useful:
- !!N and R-roads are exclusive to South Africa.
- !!A and B-roads are exclusive to Botswana, Lesotho and Namibia. In addition to this, Namibia uses C, D, M and F roads.
- !!MR-roads are exclusive to Eswatini.
text_zh: 南非使用**綠色**指示標誌，道路編號為黃色。
註：賴索托、史瓦帝尼、波札那和納米比亞也使用黃色道路編號的綠色指示標誌。在此，道路編號的格式很有用：
- !!N 和 R 開頭的道路為南非專屬。
- !!A 和 B 開頭的道路為波札那、賴索托和納米比亞專屬。除此之外，納米比亞還使用 C、D、M 和 F 開頭的道路。
- !!MR 開頭的道路為史瓦帝尼專屬。

text: South Africa utilizes **triangular warning signs** with a red border and a white background.
NOTE: The four other southern African countries use similar warning signs.
!!Australia and New Zealand use yellow diamond-shaped warning signs.
text_zh: 南非採用帶有紅色邊框和白色背景的**三角形警告標誌**。
註：其他四個南部非洲國家也使用類似的警告標誌。
!!澳洲和紐西蘭使用黃色菱形警告標誌。

text: South Africa uses **white-and-red **chevrons. You can find a similar chevron pattern below directional signs.
In addition, unique-looking [small, thin chevrons](https://goo.gl/maps/UtnQqFLqBe9EupxC6) with one arrow are common next to roads.
NOTE: The thin chevrons can also be found in the other southern African countries of Botswana, Eswatini, Lesotho and Namibia.
text_zh: 南非使用**白紅相間的**轉彎標誌。你可以在指示標誌下方找到類似的轉彎標誌圖案。
此外，道路旁常見外觀獨特的[小型細長轉彎標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/UtnQqFLqBe9EupxC6)，上面帶有一個箭頭。
註：這些細長的轉彎標誌也可以在同為南部非洲國家的波札那、史瓦帝尼、賴索托和納米比亞找到。

text: A map of major highways in South Africa. On road signs, the **letter ‘N’ **should appear in front of the highway number. On Google Maps, however, the letter ‘N’ will not be present. Instead, a **blue pentagon** with the number will be displayed.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 南非主要高速公路地圖。在道路標誌上，高速公路編號前方應會出現**字母「N」**。然而，在 Google 地圖上，字母「N」將不會出現，取而代之的是顯示帶有編號的**藍色五邊形**。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: **Square, red stickers **on the back of regular signs are often found in Eastern cape and close to Eastern cape in Northern Cape and Free State. You may see them in the North West province as well, but to a lesser extent.
NOTE: Red stickers on the back of chevrons can be seen in almost every province.
text_zh: 普通標誌背面有**方形紅色貼紙**的情況，經常見於東開普省以及北開普省和自由邦省靠近東開普省的地區。你可能也會在西北省看到它們，但頻率較低。
註：轉彎標誌背面有紅色貼紙的情況幾乎在每個省份都能見到。

text: **Metropolitan Routes** are major roads around cities. They are designated with the letter M.
These distinct and unique M route signs are commonly found in [Port Elizabeth](https://goo.gl/maps/ZfbwsNaUjonKnoAY9) (Gqeberha) and [Durban](https://goo.gl/maps/C94hkSvFEopmUoJx9), respectively.
text_zh: **都會路線 (Metropolitan Routes)**是城市周邊的主要道路，以字母 M 命名。
這些獨特的 M 路線標誌分別常見於[伊莉莎白港](https://goo.gl/maps/ZfbwsNaUjonKnoAY9)（格克貝哈）和[德班](https://goo.gl/maps/C94hkSvFEopmUoJx9)。

text: Triangular warning signs have a **yellow** **background**.
Note that circular prohibition signs, such as speed signs, have a white background. Yield signs also have a white background.
text_zh: 三角形警告標誌具有**黃色** **背景**。
請注意，圓形禁令標誌（例如速限標誌）具有白色背景。讓路標誌也具有白色背景。

text: Direction signs in South Korea have white text on a green background.
text_zh: 南韓的方向標誌是綠底白字。

text: South Korean pedestrian crossing signs can be easily recognised from the distinct **pentagonal shape** combined with the blue background.
text_zh: 南韓的行人穿越道標誌可以透過其獨特的**五角形形狀**結合藍色背景輕鬆辨識。

text: House numbers in the Hampyeong region can be recognised from the **large white section** at the top of the sign.
text_zh: 咸平地區的門牌號碼可以透過標誌頂部的**大片白色區域**來辨識。

text: In rural areas you will often find hunting signs. There are two versions, both of which are unique to Spain. One is a simple white sign with a text starting with “coto” and ending in “caza”. The other one has a diagonally divided black and white background.

NOTE: These signs have an identifying [code](https://www.google.com/maps/@39.7437882,-5.9988875,3a,15y,62.89h,79.86t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1ssz27mavsgGpo566T_-XEmg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) that can sometimes be read. In this case “Ex” stands for Extremadura.
text_zh: 在農村地區，你經常會找到狩獵標誌。有兩個版本，兩者都是西班牙特有的。一個是簡單的白色標誌，文字以「coto」開頭，以「caza」結尾。另一個則具有對角線分割的黑白背景。
注意：這些標誌有一個可識別的[代碼](https://www.google.com/maps/@39.7437882,-5.9988875,3a,15y,62.89h,79.86t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1ssz27mavsgGpo566T_-XEmg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)，有時可以讀取。在這種情況下，「Ex」代表埃斯特雷馬杜拉。

text: Spanish pedestrian crossing signs have **8 stripes**. This is the highest number of stripes in Europe, and almost unique to Spain.
NOTE: The only other European country with 8 stripes is Andorra.
text_zh: 西班牙的行人穿越道標誌有 **8 條白條**。這是歐洲條紋最多的國家，幾乎是西班牙獨有的。
注意：唯一另一個擁有 8 條白條的歐洲國家是安道爾。

text: Spanish stop signs have a distinct **small** font.
NOTE: These are mostly useful to distinguish Portugal from Spain: Portuguese stop signs have a noticeably [larger](https://maps.app.goo.gl/fFE4hc7vSRj35Kc89) font.
text_zh: 西班牙的停車讓路標誌（Stop）字體有著明顯的**小型**字體。
注意：這些主要用於區分葡萄牙和西班牙：葡萄牙的停車讓路標誌字體[明顯較大](https://maps.app.goo.gl/fFE4hc7vSRj35Kc89)。

text: Red borders on road signs extend all the way to the edge of the sign. There is **no small white border** separating the red part from the edge.
NOTE: France, Italy and Portugal have a small [white](https://goo.gl/maps/qq8QB3ArzXtkz7sw5) border on the edge of such road signs.
text_zh: 道路標誌上的紅色邊框一直延伸到標誌的邊緣。**沒有白色的小邊框**將紅色部分與邊緣隔開。
注意：法國、義大利和葡萄牙在此類道路標誌的邊緣都有一個小的[白色](https://goo.gl/maps/qq8QB3ArzXtkz7sw5)邊框。

text: Almost all traffic signs, kilometre markers, chevrons and some direction signs in Spain have a **flat signpost**.
NOTE: Flat signposts in Europe are also present in Portugal, France and Andorra.
text_zh: 西班牙幾乎所有的交通標誌、公里里程碑、轉彎標誌以及部分方向標誌都有**平坦的標誌桿**。
注意：歐洲的平坦標誌桿也存在於葡萄牙、法國和安道爾。

text: Spanish direction signs have a white background. They often feature **colourful boxes** with road numbers, making them recognizable. These road number boxes can be many different colours.
Highway signs have a blue background.
text_zh: 西班牙的方向標誌為白底。它們經常帶有標示道路編號的**彩色方框**，使其易於辨識。這些道路編號方框可以有許多不同的顏色。
高速公路標誌為藍底。

text: You will often find no parking signs in front of garage doors and gates. They will usually read “**Vado permanente**”.
These signs will very often have the name of the municipality after “Ayuntamiento de”.
NOTE: Italy uses signs that read “[Passo carrabile](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7zR6BMCLHRQb6cJQ7)”.
text_zh: 你經常會在車庫門和大門前發現禁止停車標誌。它們通常寫著「**Vado permanente**」。
這些標誌通常會在「Ayuntamiento de」後面加上市鎮名稱。
注意：義大利使用的標誌上寫著「[Passo carrabile](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7zR6BMCLHRQb6cJQ7)」（車庫出入口/禁止停車）。

text: Spanish regional road numbers feature **region-specific codes**. These are found on [road markers](https://goo.gl/maps/rhKLQGfHBrjwrCcVA), and sometimes on [direction signs](https://goo.gl/maps/3mEpJjQ2V7dRHXEb7).
For example, the [SG code on road markers](https://goo.gl/maps/1sgfM2413ykRU9P78) refers to a road in Segovia province.
The infographic shows almost all the regional codes, except for some very rare codes. Click on the image to enlarge it.
NOTE:
- National roads use the following codes: E, AP, A, R, N. These can be found anywhere in the country.
- Be careful: A is also used for community roads in Andalusia and Aragon.
- Some autonomous communities do not have community roads, only provincial roads. These have been indicated with grey on the map.
- Asturias uniquely has a large variety of local road codes.
- Ceuta only has N-roads. Melilla uses the code ML.
text_zh: 西班牙的區域道路編號帶有**地區特定的代碼**。這些代碼可以在[道路標記](https://goo.gl/maps/rhKLQGfHBrjwrCcVA)上找到，有時也會出現在[方向指示牌](https://goo.gl/maps/3mEpJjQ2V7dRHXEb7)上。
例如，[道路標記上的 SG 代碼](https://goo.gl/maps/1sgfM2413ykRU9P78)指的是塞哥維亞省的一條道路。
資訊圖表中顯示了幾乎所有的區域代碼，除了少數非常罕見的代碼外。點擊圖片即可放大。
注意：
- 國道使用以下代碼：E、AP、A、R、N。這些代碼在全國各地都找得到。
- 請小心：A 也用於安達魯西亞和亞拉岡的自治區道路。
- 有些自治區沒有自治區道路，只有省道。這些在地圖上已用灰色標示。
- 阿斯圖里亞斯擁有獨特且種類繁多的地方道路代碼。
- 休達只有 N 開頭的國道。梅利利亞則使用 ML 代碼。

text: No parking signs in Catalan speaking areas will read “**Gual permanent**”. Most municipalities use “gual” in Catalonia and the Balearic Islands, while it’s more common to find a mix of Spanish and Catalan signs in Valencia.
text_zh: 講加泰隆尼亞語地區的禁止停車標誌會寫「**Gual permanent**」。加泰隆尼亞和巴利阿里群島的大多數自治市使用「gual」，而在瓦倫西亞則較常看到西班牙語和加泰隆尼亞語標誌混用。

text: **Basque** is a language isolate that is spoken in the Basque Country and northern Navarre. In these regions, you will find a mix of Spanish and Basque signs (often bilingual).
Basque is not related to any other language, so it has a unique look. Z and K are common letters.
NOTE: Basque is also used in the border area of southwest France.
text_zh: **Basque（巴斯克語）**是一門語言孤立（語言 isolate），通行於巴斯克自治區和納瓦拉北部。在這些地區，你會看到西班牙語和巴斯克語混用的招牌（通常是雙語的）。
巴斯克語與任何其他語言都沒有親緣關係，因此它有著獨特的外觀。Z 和 K 是常見的字母。
注意：巴斯克語也用於法國西南部的邊境地區。

text: Road signs in the Basque Country and Navarre often have these distinctive **bilingual sub-signs** with a **thick black border**.
Generally you will find Basque on top in the Basque Country, while it is more common to find Spanish on top in Navarre.
text_zh: 巴斯克自治區和納瓦拉的道路標誌通常帶有這種獨特的**雙語副標誌**，並具有**粗黑色邊框**。
通常在巴斯克自治區你會看到巴斯克語在上，而在納瓦拉則更常見到西班牙語在上方。

text: **Galician** is a Romance language that is closely related to Portuguese. It is (unsurprisingly) spoken in Galicia. Compared to Catalan, it is less dominant, meaning you will still find a lot of Spanish-only signs in this region.
Galician can look very similar to Portuguese. Some ways to tell them apart is the use of **ñ** and the lack of **ç** in Galician.
text_zh: **Galician（加利西亞語）**是一種羅曼語族語言，與葡萄牙語有很深的淵源。它（不出意料地）通行於加利西亞。與加泰隆尼亞語相比，它的優勢較低，這意味著你在該地區仍然會找到大量純西班牙語的招牌。
加利西亞語看起來與葡萄牙語非常相似。區分它們的一些方法是加利西亞語中使用了 **ñ** 且缺乏 **ç**。

text: Streets are commonly called **Rúa** in Galicia, whereas in Portugal they are called Rua (without an accent). However, you can sometimes find signs without the accent in Galicia.
text_zh: 在加利西亞，街道通常稱為 **Rúa**，而在葡萄牙則稱為 Rua（沒有重音符號）。不過，有時你在加利西亞也能找到沒有重音符號的招牌。

text: Galician towns frequently use signs with a **green or blue strip** at the top featuring the name of the municipality.
NOTE: “Concello” is the Galician word for municipality, and exclusive to the region.
text_zh: 加利西亞城鎮經常使用頂端帶有**綠色或藍色飾條**並印有自治市名稱的招牌。
NOTE: “Concello” 是加利西亞語中「自治市」的意思，為該地區所獨有。

text: Many signs in Catalonia have **round, corrugated signposts**. This is especially common for direction signs. A similar design is also common in the [Basque Country](https://goo.gl/maps/7yJp32FEUtWj2mGp6) and the [Balearic Islands](https://goo.gl/maps/N8qyyoWVysXz7cKR6).
Note that municipalities may use signposts like this anywhere in the country, and that regular traffic signs retain the standard flat Spanish design.
NOTE: [French signs](https://goo.gl/maps/pQmg6fifZ3FEuJbi8) have a very similar design.
text_zh: 加泰隆尼亞的許多標誌都有**圓形且帶有波紋的支柱**。方向標誌尤其常見這種設計。類似的設計在[巴斯克地區](https://goo.gl/maps/7yJp32FEUtWj2mGp6)和[巴利阿里群島](https://goo.gl/maps/N8qyyoWVysXz7cKR6)也很常見。
請注意，自治市可能會在全國任何地方使用這類支柱，而一般交通標誌則維持標準的扁平西班牙設計。
注意：[法國標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/pQmg6fifZ3FEuJbi8)有著非常類似的設計。

text: In Catalonia and sometimes the Balearic Islands you will find huntings signs in Catalan, usually reading “**Àrea privada de Caça**”.
text_zh: 在加泰隆尼亞以及有時在巴利阿里群島，你會發現加泰隆尼亞語的狩獵標誌，通常寫著「**Àrea privada de Caça**」。

text: Signs from the local government of Andalusia are very recognizable because of the **green stripe** on the left side.
It is also very common to see small versions of these signs around nature reserves with **green signposts**.
text_zh: 安達魯西亞地方政府的標誌非常容易辨認，因為其左側有一條**綠色飾條**。
在自然保護區周圍也很常見到帶有**綠色支柱**的小型版本標誌。

text: The [**Camino de Santiago**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Camino_de_Santiago) (the **Way of St. James** in English), is a network of pilgrim's ways across Europe leading to the shrine of apostle James (Santiago in Spanish) in Santiago de Compostela.

These paths are frequently marked with a yellow [scallop](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scallop#Shell_of_Saint_James) on a blue background. Markers can be found both in traffic signs and in waystones.
It is common to see [pilgrims](https://goo.gl/maps/q2VozCDJbQbpZVVdA) hiking or biking along these routes, particularly during the summer.
NOTE: Markers for it can be found all over Europe, going as far as [Lithuania](https://maps.app.goo.gl/iEqTRA9J3qYRgtGV6), but are much more common the closer you are to Santiago.
text_zh: [**聖雅各之路**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Camino_de_Santiago)（英文為 **Way of St. James**），是歐洲各地朝聖之路的網絡，通往聖地牙哥-德孔波斯特拉的使徒聖雅各（西班牙語為 Santiago）神殿。
這些路徑經常標示著藍底的黃色 [扇貝](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scallop#Shell_of_Saint_James)。標誌可以在交通標誌和界石上找到。
沿著這些路線健行或騎單車的 [朝聖者](https://goo.gl/maps/q2VozCDJbQbpZVVdA) 很常見，特別是在夏天。
注意：它的標誌遍布全歐洲，遠至 [立陶宛](https://maps.app.goo.gl/iEqTRA9J3qYRgtGV6) 都能找到，但離聖地牙哥越近就越常見。

text: The city of Bilbao uses this unique street sign, with a very **elaborately decorated frame**. It is not found anywhere else in Spain.
text_zh: 畢爾巴鄂（Bilbao）市使用這種獨特的街頭標誌，具有非常 **裝飾繁複的邊框**。這在西班牙其他任何地方都找不到。

text: Sri Lanka commonly uses **black and white** striped signposts.
NOTE: Within South and Southeast Asia, such signposts are also found in Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Nepal and Malaysia.
text_zh: 斯里蘭卡普遍使用 **黑白相間** 的標誌柱。
注意：在南亞和東南亞境內，孟加拉、不丹、印度、尼泊爾和馬來西亞也能找到這樣的標誌柱。

text: The country is majority **Buddhist**: 70% of the population practise this religion. Throughout the country, you will often see signs of the religion, including temples, Buddha statues, [stupas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stupa) and the [Buddhist flag](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buddhist_flag).
NOTE: Thailand, Cambodia and Laos are also majority Buddhist.
text_zh: 這個國家大多數人口信仰 **佛教**：70% 的人口實踐這種宗教。在全國各地，你經常會看到這種宗教的跡象，包括寺廟、佛像、[佛塔](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stupa) 以及 [佛教旗](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buddhist_flag)。
注意：泰國、柬埔寨和寮國也多數信仰佛教。

text: The presence of the **Tamil script** is strongly correlated with the distribution of Hinduism (though not all Tamils are Hindu and vice versa).
There are two groups that use the Tamil script:
- Native Sri Lankan Tamils, who predominantly live in the north and the east.
- Indian Tamils, who mostly live in and around the central Nuwara Eliya district.

Note that it is not uncommon to find bilingual Sinhala and Tamil signs far outside the area where Tamil is the predominant language. However, Tamil-only signage can be a strong indicator for one of the Tamil-majority areas.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: **泰米爾文** 的存在與印度教的分布有強烈的相關性（儘管並非所有泰米爾人都是印度教徒，反之亦然）。
有兩個群體使用泰米爾文：
- 本地斯里蘭卡泰米爾人，主要居住在北部和東部。
- 印度泰米爾人，主要居住在中部努沃勒埃利耶地區及其周圍。
請注意，在泰米爾語為主要語言的區域之外，發現雙語的僧伽羅文和泰米爾文標誌並不罕見。然而，純泰米爾文標誌可能是泰米爾人多數地區的強烈指標。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: **Russian** can sometimes be found on signs.
text_zh: 有時可以在標誌上找到**俄語**。

text: Swedish pedestrian signs have **four stripes**. There is notably a version featuring a [female silhouette](https://goo.gl/maps/CQ5b63io5DJoPyxi7).
NOTE: Finnish and Danish pedestrian signs have five stripes. Norwegian pedestrian signs usually have four stripes, but can also have five.
text_zh: 瑞典的行人標誌有**四條條紋**。值得注意的是，其中有一個版本是[女性剪影](https://goo.gl/maps/CQ5b63io5DJoPyxi7)。
註：芬蘭與丹麥的行人號誌有五條線。挪威的行人號誌通常有四條，但有時也有五條。

text: Most **directional signs** are blue with a white font and border. A thin arrow shows the direction.
Yellow signs with a black font and red border are also common. Places showcased on yellow signs are typically very small and thus hard to find on a map.

NOTE: Norwegian directional signs are yellow or white, and the white arrow on [Finnish signs](https://www.google.com/maps/@60.7722866,25.4511841,3a,15y,300.91h,88.33t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sQ1aTJO8XBc1Hkb4-DQVc3g!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3DQ1aTJO8XBc1Hkb4-DQVc3g%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D345.10498%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i16384!8i8192) is filled in.
text_zh: 大多數**指路標誌**是藍底白字帶白邊。細長的箭頭指示方向。
黃底黑字配紅框的標誌也很常見。黃色標誌上顯示的地點通常非常小，因此在地圖上很難找到。

注意：挪威的方向指示標誌是黃色或白色，而[芬蘭標誌](https://www.google.com/maps/@60.7722866,25.4511841,3a,15y,300.91h,88.33t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sQ1aTJO8XBc1Hkb4-DQVc3g!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3DQ1aTJO8XBc1Hkb4-DQVc3g%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D345.10498%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i16384!8i8192)上的白色箭頭是填滿的。

text: Swedish road signs have a **red border** and a **yellow background**.
NOTE: Finnish road signs have a thin yellow border outside the red one.
text_zh: 瑞典的道路標誌具有**紅色邊框**和**黃色背景**。
註：芬蘭的道路標誌在紅色邊框外側還有一圈細黃框。

text: On smaller roads, it is common to see these blue signs with a **large white** **M**.

NOTE: Similar signs can be found in [Norway](https://www.google.com/maps/@62.658516,9.2730549,3a,15y,100.11h,87.29t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sPzXte8Lu53s2vN1K2XWVmA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656), however the font is distinctly different. The middle point of the M extends to the bottom of the letter. There are no similar signs in Finland.
text_zh: 在較小的道路上，經常可以看到這些帶有**大型白色** **M** 的藍色標誌。
注意：類似的標誌可以在[挪威](https://www.google.com/maps/@62.658516,9.2730549,3a,15y,100.11h,87.29t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sPzXte8Lu53s2vN1K2XWVmA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656)找到，然而字體明顯不同。M 的中間點延伸到字母底部。芬蘭沒有類似的標誌。

text: Signposts will often have **striped markings**. Blue and white, and red and yellow are the two most common, but you can also find other colours such as [blue and red](https://goo.gl/maps/2svPBY5Cvcwe6MMcA) or [white and red](https://goo.gl/maps/TYKZg93ASEFPjJoU9).

NOTE: Blue and white markings can be found in several other countries, such as [Finland](https://www.google.com/maps/@60.9979656,24.4907775,3a,32.1y,6.25h,71.79t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s2cYyNaVUaT4ADDaWu-mvSw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu) and [Estonia](https://www.google.com/maps/@57.8181373,26.9956931,3a,15y,117.03h,78.19t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sSsJ7EBGSjVuybD9Towdvaw!2e0!5s20210801T000000!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu), however the other colour schemes are essentially unique to Sweden.
text_zh: 路標通常會有**條紋標記**。藍白相間以及紅黃相間是最常見的兩種，但你也能找到其他顏色，例如[藍紅相間](https://goo.gl/maps/2svPBY5Cvcwe6MMcA)或[白紅相間](https://goo.gl/maps/TYKZg93ASEFPjJoU9)。

注意：藍白相間的標記可以在其他幾個國家找到，例如[芬蘭](https://www.google.com/maps/@60.9979656,24.4907775,3a,32.1y,6.25h,71.79t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s2cYyNaVUaT4ADDaWu-mvSw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)和[愛沙尼亞](https://www.google.com/maps/@57.8181373,26.9956931,3a,15y,117.03h,78.19t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sSsJ7EBGSjVuybD9Towdvaw!2e0!5s20210801T000000!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)，不過其他配色方案基本上是瑞典特有的。

text: On top of having red and yellow road signs and signpost markings, Sweden often has a lot of road infrastructure, such as road work signs and [road blocks](https://goo.gl/maps/wFCnjsWszwNyQQgJ9), painted red and yellow. You can even come across [red and yellow chevrons](https://www.google.com/maps/@55.6019708,13.0058156,3a,28.6y,196.99h,78.36t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sD-SvpcBIQdtSHH99XznFPg!2e0!5s20220601T000000!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu).
text_zh: 除了擁有紅黃相間的道路標誌和路標標記外，瑞典通常還有許多道路基礎設施，例如漆成紅黃相間的道路施工標誌和[道路障礙物](https://goo.gl/maps/wFCnjsWszwNyQQgJ9)。你甚至會偶遇[紅黃相間的轉彎標誌](https://www.google.com/maps/@55.6019708,13.0058156,3a,28.6y,196.99h,78.36t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sD-SvpcBIQdtSHH99XznFPg!2e0!5s20220601T000000!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)。

text: Swedish **street names** most commonly use the suffixes “vägen” and “gatan”. They are often shortened into “v” and “g” respectively on street signs. Street names can also use “väg” or “gata” as a separate word in a street name. Additionally, the suffix “[gränd](https://www.google.se/maps/@59.8558729,17.6442795,3a,15y,311.16h,99.2t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sPOWlk1qkTxjff--2GzwLIA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)” can be found near city centres.
NOTE: Norway uses veien or vei, gate or gaten, and gata attached to the rest of the street name, rather than as a separate word. Denmark uses vej and gade.
text_zh: 瑞典的**街道名稱**最常使用字尾「vägen」和「gatan」。它們在路牌上通常分別縮寫為「v」和「g」。街道名稱也可以將「väg」或「gata」作為街名中的獨立單字使用。此外，字尾“[gränd](https://www.google.se/maps/@59.8558729,17.6442795,3a,15y,311.16h,99.2t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sPOWlk1qkTxjff--2GzwLIA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)”可以在市中心附近找到。
註：挪威使用的是 veien 或 vei、gate 或 gaten，以及直接連接到街名其餘部分的 gata，而不是作為獨立單字。丹麥則使用 vej 和 gade。

text: Each administrative region in Sweden has at least one, and in many cases several, bus stop signs which are unique to that region.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 瑞典的每個行政區都至少有一個、通常是好幾個該地區特有的公車站牌。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Many regions have their own distinct type of bus shelters, which may either replace or complement the bus stop signs. This image contains the ones which are most common and easily recognizable.
NOTE: Every region has multiple types of bus shelters, these are simply the most common.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 許多地區都有其獨特的候車亭類型，可能會取代或搭配公車站牌。這張圖片包含最常見且易於辨識的候車亭。
注意：每個地區都有多種類型的候車亭，這些只是最常見的。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: The backside of railway crossing signs have a yellow sticker with a 5-digit ID number. The **first digit** indicates the region, and it predominantly increases to the northeast.
NOTE: The first digit may also be a [6](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Z5Wq8nqJarmQYXi76), which can be found randomly throughout most of the country.
text_zh: 鐵路平交道標誌的背面有一張帶有 5 位數 ID 編號的黃色貼紙。**第一位數字**表示地區，且主要由西南往東北遞增。
注意：第一個數字也可能是 [6](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Z5Wq8nqJarmQYXi76)，這可以在全國大部分地區隨機找到。

text: **Sámi bilingual signs** can be found inland in the northern parts of Sweden.
text_zh: **薩米語雙語標誌**可以在瑞典北部的內陸地區找到。

text: **Meänkieli** is a language closely related to Finnish, which is found close to the Finnish border. One of the most common occurrences on signage is for river names, which will end in “**väylä**”. It is also possible to find [trilingual signs](https://goo.gl/maps/H72p2C2LGP9XyGix7) with both Meänkieli and Sámi.
NOTE: As a general principle, if you encounter [Finnish sounding place names](https://goo.gl/maps/WN3DjPtD6WosR8dv6), you are also likely to be fairly close to the Finnish border.
text_zh: **梅因基利語（Meänkieli）**是一種與芬蘭語密切相關的語言，分佈在芬蘭邊境附近。標誌中最常見的情況之一是河流名稱，其結尾會是「**väylä**」。也有可能找到同時有梅因基利語和薩米語的[三語標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/H72p2C2LGP9XyGix7)。
注意：一般原則是，如果你遇到[聽起來像芬蘭語的地名](https://goo.gl/maps/WN3DjPtD6WosR8dv6)，你通常也相當靠近芬蘭邊境。

text: Many cities and towns have their own **local bus stop signs**, which are different from the signs in the rest of the region (as shown in the infographic in section 2).
NOTE: The Växjö sign can also occasionally be found in [Älmhult](https://www.google.se/maps/@56.5567675,14.149378,3a,15y,299.09h,91.08t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s2Sf4lzoXR-D-KsTijUw3yA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192).
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 許多城市和小鎮都有各自的**當地公車站牌**，這與該地區其他地方的標誌不同（如第2節中的資訊圖表所示）。
注意：韋克舍（Växjö）的標誌偶爾也可以在[埃姆霍爾特（Älmhult）](https://www.google.se/maps/@56.5567675,14.149378,3a,15y,299.09h,91.08t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s2Sf4lzoXR-D-KsTijUw3yA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)找到。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: **Neon-yellow** school bus stop signs are commonly found in the municipalities of Linköping, Norrköping and Jönköping.
text_zh: **霓虹黃色**的學校公車站牌常見於林雪平（Linköping）、北雪平（Norrköping）和延雪平（Jönköping）自治市。

text: Street signs in Stockholm will have **two rows** divided by a black line and will usually **lack a black border**. Similar signs can also rarely be found in [central Gävle](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Y7yH8PQKerNMSUg7A).
NOTE: Several suburbs in Stockholm use [plain white street signs](https://goo.gl/maps/QLzDkBZR6WYYA2A46).
text_zh: 斯德哥爾摩的街道標誌會有由一條黑線分隔的**兩行**文字，並且通常**缺少黑色邊框**。[加夫勒（Gävle）市中心](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Y7yH8PQKerNMSUg7A)也偶爾能找到類似的標誌。
注意：斯德哥爾摩的幾個郊區使用[純白色街道標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/QLzDkBZR6WYYA2A46)。

text: The entire city of Gothenburg uses these unique **blue** street signs. Note that they almost always have two lines.
NOTE: Some other cities will have [blue street signs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xwME3YNRBjtBQBfb6) near the centre, however they use a different design.
text_zh: 整個哥德堡市都使用這些獨特的**藍色**街道標誌。請注意，它們幾乎總是兩行。
注意：其他一些城市在市中心附近也會有[藍色街道標誌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xwME3YNRBjtBQBfb6)，不過它們採用不同的設計。

text: These somewhat old-looking, white street signs, with **black corners**, can be found all throughout Malmö.
text_zh: 這些看起來有些年代感、帶有**黑色角落**的白色街道標誌，可以在整個馬爾默（Malmö）找到。

text: Signs similar to the ones in Malmö, but with a **yellow background** can be found in Ystad.
text_zh: 在于斯塔德（Ystad）可以找到類似馬爾默但**背景為黃色**的標誌。

text: Blue street signs similar to the ones found in Gothenburg can be found in Vellinge municipality. Note that these normally only have **one line**, compared to the two lines on Gothenburg street signs.
text_zh: 在韋靈厄（Vellinge）自治市可以找到類似哥德堡的藍色街道標誌。請注意，與哥德堡街道標誌的兩行相比，這些通常只有**一行**。

text: Plain, **yellow street signs** can be found in Falköping. Note that yellow street signs may very rarely be seen in [other towns](https://www.google.com/maps/@56.07571,14.4730038,3a,15y,244.82h,92.5t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sbVZLgZdEGeq6U0YIjhsR3A!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3DbVZLgZdEGeq6U0YIjhsR3A%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D11.888187%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i16384!8i8192), however they will always have a distinctly brighter colour.
text_zh: 簡樸的**黃色街道標誌**可以在法爾肯平（Falköping）找到。請注意，黃色街道標誌極少數情況下可能會在[其他城鎮](https://www.google.com/maps/@56.07571,14.4730038,3a,15y,244.82h,92.5t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sbVZLgZdEGeq6U0YIjhsR3A!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3DbVZLgZdEGeq6U0YIjhsR3A%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D11.888187%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i16384!8i8192)看到，但它們的顏色總是會明顯更亮。

text: Blue street signs with a thin, **black outline **can be found in Köping.
text_zh: 帶有細**黑色外框**的藍色街道標誌可以在舍平（Köping）找到。

text: [Elfdalian](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elfdalian) is a language that is exclusively found in and around Älvdalen. It is most commonly seen on street signs, with street names typically ending in **“-ween”** or [“-weg”](https://goo.gl/maps/Xo1Zu7hKzGYhzHom9).
text_zh: [艾爾夫達倫語](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elfdalian)是一種僅在艾爾夫達倫（Älvdalen）及周邊地區使用的語言。它最常出現在路標上，街名通常以 **“-ween”** 或 [“-weg”](https://goo.gl/maps/Xo1Zu7hKzGYhzHom9) 結尾。

text: **Three yellow stripes** can be found on signposts and street lamps in Karlstad as well as on traffic lights in [Stockholm](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LWkfkK444PC1CAMy5).
text_zh: **三道黃色條紋**可以在卡爾斯塔德（Karlstad）的標示牌和路燈上找到，也可以在[斯德哥爾摩](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LWkfkK444PC1CAMy5)的紅綠燈上找到。

text: Sundsvall is known as **Drakstaden** (the Dragon City) in Sweden, which can be seen referenced in the form of dragon statues in the central parts of the city, and on signs.
text_zh: 松茲瓦爾（Sundsvall）在瑞典被稱為 **Drakstaden**（龍之城），這點可以從該市中心部分的龍雕像以及標誌上的參考中看出。

text: The colour of **directional signs** indicates which type of road you are on. Main road signs will be blue, while side roads are white.

Major place names will frequently appear on blue signs, while smaller places tend to be on white signs. However, you can still find large city names on a [white sign](https://goo.gl/maps/pfJ2QNrPFmB7q6xN9).
text_zh: **方向標誌**的顏色表示你所在的道路類型。主幹道標誌為藍色，而小路標誌為白色。
主要地名經常會出現在藍色標誌上，而較小的地方則傾向於出現在白色標誌上。不過，你仍然可以在[白色標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/pfJ2QNrPFmB7q6xN9)上找到大城市名稱。

text: Swiss pedestrian signs have **seven stripes**, making it almost unique for Europe. Furthermore, rather than the typical European square shape, the signs appear as tall blue rectangles.
NOTE: Liechtenstein uses identical signs.
text_zh: 瑞士的行人穿越標誌有**七條條紋**，這在歐洲幾乎是獨一無二的。此外，這些標誌不是典型的歐洲正方形，而是顯示為高大的藍色長方形。
注意：列支敦斯登使用相同的標誌。

text: Swiss road signs commonly have a round, grey **metal border** around them.

NOTE: [Liechtenstein](https://maps.app.goo.gl/wbSfjB8xPexuUkqZA) uses almost identical directional signs. Somewhat similar metal borders are found on some directional signs in [Denmark](https://goo.gl/maps/gQWu5BCRsga8WkiS7).
text_zh: 瑞士道路標誌周圍通常有一個圓形的灰色**金屬邊框**。
注意：[列支敦斯登](https://maps.app.goo.gl/wbSfjB8xPexuUkqZA)使用幾乎相同的方向標誌。[丹麥](https://goo.gl/maps/gQWu5BCRsga8WkiS7)的一些方向標誌上也能找到類似的金屬邊框。

text: Town entry signs in Switzerland are usually **white or blue**, with a **metal frame** around them.

NOTE: On the back of these signs you may often find the distance to larger, nearby cities. Furthermore, the abbreviation for the canton can often be seen on the bottom of the sign, especially when the town is situated near a canton border.
text_zh: 瑞士的城鎮入口標誌通常是**白色或藍色**，周圍帶有**金屬框**。
注意：在這些標誌的背面，你經常可以找到通往附近較大城市的距離。此外，標誌底部經常可以看到州的縮寫，特別是當城鎮位於州界附近時。

text: These bus stop signs, with thick **metal signposts** going around them, are unique to Switzerland.
text_zh: 這些公車候車亭站牌周圍繞著粗大的**金屬支柱**，是瑞士特有的景象。

text: The text on the **speed limit signs** varies depending on the official languages in the region.
text_zh: **速限標誌**上的文字會根據該地區的官方語言而有所不同。

text: **Cantons** are the first-level administrative division of Switzerland. It is very common to find the two-letter abbreviation for the canton that you are in, as seen on some town entry signs. As such, remembering these can be a great asset when region-guessing Switzerland.
NOTE: If you happen to come across an [unblurred licence plate](https://maps.app.goo.gl/yi7rVDEFGXqwZaWSA), the first two letters will correspond to the canton that it is registered in.
text_zh: **州（Cantons）**是瑞士的第一級行政區劃。你經常可以在某些城鎮入口標誌上找到你所在州的兩位字母縮寫。因此，記住這些縮寫在進行瑞士區域猜測（region-guessing）時會是一大優勢。
註：如果你剛好遇到一個[未模糊的車牌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/yi7rVDEFGXqwZaWSA)，前兩個字母將對應到該車輛註冊的州。

text: These **large** town entry signs can sometimes be found in the canton of Vaud.
text_zh: 沃州有時可以找到這些**大型**城鎮入口標誌。

text: **Olive green infrastructure**, particularly signposts, sign borders and sign backs, are found in Basel-Landschaft.
text_zh: **橄欖綠色的基礎設施**，特別是標誌柱、標誌邊框和標誌背面，常見於巴塞爾鄉村州。

text: These blue street signs, with **rounded edges** on the sides, are unique to the city of Sankt Gallen.
text_zh: 這些兩側有**圓潤邊緣**的藍色街道標誌，是聖加侖市特有的景象。

text: Large blue street signs, attached to a **low double signpost**, similar to directional signs in [Denmark](https://maps.app.goo.gl/234Fd9GSuZQRtH47A), are found in Basel.
text_zh: 大型藍色街道標誌固定在**低矮的雙標誌柱**上，類似[丹麥](https://maps.app.goo.gl/234Fd9GSuZQRtH47A)的指路標誌，可在巴塞爾找到。

text: These signs indicate Township roads, with the character written **before** or **above** the road number indicating the county.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 這種標誌代表鄉道，寫在編號**前方**或**上方**的字即代表所屬縣市。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: These **bent** sign and chevron holders with two **black and yellow**-striped stickers are only found in Pingtung, Kaohsiung, and Taitung.
text_zh: 這種**彎折式**的標誌與轉彎標誌支架，上面貼有兩條**黑黃**斜紋貼紙，只出現在屏東、高雄與台東。

text: Signposts in Thailand are square and bulky in shape, usually white, and often have the **bottom painted black**.
NOTE: In Southeast Asia, this design is unique to Thailand.
text_zh: 泰國的標誌柱形狀方正且笨重，通常為白色，且經常**底部漆成黑色**。
註：在東南亞，這種設計是泰國特有的。

text: Directional signs on smaller roads are **white**, and are composed of two signs: one with an arrow at the bottom, and one with the information at the top. These can have place names. When they do not, you will see them as just the road number with a [Garuda](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emblem_of_Thailand). Moreover, highway signs are **green**, and frequently feature the place names in Latin script below the Thai name.
text_zh: 小路上的指路標誌是**白色**的，由兩個標誌組成：一個底部帶有箭頭，另一個頂部包含資訊。這些標誌可能帶有地名。當沒有地名時，你只會看到道路編號搭配一個[迦樓羅](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emblem_of_Thailand)標誌。此外，高速公路標誌是**綠色**的，且通常在泰文名稱下方以拉丁字母標示地名。

text: Stop signs in Thailand feature the **Thai script**, instead of Latin.
NOTE: Stop signs in Laos feature the Lao script, similar to Thai, but they have just 2 characters instead of 3.
text_zh: 泰國的停止標誌使用**泰文**，而非拉丁字母。
註：寮國的停止標誌使用寮文，外觀類似泰文，但只有 2 個字元而非 3 個。

text: These distinctive **green **signs can be found all around Thailand, often in small villages.
NOTE: You will not find this sign in any other country.
text_zh: 這些獨特的**綠色**標誌在全泰國各地都能找到，通常位於小村莊中。
註：你在任何其他國家都找不到這種標誌。

text: Waystones and road signs on provincial roads will often provide a **two-letter abbreviation** of the province in Thai script. They will not appear on waystones or road signs for national roads.
You can use [this](https://super-duper.fr/country/thailand_provinces_en.php) site to view and practice all province abbreviations.
text_zh: 省道上的里程碑和道路標誌通常會以泰文字體提供該省份的**兩位字母縮寫**。國道的里程碑或道路標誌上不會出現這些縮寫。
你可以使用[這個](https://super-duper.fr/country/thailand_provinces_en.php)網站來檢視並練習所有省份縮寫。

text: The majority of **Muslims** in Thailand live in the very south of the country. In these areas, you will often see Islamic religious attire, [Jawi script](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jawi_script), based on the Arabic script, on [signs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/oy83kvBm8XWcc3ZEA) and mosques.
text_zh: 泰國的大多數**穆斯林**都住在極南部的地區。在這些地方，你經常會看到伊斯蘭教宗教服飾，以及基於阿拉伯字母的[爪夷文](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jawi_script)出現在[招牌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/oy83kvBm8XWcc3ZEA)和清真寺上。

text: Street signs with a **smaller** **green section** underneath a blue section are found in Bangkok and Nonthaburi.
text_zh: 藍色區塊下方帶有**較小****綠色區塊**的街道招牌可以在曼谷和暖武里找到。

text: Street signs shaped like a **helm **are exclusive to Pattaya City.
text_zh: 形狀像**船舵**的街道招牌是芭達雅市（Pattaya City）所獨有的。

text: **Red street signs** with golden decorated borders can be found in Mueang Chiang Rai.
NOTE: It is possible to see blue street signs with the same border in the city.
text_zh: 帶有金色裝飾邊框的**紅色街道招牌**可以在清萊市（Mueang Chiang Rai）找到。
注意：在該市也有可能看到帶有相同邊框的藍色街道招牌。

text: In Tunisia, both **French and Arabic** are common. The Arabic script can be identified by its lines and dots. You can often see [bilingual signs](https://goo.gl/maps/gS1SqVNEC2RM3KPq8).
NOTE: The UAE and (more rarely) Jordan use English and Arabic.
text_zh: 在突尼西亞，**法語和阿拉伯語**都很常見。阿拉伯文書寫系統可以透過其線條和點來辨識。你常會看到[雙語標示](https://goo.gl/maps/gS1SqVNEC2RM3KPq8)。
注意：阿拉伯聯合大公國和（較少見的）約旦也會使用英語和阿拉伯語。

text: Most direction signs have a **white** background with towns listed in Arabic and Latin script. The font of the Latin script is usually quite distinctive.
NOTE: Many direction signs include the capital Tunis, but this does not necessarily mean you are anywhere near that city.
text_zh: 大多數的方向指示牌都有**白色**背景，並以阿拉伯文和拉丁字母列出城鎮名稱。拉丁字母的字體通常相當具有特色。
注意：許多方向指示牌會包含首都突尼斯，但這並不一定代表你就在該城市附近。

text: Tunisia has a fairly unique **stop sign** with Arabic and Latin script.
NOTE: Similar stop signs can be found in Jordan and the UAE. However, Israel and Palestine use a different unique stop sign with a [hand](https://goo.gl/maps/rDWg2Ff166WhVLax9) instead of text.
text_zh: 突尼西亞有一個相當獨特的**停止標誌**，上面有阿拉伯文和拉丁字母。
注意：類似的停止標誌可以在約旦和阿拉伯聯合大公國找到。然而，以色列和巴勒斯坦使用的是另一個獨特的停止標誌，上面有[手掌](https://goo.gl/maps/rDWg2Ff166WhVLax9)而不是文字。

text: Direction signs use a very distinct font that can often be recognised by the noticeably **wide letter spaces**.
text_zh: 方向指示牌使用非常獨特的字體，通常可以透過明顯**寬敞的字元間距**來辨識。

text: Stop signs have the word “**DUR**” written on them. This is unique to Turkey.
text_zh: 停止標誌上寫著「**DUR**」這個詞。這是土耳其獨有的。

text: The third type of roads are provincial roads. While these generally aren’t labelled on the map, they can still be used to regionguess since the kilometre markers feature the [**provincial code**](https://sites.google.com/site/roadnumberingsystems/home/countries/turkey?authuser=0) as the first two digits on the sign. These codes generally increase alphabetically from 01 to 76 with some newer regions being unordered. Shown in the image is a road from the Afyon Province (03).
text_zh: 第三種道路是省道。雖然這些道路通常不會在地圖上標示，但它們仍然可以用來進行地區猜測，因為公里標示將[**省份代碼**](https://sites.google.com/site/roadnumberingsystems/home/countries/turkey?authuser=0)作為標誌上的前兩位數字。這些代碼通常按字母順序從 01 遞增到 76，其中一些較新的地區則沒有順序。圖片中顯示的是來自阿菲永省（03）的一條道路。

text: Street signs in the Ankara Province are blue with a small **round top**. Similar street signs can very rarely be found in [Giresun](https://goo.gl/maps/aVtMnDJsqJ1ms4jf6).

Beware that some [newer street signs](https://www.google.com/maps/@39.9941773,32.8704415,3a,15y,27.52h,88.69t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sHNDiTJyKaZv36GFlgPI6wg!2e0!5s20221101T000000!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu) are red.
text_zh: 安卡拉省的街道標誌是藍色的，頂端帶有小 **圓頭**。[吉雷松](https://goo.gl/maps/aVtMnDJsqJ1ms4jf6)極少數情況下也能找到類似的街道標誌。
請注意，有些[較新的街道標誌](https://www.google.com/maps/@39.9941773,32.8704415,3a,15y,27.52h,88.69t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sHNDiTJyKaZv36GFlgPI6wg!2e0!5s20221101T000000!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)是紅色的。

text: Street signs in the Izmir Province are dark blue, noticeably **bulge outwards** and very commonly have the **emblem** of Izmir in white at the top of the sign.
text_zh: 伊茲密爾省的街道標誌為深藍色，明顯 **向外凸出**，且標誌頂端通常印有白色的伊茲密爾 **徽章**。

text: These light blue and grey **touristic signs** which are either arrow shaped or rectangular with a half circle on the top can be found on the island of Bozcaada.
text_zh: 這些淺藍與灰色的 **觀光標誌**（呈箭頭狀或上方帶半圓形的長方形）可以在博茲賈島上找到。

text: Red street signs with a coloured bottom strip are found in several cities. In the bottom right corner, you can find a white arrow and some numbers. If this arrow is pointing in **both directions** and has a **single arrowhead**, rather than [double](https://goo.gl/maps/Fd5tuzksA3NY8YsF7), then you are almost certainly in Istanbul.

Beware that simple arrows pointing in only one direction can be found in both [Istanbul](https://goo.gl/maps/6uFmLFqcEn2bT7vL9) and in [other cities](https://goo.gl/maps/BBU6aeQ2BoBN38YH8). However, if you see such signs in combination with [red house numbers](https://goo.gl/maps/kjNkwByQZ7rNaQXdA), then you should be in Istanbul.
text_zh: 帶有彩色底條的紅色街道標誌可在多個城市找到。在右下角，你會看到一個白色箭頭和一些數字。如果這個箭頭指向 **雙向** 且只有 **單側箭頭**，而非[雙側箭頭](https://goo.gl/maps/Fd5tuzksA3NY8YsF7)，那麼你幾乎可以確定身處伊斯坦堡。
請注意，只指向單一方向的簡單箭頭既可在[伊斯坦堡](https://goo.gl/maps/6uFmLFqcEn2bT7vL9)找到，也可在[其他城市](https://goo.gl/maps/BBU6aeQ2BoBN38YH8)找到。然而，如果你看到此類標誌搭配[紅色門牌號碼](https://goo.gl/maps/kjNkwByQZ7rNaQXdA)，那你應該就在伊斯坦堡。

text: Street signs in Trabzon and [Yalvaç](https://goo.gl/maps/vZmpbacvJeyzbMWc9) are **red** and **oval-shaped**. [House numbers](https://goo.gl/maps/96X34Wg24K87jPG4A) also feature the same design.
text_zh: 特拉布宗與[亞爾瓦奇](https://goo.gl/maps/vZmpbacvJeyzbMWc9)的街道標誌為 **紅色** 且呈 **橢圓形**。[門牌號碼](https://goo.gl/maps/96X34Wg24K87jPG4A)也採用相同的設計。

text: Street signs in Bolu are also **green**, but are **completely flat** and lack any kind of border.
text_zh: 博盧的街道標誌也是 **綠色**，但 **完全平坦** 且沒有任何邊框。

text: Owing to its former status as a Danish colony, some streets and localities still have **Danish names** (e.g. _gade_) or display bilingual signs. This is most common in the historical downtown areas.
text_zh: 由於其曾為丹麥殖民地的歷史地位，某些街道和地名仍然保有**丹麥名稱**（例如 _gade_）或顯示雙語標示。這在歷史市中心區域最為常見。

text: Kampala is a fairly **busy-looking** city, with many signs, narrow **unpaved **roads and typically fairly small, one-storey houses. Like many African countries, houses will often be surrounded by tall walls, commonly with barbed wire on top.
text_zh: 坎帕拉是一座外觀相當 **繁忙** 的城市，有許多招牌、狹窄的 **未鋪裝** 道路，以及通常相當小的一層樓房屋。如同許多非洲國家，房屋周邊經常被高牆環繞，頂端通常帶有鐵絲網。

text: The city of Entebbe, southwest of Kampala, can often be recognized by feeling slightly emptier than most of the capital, with more **greenery **and somewhat fancier houses. The area also has significantly more **street signs** than the rest of the capital.
text_zh: 位於坎帕拉西南方的恩德培市，通常可以透過比首都大部分地區略顯空曠、擁有更多 **綠化** 以及稍微高級的房屋來辨識。該地區的 **街道標誌** 也明顯比首都其他地區更多。

text: Ukrainian pedestrian signs have **three stripes**.
Russia, Estonia and Lithuania also use pedestrian signs with three stripes.
text_zh: 烏克蘭的人行道標誌有**三條紋**。
俄羅斯、愛沙尼亞和立陶宛也使用帶三條紋的人行道標誌。

text: Ukraine uses **white** town entry signs.
text_zh: 烏克蘭使用**白色**城鎮入口標誌。

text: The area near the border with Hungary is majority Hungarian. As a result, you will see a lot of signs with **Hungarian language** on it – bilingual or even monolingual.
text_zh: 靠近匈牙利邊境的地區以匈牙利人居多。因此，你會看到很多帶有**匈牙利語**的標誌——雙語甚至單語。

text: The official language in the UAE is Arabic. Its script can be identified by its **lines and dots**.
NOTE: Due to high tourism, signs in the UAE often have English writing alongside Arabic. While this is also common in Qatar and Oman, it is not common in Jordan.
text_zh: 阿拉伯聯合大公國（UAE）的官方語言是阿拉伯語。其文字可以透過**線條與點**來辨識。
注意：由於觀光業發達，阿拉伯聯合大公國的標誌通常除了阿拉伯文外，還會附帶英文。雖然這在卡達和阿曼也很常見，但在約旦則不常見。

text: Many signposts in the UAE have **black-and-white stripes**.
NOTE: Within the Middle East, striped signposts are also found in Oman.
text_zh: 阿拉伯聯合大公國的許多路標都有**黑白相間的條紋**。
注意：在中東地區，有條紋的路標在阿曼也能找到。

text: These **blue** street name signs, with a narrow **metal border**, are specific to Dubai.
text_zh: 這些帶有狹窄**金屬邊框**的**藍色**路名標誌是杜拜特有的。

text: Like most European countries, the UK uses **triangular warning signs** with a red border and a white background.
NOTE: This is mostly useful to distinguish between the UK and Ireland, as Ireland uses diamond-shaped yellow warning signs (being the only European country to do so).
text_zh: 就像大多數歐洲國家一樣，英國使用帶有紅邊白底的**三角形警告標誌**。
注意：這主要是用來區分英國和愛爾蘭，因為愛爾蘭使用的是菱形黃色警告標誌（它是唯一這樣做的歐洲國家）。

text: Direction signs in the United Kingdom can be **blue, green, or white.** Look for the letters **A** or **M**, as these are the major roads in the country. Smaller roads start with **B**.
NOTE: Irish direction signs are typically bilingual, with Irish names in italics, making them easy to distinguish from the UK ones.
text_zh: 英國的指示標誌可以是**藍色、綠色或白色。**尋找字母 **A** 或 **M**，因為這些是該國的主要道路。較小的道路以 **B** 開頭。
注意：愛爾蘭的指示標誌通常是雙語的，愛爾蘭文名稱會使用斜體，使其易於與英國的標誌區分。

text: The UK commonly uses these **white street signs** with black text, that are positioned low to the ground. They are usually supported by two small posts. Many street signs in suburban areas will have a small cul-de-sac icon.
They can sometimes have [different colours](https://goo.gl/maps/Uc9Wf1fjrpvfSTBM8) or feature small designs, like [coats of arms](https://goo.gl/maps/8Di7Wx8TC3dvs8gKA).
text_zh: 英國普遍使用這些位置較低、黑字白底的**白色街道標誌**。它們通常由兩個小柱子支撐。許多郊區的街道標誌會帶有一個小的死胡同圖示。
它們有時可以有[不同的顏色](https://goo.gl/maps/Uc9Wf1fjrpvfSTBM8)或具有小型設計，例如[紋章](https://goo.gl/maps/8Di7Wx8TC3dvs8gKA)。

text: UK yield signs feature the phrase “**GIVE WAY**”.
NOTE: [Irish yields signs](https://goo.gl/maps/GAm9QdSeKWWahHny5) just have the word “YIELD”.
text_zh: 英國的讓行標誌帶有「**GIVE WAY**」字樣。
注意：[愛爾蘭的讓路標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/GAm9QdSeKWWahHny5)只有「YIELD」這個詞。

text: These** diamond-shaped** **‘Passing Place’ **signs are most commonly found in Scotland.
text_zh: 這些**菱形**的**「會車處」（Passing Place）**標誌最常在蘇格蘭找到。

text: **Welsh** is a Celtic language that is spoken throughout Wales. Road signs in Wales are usually bilingual English and Welsh. Towns often have Welsh names too.
Welsh uses the letters **D**, **W**, and **Y** much more commonly than English. The double **LL** is also very distinct.
NOTE: Scottish Gaelic and Irish are both also Celtic languages. They can look somewhat similar to Welsh.
text_zh: **威爾斯語**是一種凱爾特語，在整個威爾斯都有人使用。威爾斯的路標通常是英語和威爾斯語的雙語標誌。城鎮通常也有威爾斯語名稱。
威爾斯語使用字母 **D**、**W** 和 **Y** 的頻率比英語高得多。雙寫 **LL** 也非常獨特。
注意：蘇格蘭蓋爾語和愛爾蘭語也都是凱爾特語。它們看起來可能與威爾斯語有些相似。

text: **Scottish Gaelic** is a Celtic language that is closely related to Irish. They have a very similar look and use accent marks commonly. Common and recognizable letter clusters include bh, dh, fh, mh, ai, ea, eo, and ui.
Scottish Gaelic on road signs is found most commonly in the Scottish Highlands, and is almost always found north of Glasgow.
NOTE: Scottish Gaelic on road signs will often be in green or yellow text. This will not happen with Welsh or Irish on road signs.
text_zh: **蘇格蘭蓋爾語**是一種與愛爾蘭語密切相關的凱爾特語。它們的外觀非常相似，並且常用變音符號。常見且可辨識的字母組合包括 bh、dh、fh、mh、ai、ea、eo 和 ui。
路標上的蘇格蘭蓋爾語最常在蘇格蘭高地找到，且幾乎總是位於格拉斯哥以北。
注意：路標上的蘇格蘭蓋爾語通常會是綠色或黃色的文字。這在威爾斯語或愛爾蘭語的路標上是不會發生的。

text: **London street signs **have a distinct look. They usually feature the street name in black, followed by the postcode and borough in red.
text_zh: **倫敦街名標誌**有著獨特的外觀。通常街名為黑色，下方則是以紅色標示的郵遞區號與行政區。

text: Street name signs in Aberdeen and Aberdeenshire typically feature a simple **blue background** with white lettering.
NOTE: Central Aberdeen uses a different, [black-and-yellow](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dpw9AUQ1e6ieL5U19) design.
text_zh: 亞伯丁（Aberdeen）與亞伯丁郡（Aberdeenshire）的街名標誌通常採用簡單的**藍色背景**搭配白色字體。
注意：阿伯丁市中心採用不同的[黑黃相間](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dpw9AUQ1e6ieL5U19)設計。

text: Signs with **green text** underneath the street name, indicating the townland, can be found in the western part of Northern Ireland.
Especially towards the north of the shaded area, there may be a metal [divider](https://maps.app.goo.gl/AzvWFf8dyeHwbrp98) between the two lines.
text_zh: 在北愛爾蘭西部，街名下方常有標示城鎮區（townland）的**綠色文字**標誌。
特別是在陰影區域的北方，兩條線之間可能會有一個金屬[分隔線](https://maps.app.goo.gl/AzvWFf8dyeHwbrp98)。

text: Most street signs in the Wakefield council are black with a white outline and letters. They use the Monotype Rockwell Nova font.
text_zh: 韋克菲爾德（Wakefield）市議會轄區內的大多數路標都是黑色底，帶有白色的外框和文字。它們使用 Monotype Rockwell Nova 字型。

text: Speed signs with green borders with the text “**Twenty’s Plenty**” are mostly found in and around Glasgow.
text_zh: 邊框為綠色且寫有「**Twenty’s Plenty**」字樣的速限標誌，主要出現在格拉斯哥及其周邊地區。

text: In the US and Canada, especially at large intersections, **long metal bars** with **stop lights** attached to them hang over the street. These bars also commonly have street signs, highway signs, or other signs attached to them.
text_zh: 在美國和加拿大，特別是在大型路口，街道上方會懸掛掛有**紅綠燈**的**長金屬桿**。這些橫桿上也經常掛有路名牌、公路標誌或其他標誌。

text: A horizontal blue, red, or green sign can commonly be seen at the ends of driveways in Wisconsin and the Michigan peninsula. The house number is present, in addition to either the **town name** and or the **road name** (usually).
NOTE: Nearby states often use [similar markers](https://goo.gl/maps/ETNAA9cvLDbB92Lw9), but typically lack any town or street name information and only feature numbers.
text_zh: 在威斯康辛州和密西根半島的車道盡頭，常可見到水平的藍色、紅色或綠色標誌。除了門牌號碼外，通常還會附上**城鎮名稱**和/或**道路名稱**。
注意：鄰近的州經常使用[類似的標示](https://goo.gl/maps/ETNAA9cvLDbB92Lw9)，但通常缺乏任何城鎮或街道名稱資訊，且僅有數字。

text: **Black** street signs with white text can commonly be found at intersections in South Carolina.
text_zh: 在南卡羅萊納州的交叉口，常可找到配有白字的**黑色**街道標誌。

text: Uruguay uses **thick wooden signposts**, which are typically painted white. They often have up to four rectangular notches at the back of the post.
NOTE: Thick wooden signposts can also be seen in Bolivia.
text_zh: 烏拉圭使用**粗木製路標**，通常漆成白色。它們的柱子背面通常有多達四個長方形的缺口。
注意：在玻利維亞也能看到粗木製路標。

text: The posts of road signs are usually painted with a **red and white stripe** pattern.
text_zh: 道路標誌的柱子通常漆成**紅白相間的條紋**圖案。

text: Road signs have a **yellow-orange background**. Within southeast Asia, this is unique.
text_zh: 道路標誌具有**黃橘色背景**。在東南亞範圍內，這是獨一無二的。

text: Directional signs are typically blue with either a very [thin white border](https://maps.app.goo.gl/u7UCtnpyaBFKZ1bR6) or no border at all. The signs usually contain white arrows, which rather than being orthogonal often point in slightly strange directions.
text_zh: 方向標誌通常是藍色的，帶有非常[細的白色邊框](https://maps.app.goo.gl/u7UCtnpyaBFKZ1bR6)或完全沒有邊框。標誌通常包含白色箭頭，這些箭頭往往不依正交方向，而是指向稍微奇怪的方向。

text: **Addresses on signs** are _extremely _common in Vietnam, in particular on storefronts. These addresses follow a hierarchical sequence that usually goes from specific (house/building) to general (city/province). These can be tremendously helpful to find your exact location.
Usually an address will contain all or some of the following elements, from left to right:
- House and street number
- Ward/commune:
- - Ward (urban areas): **phường**
- - Commune (rural areas): **xã**
- District:
- - Urban district: **quận**
- - Rural district: **huyện**
- - District level town: **thị xã**
- - Municipal/provincial city:** thành phố**
- Province/City
- - Province: **tỉnh**
- - Municipality: **thành phố **(a municipality in Vietnam is a city that is on the same administrative level as a province, such as Ha Noi, or Hải Phòng)

These words are often abbreviated. For example, huyện can be abbreviated as just H., thành phố as just TP., etc. Additionally, sometimes the province itself may be abbreviated, for instance [here](https://maps.app.goo.gl/jrN2XEvhZ31gQmJy5) Thái Bình is abbreviated as TB.
text_zh: 越南的**標誌上的地址**_非常_常見，特別是在店面招牌上。這些地址遵循層級順序，通常從具體（房屋/建築物）到廣泛（城市/省份）。這對於尋找你的確切位置會非常有幫助。
通常地址會包含以下全部或部分元素，由左到右：
- 房屋與街道號碼
- 坊/社：
- - 坊（市區）：**phường**
- - 市轄區：**quận**
- - 鄉級行政區：**huyện**
- - 市社：**thị xã**
- - 省轄市/直轄市：**thành phố**
- 省/市
- - 省：**tỉnh**
- - 直轄市：**thành phố**（越南的直轄市是行政等級與省相同的城市，例如河內或海防）
這些詞彙經常被縮寫。例如，huyện 可以簡寫為 H.，thành phố 簡寫為 TP. 等等。此外，有時候省份本身也可能會被縮寫，例如[這裡](https://maps.app.goo.gl/jrN2XEvhZ31gQmJy5) Thái Bình 被簡寫為 TB。

text: Near the beach resorts just east of Phan Thiết city, most signs will have **Cyrillic text** alongside Vietnamese, catering to Russian tourists.
text_zh: 在潘切市東部海灘度假村附近，大多數標誌除了越南文之外還會有**斯拉夫字母文字**，以迎合俄羅斯遊客。
